Ah, it's you... I am not exactly thrilled, but I feel more at ease handing the task to you.
Honestly, my first impression of you was that you weren't dependable... But we should never judge a book by its cover, right?
What's wrong? To let you know, I cannot play favourites even if you try to flatter me. Doing anything like that would be a lost cost.

As the older sister, I feel a deep sense of responsibility for that kid. This includes introducing suitable commissions and helpers to support her... But doesn't it feel unfair to dump all the problems on her? It may sound harsh, but this is obviously meant to toughen her up.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/交谈/交谈3-略低
records.text: Are you here to complain about me being too hard on you? Conductor, I... have been showing you extra care and concern... This is outrageous! (sniffles) Alright, enough with the theatrics. Please get back to work.
The free tennis court has been neglected, forcing me to play at a paid sports centre. Oh! The damage to the court is due to years of neglect, not a powerful serve. Please don't jump to conclusions.

Whether as a superior or a female, the President deserves my utmost respect. She possesses brilliant business acumen and a sharp eye for people. It seems like Signora Medici rarely experiences fatigue during work, except when she hired you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/打开任务列表/打开任务列表1
records.text: It's a good idea to take a moment to consider whether you're up for this task. So, choose wisely, alright?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/打开任务列表/打开任务列表2
records.text: It's great to see how dedicated you are to your work — as a Conductor, dedication should be a given.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/添加任务/成功1
records.text: These orders align better with your current business abilities. Oh, this is just for my assessment. Please don't read too much into it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/接受任务/接受任务1
records.text: I understand that orders at this level shouldn't pose any problems for you, correct?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/接受任务/接受任务2
records.text: I eagerly anticipate the successful completion of these orders, and I hope to receive zero complaints regarding your service.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/取消任务/取消任务1
records.text: Ah... perhaps I should commend you for possessing some level of self-awareness?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/取消任务/取消任务2
records.text: It's pretty heartening. Compared to the energy you've put into cleaning up after messing up an order, the time you've wasted isn't much... Of course, I am the only one cleaning up after you, right?

records.text: There's no need to question my judgment. You just have to worry if the cash in your wallet is adequate.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/买入/购买页签/购买页签2
records.text: Today's item on sale is <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>. Considering its cost-effectiveness, I recommend purchasing it for future needs.
records.noDataString: My judgment needs no doubt, you only need to worry if your wallet is full enough.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/买入/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: Discounts are irresistible. Whenever people see that something is on sale, they will immediately have the urge to purchase it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/买入/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: I consider this a decision without any potential losses.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/买入/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: ...I thought you only bought items on sale.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/买入/购买成功/购买成功1
records.text: Rest assured that my products are designed to exceed your expectations and satisfy you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/买入/取消购买/取消购买1
records.text: Is it a matter of taste or financial capability that led you to this decision? Either way, it's none of my concern.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/卖出/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: It is average... but it is not entirely worthless.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/卖出/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: Well, this is pretty good. I'm starting to see you in a different light.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/卖出/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: ...You're not planning to show me this kind of thing, are you?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/卖出/出售页签/出售页签1
records.text: I'd like to see what good things you can bring to the table.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/卖出/出售页签/出售页签2
records.text: The demand for <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> is high now, so it is recommended that you sell it.
records.noDataString: I am very happy to see what good things you can bring.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/卖出/取消卖出/取消卖出1
records.text: Well, even if you cancel the deal multiple times, I'll still greet you with a smile at the Trading Center the next time.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/卖出/出售成功/出售成功1
records.text: I must say, it has exceeded my expectations. Our collaboration is valuable and should be continued.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/议价/砍价成功/砍价成功1
records.text: You're really something — let's just leave it at that.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/议价/砍价失败/砍价失败1
records.text: I bet you're thinking, 'Could I leave with everything in the store without spending a dime if I beat this guy up?'

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/议价/抬价成功/抬价成功1
records.text: I am feeling generous today, so I will cut you some slack.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/议价/抬价失败/抬价失败1
records.text: It's not easy for me to reach into my pocket and pull out money.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/进入交易所/寒暄3
records.text: I have heard about your work in Freeport Ⅶ. Keep up the excellent work!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/进入交易所/寒暄4
records.text: Welcome. In my investment journey, trading with you has undoubtedly been a success.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/进入交易所/寒暄5
records.text: Your reputation precedes you here. I bet you're doing well in other cities, too.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/进入交易所/寒暄6
records.text: Could it be that you perceive things differently than I do? I'm excited to see what you'll come up with.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/交谈/家族故事/家族故事1
records.text: ...Ahem, Conductor. Based on your route, you'll probably pass through Gronru City later, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/交谈/家族故事/家族故事2
records.text: If you visit Gronru City, you should also check out their Trading Center. What? How could it be considered caring about your money!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/交谈/家族故事/家族故事3
records.text: It's just... Well, I am childhood friends with a landlady there, so I am checking in on a friend's well-being.

records.idCN: 家园/电力/升级前后速度
00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/进入/进入1
records.text: I've been waiting a long time, Conductor...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/喝饮料/喝饮料1
records.text: (chuckles) You've gulped down... all my love...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/喝饮料/喝饮料2
records.text: What exactly should I do to make the Conductor stay?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/上限/上限1
records.text: You can't drink anymore? Then... how about something else?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/浏览/浏览1
records.text: I've prepared everything you wanted, Conductor!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/浏览/浏览2
records.text: Just tell me whatever is it you need, and I'll bring it to you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/交谈/交谈1
records.text: Other than throwing them, my throwing knives can also be used to carve apples. I've carved lots of... (chuckles)... on apples... They will taste much nicer this way when you consume them as drinks, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/交谈/交谈2
records.text: Why are you so close with both the COLUMBA and the BCRL Agency's administrators, Conductor? I can accomplish lots of things too, way more than they can...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/交谈/交谈3
records.text: {playername}, do you know about Artificial Crystal? It's a trendy thing to give them to your lover these days. But in actuality, what's more important than the gift itself is the thought behind it, which is also the hardest to come by...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/交谈/交谈4
records.text: Why am I here? You sure like asking this question, Conductor. Are you perhaps interested in my affairs? That makes me so happy!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/交谈/交谈5
records.text: I've run a check on those people around you. So, you prefer people like them, huh? I will come up with a plan... Of course, I will absolutely never do anything that ruffles your feathers.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/进入/进入1
records.text: Welcome! Ah... Let's have a wonderful time together...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/喝饮料/喝饮料1
records.text: This is a secret recipe prepared exclusively for you. As for what's added to it... you will have to taste the sweetness with your own tongue, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/喝饮料/喝饮料2
records.text: It's okay. Don't mind me. I just want to see you a bit longer...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/浏览/浏览1
records.text: So, this is the kind of design you like, Conductor?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/浏览/浏览2
records.text: Is there anything you want? If not, let me know, and I'll think of something for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/交谈/交谈1
records.text: I may have investigated a ton, but it's not enough. I still want to know more about you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/上限/上限1
records.text: I've filled your stomach with the glass of love I personally mixed.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/交谈/交谈2
records.text: Shoggolith's Black Tea is especially renowned due to its sophisticated aroma. You seem to have bought quite a bit of it. Are they for Miss Livia? You sure are thoughtful toward your subordinates... Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/交谈/交谈3
records.text: Many Shoggolith companies incorporate the Ward Mountain as a fundamental element in the design of their logo, as it holds a special significance to the people of Shoggolith. It's the same as how special you are to me, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/交谈/交谈4
records.text: Mr. Mayor's contribution to the prosperity this city now has is naturally indisputable. Nevertheless, a man with a successful career may not necessarily have a happy family... Ah, I just thought about some things from the past.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/交谈/交谈5
records.text: About the amazing effects of the 'Silver Branch Water,' I simply added a tinge of love magic to it... This way, you will keep coming to see me from now on, yeah?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/交谈/交谈1
records.text: That manager guy changed all the workers' cutlery to plastic ones ever since he was attacked by someone with a sharpened metal spoon. Interesting, huh?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/交谈/交谈2
records.text: (sighs) Conductor, what exactly is your relationship with Miss Shizuru of the BCRL Agency? There are already more than enough pests as it is... Haa... Seriously...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/交谈/交谈3
records.text: If only the effects of 'Silver Branch Water' can be determined? If that's your wish, I'll work on it! Next time, I'll add something even stronger... Look forward to it, Conductor!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/交谈/交谈4
records.text: Have you ever wondered why you keep receiving orders to transport workers to Mander Mine every now and then? It's somewhat odd, right? As if they have an endless need for manpower.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/交谈/交谈5
records.text: If you're unhappy with the things I prepared, you gotta let me know, okay? I will become whatever you like, Conductor...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/进入/进入1
00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/上限/上限1
records.text: I'd love for you to drink more too, but it isn't right. We gotta take it one step at a time...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/喝饮料/喝饮料1
records.text: How is it? Did the sweet taste of apples help you relax? I picked every single apple meticulously since they are meant for you to drink!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/喝饮料/喝饮料2
records.text: How is it? This is a drink you can't find anywhere else but here!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/浏览/浏览1
records.text: I remember every little thing that you like, Conductor~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/浏览/浏览2
records.text: I can do way more things for you, so pay me more attention, okay?
载客量不足，建造载客车厢可以提高载客量

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/进入/进入1
records.text: Enough with the small talks. Is there anything you need assistance with today?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/进入/进入2
records.text: Ah, it's you... I am not exactly thrilled, but I feel more at ease handing the task to you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/进入/进入3
records.text: How hard-working. All right, I can't lose to you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/进入/进入4
records.text: You never fail to complete your tasks impeccably. Clearly, you also have really high standards for yourself, huh?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/进入/进入5
records.text: Feels like I might even find it strange if you stop showing up someday... Tsk, this sense of dependency needs to be curbed.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/进入/进入6
records.text: It isn't my style to not reciprocate one's assistance. Don't hesitate to let me know if you ever need anything.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/浏览/浏览1
records.text: Just select tasks within your capabilities.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/浏览/浏览2
records.text: It would not hurt to consider this carefully. After all, you're responsible for the safety of others on the train.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/交谈/交谈1
records.text: As members of the B.C.R.L., we regularly receive supplies from Carmine May. It's impressive that such delicious chocolate is also affordable.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/交谈/交谈2-略低
records.text: You and Shizuru... seem to share a deeper relationship, right? I've never seen her react like that, and it's rather surprising.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/交谈/交谈3
records.text: Honestly, my first impression of you was that you weren't dependable... But we should never judge a book by its cover, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/交谈/交谈4
records.text: The line at the first window of BCRL's cafeteria is consistently the longest because it sells BCRL's Set Meal A exclusively. That is the most unbeatable value-for-money set meal of all.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/朱利安/交谈/交谈5-低
records.text: Dealing with those overly shrewd people never fails to give me a headache. Take the COLUMBA's Miss Ruperto for instance. In fact... she always makes me feel like I can never hide anything from her. I hope I'm just overthinking it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/交谈/交谈1
records.text: You find me familiar? Perhaps you've seen my face on the BCRL's recruitment posters.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/交谈/交谈2
records.text: Every once in a while, my daughter asks me to purchase some car parts from Shoggolith and send them to her. I don't wish to interfere too much with her affairs, but I can't help worrying if she's doing some kind of dangerous experiments again...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/交谈/交谈3
records.text: MoleGang is a challenging conundrum for Shoggolith's security. The BCRL Agency has tried multiple times to shut them down but to no avail. They seem to always receive some form of help at critical junctures to get away.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/交谈/交谈4-低
records.text: Although Shoggolith's mayor has never been anything short of polite to me, I shouldn't have too close a relationship with him, be it at work or in private. He is a calculating man. You ought to be cautious when dealing with him, too.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/交谈/交谈5
records.text: My wife called to ask me why the television couldn't be turned on anymore. I asked her if the plug had come loose. Indeed, that was the case when she checked on it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/浏览/浏览1
records.text: There are all kinds of intricate, complex forces in Shoggolith. Being too prudent might cause one to be unable to handle these missions deftly instead.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/浏览/浏览2
records.text: Victory isn't limited to a specific form. You are free to pick whatever your forte is.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/进入/进入1
records.text: Welcome to the BCRL Agency, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/进入/进入2
records.text: If you're here to handle mission-related matters, then you should all the more compose yourself.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/进入/进入3
records.text: You look much more in your element now than when you first stepped into the BCRL Agency.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/进入/进入4
records.text: Your performance has been undeniably notable all along. Keep working hard, gifted one.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/进入/进入5
records.text: It's already impressive that you've achieved so much, but your gaze tells me that you are far from attaining your goals.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/进入/进入6
records.text: I trust you to take care of the matter.
Seeing as you're here while on the clock, do you need help, or are you here to take on commissions?
The commission board is over here... Or do you perhaps have something else to talk to me about?
You're right on time today too.
I doubt a conductor's job is languorous, and yet you still complete so much work every day. If you have some kind of time management tips, I'm all ears.
Having you around almost immediately lessens my workload. What a foreign feeling this is...
Other than completing the missions immaculately, you have to make sure you get adequate rest as well.
There is never a lack of missions here.
Manage your time reasonably and select the most efficient method.
In Mander Mine, there are perpetually more people seeking help from the BCRL Agency than people providing aid. Hence, someone like you is truly hard to come by.

Thanks to the terrible state of security here, the majority of conductors do their best to avoid taking any jobs located in this region. Even if they do come, they will rather not step foot off the carriage.
I don't have any particular thoughts about this place. Since I've been assigned to manage things here, I'll just do my part.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/甘雅/交谈/交谈4-略低
records.text: If I'm being honest, Mander Mine isn't really that bad of a place... There are always loads of large machinery here that can't be found in other Bonfire Cities. It's entertaining to watch them work.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/甘雅/交谈/交谈5-极低
records.text: ...Legend of Mander Mine's midnight cries? I-I've never heard of that. That's clearly made-up nonsense.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/波克普拉士/交谈/交谈1
records.text: Humans perceive beauty as a sensory ability, but I also have my own understanding of beauty — Signora Medici is beauty!
Conductor, it seems like you don't have enough BCRL Coins.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/波克普拉士/投资/投资1
records.text: Conductor, these are the current investment options for the city.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/荷塞/成功投资/成功投资1
records.text: Thank you for your kindness, this will be an indispensable part of Shoggolith's development.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/波克普拉士/成功投资/成功投资2
records.text: Thank you, Conductor, for supporting Freeport Ⅶ!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/波克普拉士/成功投资/成功投资3
records.text: The use of this fund needs to be simulated and decided.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/波克普拉士/成功投资/成功投资4
records.text: Good job! There are many places where funds are needed!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/波克普拉士/成功投资/成功投资5
records.text: It seems like a large amount to the average human, but it's insignificant compared to my regular maintenance costs!

records.idCN: 补充体力/选择补充方式-澄明度
records.text: Please choose one of the following ways to restore Clarity.

records.idCN: 交易所/0提示/补充疲劳值
records.text: Your Fatigue is too high! Do you want to use <color=#FEC032>%s</color> to reduce Fatigue?
It's a pleasure seeing you in Shoggolith's City Hall. I have a feeling we can both see eye to eye on certain things.
In response to your ardor, I should also demonstrate my sincerity so that you won't regret any investment you made in Shoggolith.
See? Your contribution is truly changing Shoggolith City, albeit still just minimally. It is something to feel proud about.

Will you really not consider staying in Shoggolith City to work for me? I'll make you an offer you can't say no to... Just kidding. We've spent enough time for me to know that you will surely turn me down.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/荷塞/成功投资/成功投资2
records.text: I assure you they will be used where it needs most.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/荷塞/成功投资/成功投资3
records.text: Shoggolith City is beyond grateful for your generous contribution.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/荷塞/成功投资/成功投资4
records.text: Of course, I'll give you satisfactory returns. This is also what you're looking forward to, no?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/荷塞/成功投资/成功投资5
records.text: I will have the managing officer send you the funds' usage breakdown afterward. After all, being transparent is the most efficient means to maintain this trust, a key element.
Worry not about the privileges you're receiving. No one can disregard your contribution to Shoggolith. I'm merely responding in kind as the mayor. There is no personal agenda behind this.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/打开任务列表/打开任务列表2
records.text: Let me know when you've made up your mind, okay? I'm busy, and it's boring to wait for your decision.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/打开任务列表/打开任务列表1
records.text: Hmm, take your time to read through it. My teacher always said that people who aren't quick on the uptake need more time to think.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/交谈/交谈1-极低
records.text: Who's my teacher? Well, there isn't really a teacher. using the term just makes what I say sound more convincing. Even if people don't like what's said, they can't really blame a teacher.
My sister... that woman... probably comes across as rather harsh to many conductors. Although she may give that impression, she's actually better than me at controlling her emotions.

When it comes to appointing responsible individuals to various stations, the president makes careful consideration. That means she thinks I'm suited to work in Shoggolith... The president is quite formidable, so I trust her judgment.
I bought one of those pure white jigsaw puzzles with no patterns on it, a thousand pieces in total. Should keep me occupied for a while. Once I finish it, I'll go buy a black one to play with.
Here for a chat? I suppose you still have work to do, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/接受任务/接受任务1
records.text: Alright, alright. I've updated the order manager column with your name.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/接受任务/接受任务2
records.text: That's it, my teacher says diligence can make up for deficiencies, so use your diligence to make up for your shortcomings.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/取消任务/取消任务1
records.text: Ugh... What a hassle... Huh? I didn't say anything. My teacher said that the guiltier you are, the more likely you are to have illusions.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/取消任务/取消任务2
00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/添加任务/成功1
records.text: If you really can't decide, look at these orders. They had undergone careful consideration, not randomly arranged.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/任务列表为空/任务列表为空1
records.text: I've finished all the work for today. Even if you want to work overtime, I won't accompany you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面3
records.text: Well, you finally look like a COLUMBA member now. Hopefully, it's not too late for everything.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面4
records.text: You're unexpectedly competent... Oh? Did you finally get it? Or were you just pretending to be clueless when we first met? Either way, it's kind of annoying, isn't it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面5
records.text: Your performance is excellent. Keep it up. Of course, I'll praise others when they deserve it. Don't look so surprised.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/露珀特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面6
records.text: Welcome, COLUMBA's Future Star — Is that mockery or praise? You decide.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/打开商会界面/打开商会界面1
records.text: Feel free to browse through today's orders. I don't think you'll look for me for something other than this, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/打开商会界面/打开商会界面2
records.text: Don't worry. You won't have trouble finding work here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/打开商会界面/打开商会界面3
records.text: It's you... You'd better work hard, okay? After all, not everyone is as friendly and easygoing as I am. Just wait till you meet that woman at Freeport Ⅶ.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/打开商会界面/打开商会界面4
records.text: You're working hard, huh? That's great, really great.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/打开商会界面/打开商会界面5
records.text: Hey, aren't you overdoing it a bit? Even if you're chasing performance, shouldn't you feel a little bored doing it so relentlessly?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/墨伊拉/打开商会界面/打开商会界面6
records.text: Many people slack off right after achieving their goals. Are you such a person?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/成功投资/成功投资1
records.text: Don't worry. I won't use this fund, filled with enthusiasm and goodwill, for my own gain.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/成功投资/成功投资2
records.text: If you have a specific purpose in mind for this fund, please feel free to say so.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/成功投资/成功投资3
records.text: A moderate amount, that's a reasonable choice.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/成功投资/成功投资4
records.text: My, this amount of investment. If only there's no need to spend any penny... Alas, it's necessary to give out some benefits from time to time to keep those people in check.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/成功投资/成功投资5
records.text: Your demeanor seems to suggest that even a larger sum wouldn't be out of the question.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/进入/进入1
records.text: Since you're here, it means we can reach a mutually satisfying cooperation. My understanding is correct, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/进入/进入2
records.text: Ah, of course, I knew that a promising young conductor like you would surely bring surprises.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/进入/进入3
records.text: Welcome, welcome. You are the great benefactor of Mander Mine. If my tone has offended you, please forgive me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/进入/进入4
records.text: Such generous investment in Mander Mine. Perhaps I should erect a statue for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/进入/进入5
records.text: Maintaining our cooperation with you was indeed the right choice. I'm good at seizing profitable opportunities, even if it requires some less-than-pleasant methods.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/进入/进入6
records.text: Please continue to maintain this good relationship. You wouldn't turn your back on us after achieving your goals, would you?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/波克普拉士/进入/进入3

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/进入交易所/寒暄1
records.text: As soon as you walked in, I knew today was a good day for business.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/进入交易所/寒暄2
records.text: Take a look at this ring in my hand. Isn't it nice? Feel free to take a closer look. This quality is hard to come by.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/进入交易所/寒暄3
records.text: Look who's here. I brought in some good stuff. You'll be the first to see them!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/进入交易所/寒暄4
records.text: You've been quite active lately. My ears are almost calloused from hearing about you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/进入交易所/寒暄5
records.text: Oh hey, the busy person is here? You look hectic. Want to sit down and have some tea?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/进入交易所/寒暄6
records.text: Thanks for taking care of my business. Is there anything I can help you with?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/交谈/站点限定情报/情报1
records.text: Speaking of Shoggolith, it's impossible not to mention their home appliances. I heard even the television at Heath David's house is produced by Shoggolith.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/交谈/站点限定情报/情报2
records.text: The Agricultural Association of Shoggolith is discussing whether to establish new export standards for potatoes... I can already smell business opportunities.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/买入/购买成功/购买成功1
records.text: Thanks for your patronage. Come back when we have restocked!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/买入/购买页签/购买页签1
records.text: These are carefully selected goods. Supply is limited. Don't miss out.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/买入/购买页签/购买页签2
records.text: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are on sale today! With such a good price, why not take some?
records.noDataString: These are carefully selected quality goods, available in limited supply, so don't miss out.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/买入/取消购买/取消购买1
records.text: If you miss this opportunity, you won't come by it again!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/买入/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: The price is absolutely fair. Take some if you need!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/买入/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: Oh, you're making quite a lavish purchase today. No wonder I smelled something rich as soon as you walked in... I mean, the aura of a distinguished guest!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/买入/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: Highly discounted price. I won't make a penny off this deal. You can buy it with your eyes closed!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/卖出/出售成功/出售成功1
records.text: Happy trading. Remember to come to me next time you need something!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/卖出/出售页签/出售页签1
records.text: I welcome all transactions, buying and selling, buying and selling. When there's buying, there's selling — What good stuff are you planning to show me this time?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/卖出/取消卖出/取消卖出1
records.text: Other stores might not offer you the same price. Think about it carefully.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/卖出/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: This one... a fixed price, how about this amount! Rest assured, absolutely fair and square!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/卖出/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: You're lucky. This item is very popular right now. I'm willing to pay more for it. How about it? Aren't you happy enough?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/卖出/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: The market for this item isn't doing well today. Have you considered it carefully?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/议价/砍价成功/砍价成功1
records.text: Sigh... for the sake of long-term development, sometimes you have to make concessions.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/议价/砍价失败/砍价失败1
records.text: Bargain leaves room for future meetings! If I sell it to you at that price, I'll be out of business.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/议价/抬价成功/抬价成功1
records.text: For such quality, it's a deal! Remember to come back next time with good stuff!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/议价/抬价失败/抬价失败1
records.text: It's not that I'm disrespecting you. Anyone would only offer this price.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/卖出/出售页签/出售页签2
records.text: By the way, if you have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>, don't hesitate to bring them out.
records.noDataString: I welcome all trades, trade trade, where there's buying, there's selling—what good stuff do you plan to show me this time?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/进入交易所/寒暄1
records.text: Welcome, welcome, Conductor! What would you like to buy?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/进入交易所/寒暄2
records.text: I might smell of oil. Don't mind it! It's inevitable when I often tinker with those things.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/进入交易所/寒暄3
records.text: Perfect. I've created an impressive new gadget. Do you want to take a look before we trade?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/进入交易所/寒暄4
records.text: Seeing you work so hard, I can't be left behind. I must prepare an item that will surprise you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/进入交易所/寒暄5
records.text: It seems your work is going quite smoothly. Fortunately, our research and development process is the same.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/进入交易所/寒暄6
records.text: Seeing your success now proves that I had a keen eye from the beginning, haha! Research results? Let's not talk about that for now...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/家族故事/家族故事1
records.text: Gronru City. Gronru City is a good place! Most importantly, my beloved fish is there!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/家族故事/家族故事2
records.text: I know we have many competitors, but if we don't try, how do we know if we'll succeed? I believe I can impress her!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/家族故事/家族故事3
records.text: Speaking of which, I made a gold-plated electric torque wrench just for her on her last birthday, but she rejected it. Why!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/站点限定情报/情报1
records.text: The steel produced here has made the iron rails of the northern continent. There's no doubt about it!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/站点限定情报/情报2
records.text: Baxter said that the eerie noises at night seemed to come from the direction of the BCRL Agency, but Ganya said she had never heard them, and that made him even more afraid, haha!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/买入/购买成功/购买成功1
00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/买入/购买页签/购买页签1
records.text: Before you buy, I want you to know that <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are on sale today. Don't miss out. Give it priority consideration!
records.noDataString: I won't do anything as shoddy as passing off inferior goods as good ones! Wouldn't that ruin my reputation?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/买入/购买页签/购买页签2
records.text: We wouldn't do things like passing off substandard goods as high-quality ones, that would be ruining our own reputation!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/买入/取消购买/取消购买1
records.text: There's a saying, not buying can save you one hundred percent...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/买入/选择商品/选择原价商品1
00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/买入/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: Haha, of course I don't mind making a little more money!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/买入/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: That's right! Save where you can!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/卖出/出售成功/出售成功1
records.text: My offer is definitely fair. Come back next time!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/卖出/出售页签/出售页签1
records.text: Come on! Let's give a warm welcome to <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> today.
records.noDataString: There's nothing without value. It's just a matter of how much it's worth!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/卖出/出售页签/出售页签2
records.text: There is no such thing as worthless; it's only a matter of how much value it holds!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/卖出/取消卖出/取消卖出1
records.text: Changed your mind? That's fine. Let's trade next time!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/卖出/选择商品/选择原价商品1
00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/卖出/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/卖出/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: Oh, are you sure? Are you that short on money?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/议价/砍价成功/砍价成功1
records.text: Alright, I'll give you a friend's price!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/议价/砍价失败/砍价失败1
records.text: Haha, sorry, I can't let myself lose money!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/议价/抬价成功/抬价成功1
records.text: Take the extras as an investment for your future!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/议价/抬价失败/抬价失败1
records.text: You get what you pay for. This is all I can offer.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/交谈/交易行情/交易行情1
records.text: The demand for <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> has skyrocketed at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>. Why don't you consider selling there?
records.noDataString: I actually can't quite understand the behavior of buying train models as souvenirs to take back from Freeport VII, but they do sell well.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/交谈/交易行情/交易行情2
records.text: At <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>, there's simply no market for <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>. I suggest you trust my information network. Don't suffer losses from trading with the wrong partners.
records.noDataString: Book storage is an issue in this place, as it tends to get damp easily. However, Anita and her team always have their own strategies.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/交谈/特产情报/特产情报1
records.text: Freeport Ⅶ's Chaos Money Tree? That's the best-selling item in Mander Mine.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/交谈/特产情报/特产情报2
records.text: Mander Mine's GPU is consistently out of stock in Freeport Ⅶ. After all, it's the pick of the litter.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/采购券使用/采购券使用1
records.text: Oh, since you had this, why didn't you bring it out earlier? I'll prepare new merchandise right away.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/商品交易上限/商品交易上限1
records.text: We're out of stock today, sorry. After all, the warehouse capacity is limited.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/采购券使用/采购券使用1
records.text: Facing such a generous guest like you, I certainly have no reason to hide the goods!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/商品交易上限/商品交易上限1
records.text: Oh, you're so generous a customer, but I don't have anything better to offer. I'm really sorry! Please allow me to make up for it tomorrow!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/交谈/交易行情/交易行情1
records.text: Recently, a transportation order concerning <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> went wrong at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>. Now, the price of it over there is continually rising.
records.noDataString: Speaking of Shoggolith, their home appliances are a must-mention. I heard that even the television set in Heath Davis's house is produced by Shoggolith.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/交谈/交易行情/交易行情2
records.text: Have you heard? There's a COLUMBA selling a large quantity of <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>. I don't recommend selling there. It's wiser to find another place to sell them.
records.noDataString: Recently, the Shoggolith Agricultural Products Association has been discussing whether to establish new potato export standards... I can already smell the scent of opportunity.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/交谈/特产情报/特产情报1
records.text: Our Bullet Accelerators are incredibly hot selling in Anita Weapon Factory. I heard it's almost to the point where it's regarded as hard currency.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/交谈/特产情报/特产情报2
records.text: Pure Gold Wires are good stuff... If you have some, I'll gladly take them off your hands. No one here will say no to it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/采购券使用/采购券使用1
records.text: Let me prepare new merchandise right away!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/商品交易上限/商品交易上限1
records.text: Oh no, our warehouse is empty now!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/交易行情/交易行情1
records.text: Do you have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>? It's selling pretty well at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>.
records.noDataString: The steel produced here has undoubtedly created these railroad tracks of the Northern Continent!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/交易行情/交易行情2
records.text: Wait, have you heard? Don't sell <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> today, or you'll definitely lose money! Don't be polite. Please take care of our business in the future.
records.noDataString: That old fellow Baxter told us that the eerie sound at midnight seemed to come from the direction of the BCRL Agency, but young sister Ganya said she had never heard it. He got even more scared after hearing that, haha!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/特产情报/特产情报2-1
records.text: Chaos Money Trees are very popular here. Frankly, I like them too.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/采购券使用/采购券使用1
records.text: If it means offering an outstanding conductor like yourself even more choices, it would be my utmost pleasure.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/进入交易所/寒暄1
records.text: Good day~ Isn't the weather simply lovely today? To me, any day there's business to be done is a lovely day indeed.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/进入交易所/寒暄2
records.text: I do have quite a number of admirers, it's true, but rather than flirtation, I'd much prefer you speak with me about business matters.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/交谈/站点限定情报/情报1
records.text: Fine cuisine, fashion, luxury goods... this city is truly made for a lady of refined taste to enjoy life to the fullest.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/交谈/站点限定情报/情报2
records.text: To my eye, none of the productions playing at the concert hall these days come close to Mr. Verwell's caliber... what a shame. Has Gronru really produced no finer playwright in all these years?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/交谈/交易行情/交易行情1
records.text: There's been trouble lately with a shipping order for <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>, and the price of <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> has climbed rather steeply as a result.
records.noDataString: Fine cuisine, fashion, luxury goods... this city is truly made for a lady of refined taste to enjoy life to the fullest.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/交谈/交易行情/交易行情2
records.text: Have you heard? Some merchant house has been dumping large quantities of <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>. Might be wiser to unload elsewhere.
records.noDataString: To my eye, none of the productions playing at the concert hall these days come close to Mr. Verwell's caliber... what a shame. Has Gronru really produced no finer playwright in all these years?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/交谈/家族故事/家族故事1
records.text: Even a fine lady such as myself has little say in matters of the heart. It's only that... I still can't quite bring myself to forgive my brother.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/交谈/家族故事/家族故事2
records.text: If it's my brother who put you up to prying, I'm afraid I have nothing to say on the matter—I simply refuse to resort to the sort of coarse language people use when venting their negative feelings. It would hardly become a lady.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/交谈/家族故事/家族故事3
records.text: He once told me he could never afford to linger over matters of romance... but then, how easily does one simply forget?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/交谈/特产情报（废弃）/特产情报1
records.text: <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>对<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>需求一向巨大，与当地的产业环境有很大的关系。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/交谈/特产情报（废弃）/特产情报2
00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/交谈/今日折扣情报/今日折扣情报1
records.text: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> happens to be on clearance right now—a deal this good doesn't come along often.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/买入/购买成功/购买成功1
records.text: Many thanks for your continued patronage.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/买入/购买页签/购买页签1
records.text: Whether it's suitors or merchandise, my eye for quality is second to none—feel free to browse with complete confidence.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/买入/取消购买/取消购买1
records.text: Knowing one's own means isn't such a bad thing, you know.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/买入/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: A discerning choice—though, of course, I'd say that no matter what you bought.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/买入/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: Sometimes what you're really buying is a feeling, in the moment. That's what they call added value.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/买入/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: By every measure, I'd wholeheartedly recommend this item to you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/卖出/出售成功/出售成功1
00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/卖出/出售页签/出售页签1
records.text: Naturally, I take quite an interest in items of real value—please, don't hesitate to show me what you're holding.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/卖出/取消卖出/取消卖出1
records.text: Well, I suppose I can hardly fault you for being cautious when it comes to making a decision.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/卖出/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: This looks rather nice—how about this price?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/卖出/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: Oh my, isn't this... you simply must sell it to me. And of course, I won't shortchange you on the price.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/卖出/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: I'm not terribly interested in this one... but seeing as it's you, I suppose I could bring myself to take it off your hands.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/议价/砍价成功/砍价成功1
records.text: For the sake of a long and lasting relationship, I suppose I could afford to give a little ground today.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/议价/砍价失败/砍价失败1
records.text: Even I would find the price you're asking rather difficult to swallow.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/议价/抬价成功/抬价成功1
records.text: That'll do just fine—the price is still within reason.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符渝/议价/抬价失败/抬价失败1
records.text: I can only offer what an item is truly worth—that's simply the duty of a merchant.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/采购券使用/采购券使用1
records.text: Restock? Sure thing, provided that you've brought the purchase voucher!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/进入交易所/寒暄1
records.text: Welcome to Cape City! It's got to be your first time here, huh? Want a tour?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/进入交易所/寒暄2
records.text: Feel free to ask me if you have any cravings. I'm the local foodie, after all!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/交谈/交易行情/交易行情1
records.text: The price of <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>'s <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> has been skyrocketing lately. Better not miss this opportunity, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/交谈/交易行情/交易行情2
records.text: Rumor has it that the price of <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> near the <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> has been plunging. Maybe it's a good time to get into it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/交谈/今日折扣情报/今日折扣情报1
records.text: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are on sale today! With such a good price, why not take some?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/交谈/特产情报（废弃）/特产情报1
records.text: 我们这儿的<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>在<color=#b45e01>{station}</color>卖得特别火爆，听说都快赶上硬通货了。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/交谈/特产情报（废弃）/特产情报2
records.text: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>？这可是个好东西啊……你要是有不妨考虑卖给我，在这里没人不喜欢。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/交谈/站点限定情报/情报1
records.text: If I'm being honest, I'm frankly more familiar with the popular restaurants in Gronru City, but Cape City has quite a few equally good ones too. They're so successful that the owners refuse to advertise. I'll tell you about them on the down-low next time!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/交谈/站点限定情报/情报2
records.text: If there's something you want to buy but you're not sure which to choose, try getting them all. Sometimes, nitpicking on which one's more suitable will make you miss out on many other stuff instead.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/买入/购买成功/购买成功1
records.text: Okay! I'll go get my apprentices to move the goods over for you!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/买入/购买页签/购买页签1
records.text: Don't hesitate to take a look around. All my stuff is top-tier.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/买入/取消购买/取消购买1
records.text: If you're not buying, I'm knocking off. Any second thoughts?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/买入/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: This price... is average, I guess!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/买入/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: I'm fine with that, but maybe you should double-check the price?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/买入/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: This price is quite a steal. You've got a keen eye!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/卖出/出售成功/出售成功1
records.text: Deal! Nice doing business with you, Conductor!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/卖出/出售页签/出售页签1
records.text: Cape City's market has been booming nowadays. How about you consider coming to do business alongside me?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/卖出/取消卖出/取消卖出1
records.text: If you're not in the mood to do business today, I can buy you a meal.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/卖出/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: Average, I guess. It'll do if you're simply trying to offload your inventory.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/卖出/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: Sure, I'm willing to pay a bit more!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/卖出/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: (sighs) This price won't be that good of a deal for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/议价/砍价成功/砍价成功1
records.text: (inhales sharply) Fine, I'll lower it a little more just for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/议价/砍价失败/砍价失败1
records.text: No way, I won't go any lower! Any more and I'll be making a loss!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/议价/抬价成功/抬价成功1
records.text: This is for the sake of our long-term partnership.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/议价/抬价失败/抬价失败1
records.text: In my opinion, what you brought isn't worth that high of a price...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/打开任务列表/打开任务列表1
records.text: Take your time to consider. The cup's empty, and I'll go get something to drink.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/打开任务列表/打开任务列表2
records.text: Let's see... Nothing, I'm just checking how long it is until I get off work.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面1
records.text: The work here isn't very interesting. It's still not too late to change my mind.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面2
records.text: Oh my... ouch... Just my shoulder acting up, don't mind me... ouch...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面3
records.text: As you can see, I'm swatting mosquitoes. With the world in such turmoil, how can these creatures still survive?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面4
records.text: You come here every other day. Even if I wanted to slack off, I didn't have the chance to.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面5
records.text: Whether it's work or idle chatter, I'll keep you company all the way. Everyone, feel free, as there are no rules here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面6
records.text: Here again? Put everything else aside, and play some cards with me first!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/交谈/交谈1
records.text: Let's have a few honest words. You've always thought I have alcohol in my cup, right? It's actually cactus beverage. I love beer, but ever since I got gout, well... sigh.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/交谈/交谈2
records.text: The president... the president is a good person, isn't she? All the young men and women in the COLUMBA respect her a lot. I'm sure you do too... Well, forget it. Forget about it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/交谈/交谈3
records.text: Sometimes I feel that I talk too much in front of you, but well, an old uncle like me rarely has someone to talk to, so forgive me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/交谈/交谈4-略低
records.text: I-I-I don't know how to say this, but I hear eerie cries occasionally late at night in Mander Mine... and I'm the only one who hears them! It's very scary, really scary...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/交谈/交谈5
records.text: I love the movie 'Chaos Remains: Alien Warfare Prehistoric Birch Creatures' a lot, but everyone else's reviews are negative. I wrote a rave review to the movie magazine before, and it was mistaken as a sponsored post.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/接受任务/接受任务1
records.text: Do your best. If you mess up, no one will say anything. After all, that's just how it is here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/接受任务/接受任务2
records.text: I used to be as energetic as you... but... let's not talk about it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/取消任务/取消任务1
records.text: Sigh. I understand. I understand very well! People always feel tired at some point.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/取消任务/取消任务2
records.text: Honestly, there aren't many people willing to do the work here...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/任务列表为空/任务列表为空1
records.text: It's good that young people are enthusiastic, but for an old uncle like me, my abilities are limited. Let's call it a day.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/巴克斯特/添加任务/成功1
records.text: Although I recommended it to you, it's just picking something slightly less terrible from a pile of rubbish. Don't expect too much.
The train has arrived at the station.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/波克普拉士/交谈/交谈2
records.text: Misappropriation of funds for self-upgrade? This is a serious accusation! Besides, upgrading is essential to maintain the city's operations efficiently!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/波克普拉士/交谈/交谈3
records.text: This device had both the Administrator Mode and the Guided Tour Mode. However, due to changes in our development plans, the Guided Tour Mode will now be available in the upcoming BOX units derivative models. These models may soon be unveiled. Just to clarify, this is not an advertisement! But if you have any questions or would like to make a reservation, please feel free to give us a call!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/波克普拉士/交谈/交谈4
records.text: Conductor, if you're interested in learning about the history of Freeport Ⅶ, I'm pleased to provide some insight. Here are stored official brief, folk brief, and a brief for underage users. Please feel free to choose the version that suits you best.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/波克普拉士/交谈/交谈5
records.text: It may come as a surprise, but I'm actually responsible for managing Freeport Ⅶ. We recommend a visit to Cape City to experience it!
Let's not let any past misunderstandings come between us. Since you're here, let's make the most of our time together.
Sincerity is a wonderful thing. With it, one can achieve a lot. With your dedication and support, Shoggolith will reciprocate it with equal sincerity.
I noticed that you have some connections with the Night Chains. Ah, please do not misunderstand. I don't want to intrude on your privacy, but it shows you have a unique charm, which is good.
I heard that you are interested in Mander Mine. In fact, it is an important place for Shoggolith's survival, and I have a soft spot for it, too. It's great that we have this in common.
Why do you always maintain such a formal demeanor? Did Mr. Heinrich 'advise' you to be so strict? He's always so strict with himself, but that is how he is. You could afford to relax a bit more.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/交谈/交谈1
records.text: Chatting? No worries — I get it. You're at an age where curiosity reigns supreme. I'll be mindful only to share information that is safe and appropriate for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/交谈/交谈2
records.text: Baxter is still as honest and boring as ever, so the simple and steady life suits him.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/交谈/交谈3
records.text: Don't think I'm harsh on my subordinates. People are never satisfied, and they only deserve this much from the level of effort they put in.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/交谈/交谈4
records.text: I'm not so patient with everyone. If I put on a friendly face for everyone, it would depreciate the value of such an expression. In other words, you're worth my warm welcome.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/交谈/交谈5
records.text: First impressions are important, so I always make sure my shoes are polished. It's not easy to maintain this in a place like this, you know?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/点击喝一杯/点击喝一杯1
records.text: There's only one type of beverage sold to Conductors here. Compared to other drinks, it can help you more.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/点击喝一杯/点击喝一杯1
records.text: You seem to really like the artisanal beverages. Does that mean I'm indispensable to you, Conductor~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/曼德矿场/点击喝一杯/点击喝一杯1
records.text: The Silver Branch Water gives a very nice feeling both in name and effect, doesn't it? I'm always ready to prepare it for you.

records.idCN: 商店/宠物店周刷倒计时
00NPC对话/铁安局/海因里希/交谈/交谈6-特殊
records.text: My wife called to ask me why the television couldn't be turned on anymore. I asked her if the plug had come loose. Indeed, that was the case when she checked on it.

records.idCN: 家园/鱼缸/是否需要保存
records.text: Do you want to save the fish tank edits?
You are fully energetic! Would you like another drink?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/进入/进入1
records.text: Welcome to "Flamingo Pet Shop." We sell pets, plants, fish, and relevant supplies.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/交谈/交谈3
records.text: Although we'll stay in touch, the shopkeeper has been away for a long while this time. Hasn't he found that important partner yet?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/浏览/买卖
records.text: Take your time to consider your purchase. Feel free to let me know if you need anything.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/浏览/宠物店
records.text: If you can't decide which one to take home, try interacting with them to get to know each other better. The shopkeeper once said, humans don't merely choose pets unilaterally — the final choice is mutual.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/浏览/植物店
records.text: Plants have always been popular for bringing peace and relaxation. They make wonderful decorations for train decorations, or great gifts for others.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/浏览/水族店
records.text: Aquariums filled with ornamental fish have also become a trendy interior decoration lately. Perhaps it offers a unique viewing experience for those who live on land.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/浏览/宠物用品
records.text: If you want to take good care of these living creatures, dedicated supplies are absolutely essential.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/进入/进入2
records.text: We've just restocked a batch of new goods in the shop. If you're interested, I can show you right away.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/进入/进入3
records.text: Welcome. You look quite busy. Would you like something to drink first, if you don't mind?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/进入/进入4
records.text: I've heard a few things about you. The owner of the shop next door said it's all thanks to you that our neighborhood has become much nicer than before.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/进入/进入5
records.text: I heard from the shop manager after a long while. He's never one to meddle in others' business, yet he specifically told me to treat you well. It really took me by surprise... though I already planned to do so anyway.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/进入/进入6
records.text: If you ever run into any troublesome matters, I'd be glad to lend you a hand. After all, my true occupation isn't shop assistant — I am a maid, especially skilled at all kinds of cleaning work, so please don't hesitate to ask if you need help.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/交谈/交谈2
records.text: You noticed I'm from the Empire? I see. Your assistant is my fellow countrywoman... We might even have met before. I've worked in the manors of many noble households, after all.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/交谈/交谈4
records.text: I wasn't originally good at taking care of living things. All my knowledge was taught to me by the shopkeeper. But just as a gem grows more beautiful with polishing, anything you're bad at can be mastered with constant practice.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/交谈/交谈1
records.text: All kinds of legends circulate across the Mundus Empire, and many have been distorted as they passed down by word of mouth. Ordinary people have very few ways to learn the truth. If you're interested, I could tell you the original versions of some tales when we get the chance.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/交谈/交谈5
records.text: ...Sorry, I zoned out just now. I was just wondering if the person who gave me my name is doing well now.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/交谈/交谈6

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/交谈/交谈7

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/修格里城/交谈/交谈8

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/交谈/交谈6
records.text: Can you call my name, Conductor? Tenderly or reproachfully. Both are fine.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/7号自由港/交谈/交谈7
records.text: Many people here are very grateful to Anita. After all, their research results have benefitted this city a lot. But... well, they did a decent job of covering their tracks, so I won't badmouth them~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/交谈/稀少交易品
records.text: There's no harm telling you this. <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> have been in short supply recently. All the store owners I know regret not stocking up more.
records.noDataString: Speaking of Shoggolith, their home appliances are a must-mention. I heard that even the television set in Heath Davis's house is produced by Shoggolith.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/进入交易所/寒暄1

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/进入交易所/寒暄3

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/进入交易所/寒暄2
records.text: What would you like to see? I can recommend some options.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/进入交易所/寒暄4
records.text: Have things been going smoothly lately? Your affairs are the talk of the town around here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/进入交易所/寒暄5
records.text: Oh dear, Conductor, would you like something to drink? Don't stand on ceremony. We rely on your patronage for business.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/进入交易所/寒暄6
records.text: Your visit truly brightens our day. Is there anything else you need me to keep an eye out for?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/采购券使用/采购券使用1

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/卖出/出售成功/出售成功1
records.text: Thank you for your patronage. Please come back again soon.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/买入/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: The prices can't be helped. You're well aware of the recent trends!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/卖出/出售页签/出售页签1
records.text: If you're looking to sell, we're happy to buy.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/卖出/取消卖出/取消卖出1

records.text: Processing the leftovers of Chaos Stones into decorations... I find it somewhat difficult to understand. Is there still a gap between me and real humans? But why do I feel a circuit heating up upon seeing Signora Medici's image?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/交谈/交谈6
records.text: I've heard you're quite proactive, and I don't mind that. After all, being complacent won't help when crises strike suddenly. Ha, just be careful not to get burned.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/交谈/交谈7
records.text: BOX on your train seems quite unique, but in the end, a robot is still a robot...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/交谈/交谈99
records.text: First impressions are important, so I always make sure my shoes are polished. It's not easy to maintain this in a place like this, you know?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/彼得黄/交谈/交谈8
records.text: Those refugees chose to live in such a desolate place and oppose me. I really don't understand what they're thinking. It's just like that... no, it's nothing.

There has always been a close relationship between Shoggolith and Mander Mine, and I also care about the mine's development. Unfortunately, I'm unable to spare any more time. As luck would have it, Peter is an excellent manager. If you're willing to support Mander Mine like you support Shoggolith, I believe he'll treat you well.

I firmly believe it's rash to assess a COLUMBA's strength solely on its current scale. Sometimes, I prefer to support those with more growth potential in exchange for long-term and substantial returns. You should understand, considering your investment in Shoggolith serves a similar purpose.

I've heard that your capable assistant, Miss Livia, has a strong liking for the city's black tea. As a token of gratitude for your generous contributions, would you like my staff to deliver some to your train? ... You're asking how I know this? I join those bosses for afternoon tea some times, that's all.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/卖出/宠物
records.text: Let me confirm once more — you're sending this little one back, correct? Understood, no need to feel awkward. Given your busy, traveling work schedule, it's perfectly understandable. Please accept this refund.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/卖出/植物
records.text: The weather in Shoggolith City is indeed more suitable for its growth. I'll take proper care of it, and here is your refund.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/奥莉薇恩/卖出/水族
records.text: Though they have a pleasing appearance, many customers have mentioned that keeping them healthy is quite difficult. Per our store regulations, we will refund you a portion of the payment. If you need it later, I'd be happy to explain some care tips to you in detail.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Hello, nice to see you again, Conductor of The Eternal.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: Thank you, for your continuous efforts, toward the reconstruction of the ONEderland.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: We meet again, Conductor. Here to help, are you?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: Welcome, Conductor of The Eternal. I hope you will, continue to assist, in the construction of the ONEderland.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: (Yelling) Rock 'n' Roll!! (Normal voice) This is what, Peter Hwang, taught me. You don't buy it? Fine.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: You truly are, Conductor, making significant contributions, to the reconstruction of the ONEderland. I've upgraded your system rating, to the highest level.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开关卡/文本1
records.text: Please have a look. This is the latest registered combat mission.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开关卡/文本2
records.text: Guarding the ONEderland, is the mission of all Nugget Mechs. Would you like, to share this mission, with us? Alright, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开关卡/文本3
records.text: Please choose, the task that suits you best. As for the rest, you can leave them to me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开关卡/文本4
records.text: Although I, can solve some things, not everything can be resolved. Many times, I have to rely on humans.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开关卡/文本5
records.text: Destroyers, are unforgivable. The act of destroying the ONEderland is unforgivable!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开交货/文本1
records.text: What, new and interesting goods, did you bring? The ONEderland, needs fresh supplies.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开交货/文本2
records.text: Checking the carriage's damage. Enjoy some free time now.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开交货/文本3
records.text: Checking the cargo labels and contents... Safety confirmed.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/打开交货/文本4
records.text: Checking the damage to the target miner... This, is a joke. Because, I am a Nugget Mech. I can't check humans. Some say, having a sense of humor, is important.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/成功交付/文本1
records.text: Thank you, for your contribution, to the construction of the ONEderland.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/成功交付/文本2
records.text: Thank you... Yes, this is part of, the initial programming. If you need, new lines, use more computational resources. That's quite tiring.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/成功交付/文本3
records.text: These goods can revitalize the ONEderland! Bring vitality back to our home! ... How does, that sound? Not quite right? Very well, I will, process it again.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/成功交付/文本4
records.text: The order has been delivered. Do you feel, delighted, Conductor? I hope you're happy.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/交谈/文本1
records.text: Don't you think, the ONEderland is, gradually becoming more beautiful? I hope your answer is, yes.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/交谈/文本2
records.text: The other Nugget Mechs, are my subordinates. "Brethren"? No, they and Gold, are not siblings. Robots, don't have siblings.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/交谈/文本3
records.text: I, like the aurora, very much. The time, without reality stabilizer, without people, without aurora, isn't good...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/交谈/文本4
records.text: Peter Hwang said, when my programming runs into errors, I speak in a frightening manner. But, I don't remember at all. Is it, really scary?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/交谈/文本5
records.text: In the past, there was, a superstar, who sang in the bar at the ONEderland. My memory is damaged, unable to retrieve, who it was. Only remember, the song title &*%! Until the ￥#% End.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/放弃/文本1
records.text: I also feel that this order, isn't really good.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/放弃/文本2
records.text: Accidentally, blew off, good business. Such cases, happened frequently, twenty years ago. However, Conductor, you probably won't.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/放弃/文本3
records.text: Be careful, in examining, the order details. Be wary, of being deceived.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/放弃/文本4
records.text: Shoo. Shoo shoo. This is the simulated sound, of an order flying away.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/放弃/文本5
records.text: Selecting orders, that better suit, your requirements...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/标记/文本1
records.text: Ding ding! Added it, to the to-do list.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/标记/文本2
records.text: Please register this order, in your database... For humans, what is a database?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/取消标记/文本1
records.text: Ding ding! This item, has been deleted, from the to-do list.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/金子小姐/取消标记/文本4

00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/进入交易所/寒暄1
records.text: Hello, young one. The fact that you walked in here means you have good taste. After all, what I sell can't be found elsewhere.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/进入交易所/寒暄2
records.text: A new face, huh? Have a look around. What I have here are high-tech gadgets, sure to broaden your horizons.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/进入交易所/寒暄3
records.text: Admirable diligence you have there. I've met plenty of conductors, but you seem to really be capable of making a name for yourself.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/进入交易所/寒暄4
records.text: So, you're the one who's been rather famous lately, right? You have the energy I had when I was young. Come here often. I don't mind sharing some business experience with you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/进入交易所/寒暄5
records.text: Ah, it's you. Haven't seen you for a while. Any news from elsewhere? Tell me about it. In return, I can give you some special discounts.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/进入交易所/寒暄6
records.text: Ah, an honored guest is here. Take your time, sit down and try this chocolate milk first. It's a unique recipe, not available anywhere else!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/交谈/交易行情/交易行情1
records.text: Word has it that a stable supplier at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> is closing down their business, so <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> have become a top seller there lately.
records.noDataString: This station is rumored to have lots of weirdos, but if you ask me, that's just nonsensical. They're simply a bunch of people not understood by the world.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/交谈/交易行情/交易行情2
records.text: Don't run around aimlessly. If you still have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>, go sell them at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>. My insider news is never wrong!
records.noDataString: They say that the acting station master, or is it the director, has created some kind of new invention again and wants you to go over.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/买入/购买页签/购买页签1
records.text: What's the phrase? Act quickly if you want to buy! I only have these for now, and once they're gone, you won't be able to get them even if you want to.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/买入/购买页签/购买页签2
records.text: Today's <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are on a time-limited discount! I occasionally do promotions to attract customers.
records.noDataString: How do you say that word? Buy now while supplies last! This is all I have for now; once it's out of stock, you won't be able to buy it even if you want to.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/买入/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: If you want it, grab it now. If you come any later, you won't find a single one.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/买入/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: Hmm, I appreciate your directness. Straightforward people are always especially welcomed in business, you know.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/买入/选择商品/选择原价商品1
00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/买入/购买成功/购买成功1
00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/买入/取消购买/取消购买1
records.text: At least you didn't waste too much of my research time, and I have to say, being cautious when buying things is not a flaw.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/卖出/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: Hmm, pretty standard. I do accept it here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/商品交易上限/商品交易上限1
records.text: Well, you've cleared my inventory. Considering your generosity, I'll save some good stuff for you next time.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/采购券使用/采购券使用1
records.text: You're quite sharp. To be honest, I still have some stock. I'll bring it out for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/卖出/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: Not bad, you've become smarter after spending time with me. You're the sum of people you spend the most time with!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/卖出/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: Whoa, this thing isn't worth that much now.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/卖出/出售页签/出售页签1
records.text: Instead of running around to other places, why not sell it to me? I'll give you this amount.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/卖出/出售页签/出售页签2
records.text: If you have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> right now, I can buy it all.
records.noDataString: Instead of running around elsewhere, why not sell it to me? I'll offer you this amount.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/卖出/取消卖出/取消卖出1
records.text: If this is your final decision, then so be it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/卖出/出售成功/出售成功1
records.text: Our cooperation looks worthy of long-term development, doesn't it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/议价/砍价成功/砍价成功1
records.text: Take it, but bring me any new and exciting goods first in the future.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/议价/砍价失败/砍价失败1
records.text: You won't find a better price anywhere else.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/议价/抬价成功/抬价成功1
records.text: Young people are rather stubborn nowadays. The price I gave is very reasonable, but, let's go with what you asked for.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/议价/抬价失败/抬价失败1
records.text: The price quoted has already been adjusted to account for our friendship.

00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Did you bring materials? New mission? New research opportunity? ...Or just yourself?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: I don't understand why I'm the one negotiating with you... Do they think we're close?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: From what I can see, you've established a good working relationship with Anita Energy Institute. But you can still go further. I'm sure of it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: I've received your inventory list and report. It looks good... Alright, let's get to work.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: Among all the visitors who've been here, you're the most pleasing one I've met.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: It's fine if you just brought yourself today. Have a seat. I'll have them prepare some mashed potatoes for dinner tonight.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开关卡/文本1
records.text: I hope you can complete these tasks and bring back combat data for me. It'll help immensely with the progress of the experiment.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开关卡/文本2
records.text: Transporting Chaos Remain carcasses... though difficult, it isn't impossible, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开关卡/文本3
records.text: Inactive Chaos Remains can become valuable research materials. I prefer not to describe them as "dead" as it's neither scientific nor accurate.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开关卡/文本4
records.text: Want me to lend you my weapon? It can be adjusted to lethal mode.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开关卡/文本5
records.text: I didn't submit this combat mission, but the objective is clear. Just eliminate everything.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开交货/文本1
records.text: Oh... Did you bring anything valuable, or goods meant for me?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开交货/文本2
records.text: Is there anything interesting in Bonfire Cities? Oh, we have some new plushies?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开交货/文本3
records.text: When can I have the Eternal as the exclusive transport for my experimental supplies... Although the current capacity meets the needs, I have higher requirements.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/打开交货/文本4
records.text: There are canned potatoes in the supplies this time. I can exchange Anita's high-quality rations for them, two for one.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/成功交付/文本1
records.text: This should be helpful for research...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/成功交付/文本2
records.text: Let's see — no goods for me? Looks like I'll have to head to town myself next time... Never mind. Better to let someone else do it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/成功交付/文本3
records.text: Thank you... What's wrong? You think I shouldn't thank you?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/成功交付/文本4
records.text: I'm busy writing the conclusion for an experiment. Just leave the items in the unloading area... You, come here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/交谈/文本1
records.text: Look, newly bought plushie, very cute, right? Just have a look, but don't touch it. I want to keep hugging it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/交谈/文本2
records.text: Sound of arguments? It's just noise from outside. Don't mind it. As long as you're here with me, you won't be affected.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/交谈/文本3
records.text: My relationship with the others from Anita... We have no relationship. Huh? I mean it. Why the weird expression?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/交谈/文本4
records.text: There's no skill in playing Sudoku. It's just training the lowest-level logic to become a subconscious response, then deducing with your own brain. It's a piece of cake for me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/交谈/文本5
records.text: My weapon's power output is controllable. While greater destructive power might be more efficient, sometimes excessive power would only destroy the target...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/放弃/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/放弃/文本2
records.text: Need me to help you pick a new one? I'll be as enthusiastic as when buying plushies.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/放弃/文本3
00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/放弃/文本4
records.text: Next... Didn't I say the exact same thing during battle?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/放弃/文本5
records.text: I'll provide you with opportunities that suit you. Don't miss out.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/标记/文本1
records.text: Correct judgment. You should be well prepared beforehand.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/标记/文本2
records.text: Ready to set off? I'll go back to the lab to continue the research. See you next time.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/标记/文本3
records.text: Looks like you don't need my meddling. Off you go.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/标记/文本4
records.text: You actually remember the senders and recipients of these orders? Impressive. I don't remember any of them... Oh, that's supposed to be someone I know?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/标记/文本5
records.text: If need be, I'll board the Eternal with you... Oh, not this time. This project is quite urgent.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/取消标记/文本1
records.text: You're pretty good at arranging the schedule.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/取消标记/文本2
records.text: Though I'm not sure what a conductor's job entails... But, very well, I'll go along with you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/取消标记/文本3
records.text: Great, since you're not in a hurry to finish your work, come assist me instead.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/取消标记/文本4
records.text: Hmm? Decided to help me make the trip?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/妮蔻拉/取消标记/文本5
records.text: Oh yeah, I have a sudden idea... You'll assist me executing it, right?

00NPC对话/列车武器/苔妮/交谈/文本2
records.text: You came at the right time. Can you help me figure out what these lines even mean? ...Wait, you're telling me this is junior high history? How am I supposed to know that? I never even paid attention in history class!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/列车武器/苔妮/交谈/文本3
records.text: Fighting is such a pain. All that matters is your firepower. Why overthink it?!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/列车武器/苔妮/交谈/文本4
records.text: Do you want to see Margaret's photo? What? She's not my pet—she's my most important friend! Look, she that teddy bear in the photo. Cute, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/列车武器/苔妮/交谈/文本5
records.text: I get so annoyed watching people do things so slowly, I feel like just doing it for them myself!
Earn profits to boost your trade level, which increases Bargain range and trade efficiency.
Raising local Reputation can increase the number of Bargain attempts, success rates, and the quantity of goods purchased in a single transaction, improving trade efficiency.
Certain crew members' profession skills can increase the number of Bargain attempts, success rates, and the quantity of goods purchased in a single transaction, improving trade efficiency.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/列车武器/苔妮/进入/文本1
records.text: This is the Train Weapon Factory under Anita. I'm Tennie, the person in charge. All technical support provided here complies with BCRL regulations... at least the public ones do!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/列车武器/苔妮/交谈/文本1
records.text: Ugh, those stiff-necked BCRL guys are always banning this and banning that! What's so fun about "safe" stuff anyway?!
