淘金票价/投资/1奖励文本1
00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/进入交易所/寒暄1
records.text: It's not every day that we get conductors who are willing to come to this godforsaken place. I've got to be a good host and take care of you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/进入交易所/寒暄2
records.text: Did you come across anything fun while on the road? Aha, I have to keep up with the times too.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/进入交易所/寒暄3
records.text: Ah, you're here. I was just working out. How about you try a hand at Tai Chi with me before we talk shop?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/进入交易所/寒暄4
records.text: The secret to doing business? Nope, no clue. At my age, I've long fallen behind the times.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/进入交易所/寒暄5
records.text: Money is simply worldly possessions... But you're still young, so being a little driven is all right. You impress me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/进入交易所/寒暄6
records.text: What doesn't lie is the honest work one has done. I see it all. You are undoubtedly destined for greater endeavors.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/交易行情/交易行情1
records.text: If I have to name a place that <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> have been selling out like hot cakes in recent times, it can only be <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>.
records.noDataString: Oh, this place? It used to be where Anita did their aerospace research. But it's likely still a ways to go before their experiment works out...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/交易行情/交易行情2
records.text: The market price of <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> has plummeted. Those people who stocked up to sell there are most likely regretting their life choices now.
records.noDataString: I'm here simply for the peace and quiet. The testing ground is too noisy? (chuckles) I mean peace from people problems.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/采购券使用/采购券使用1
records.text: I remember there are some left... Hang on.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/买入/购买成功/购买成功1
records.text: Thank you for your patronage. Come again soon.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/买入/购买页签/购买页签1
records.text: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are on sale today. Consider stocking up.
records.noDataString: You'll always find something you like, so why not buy it now instead of waiting until tomorrow?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/买入/购买页签/购买页签2
records.text: There will always be goods you like. If you don't buy them today, you'll eventually buy them tomorrow, so why not take advantage of the present and buy them now?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/买入/取消购买/取消购买1
records.text: This always happens — adding something in the shopping cart and then suddenly losing the desire to buy it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/买入/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: Not bad. Many people rush around and end up just going for something average.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/买入/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/买入/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: That's right. Sales are meant to make you buy.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/卖出/出售成功/出售成功1
records.text: Be sure to maintain our cooperation in the future as well.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/卖出/出售页签/出售页签1
records.text: If you have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>, consider selling them to me. I can offer you a better price than usual.
records.noDataString: Don't worry. There's a price to everything.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/卖出/出售页签/出售页签2
records.text: Don't worry, no matter what it is, it always has some value.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/卖出/取消卖出/取消卖出1
records.text: Prefer to keep it for yourself?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/卖出/选择商品/选择原价商品1
00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/卖出/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: This is exactly what the market urgently needs.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/卖出/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/商品交易上限/商品交易上限1
records.text: The shelves and warehouse are empty. Come back tomorrow!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/议价/砍价成功/砍价成功1
records.text: Let's settle on this price this time!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/议价/砍价失败/砍价失败1
records.text: I'm really sorry, but we can't lower the price any further.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/议价/抬价成功/抬价成功1
records.text: No worries. A few extra bucks don't make much difference.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/议价/抬价失败/抬价失败1
records.text: Even if you ask around, other places won't offer more than this.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/上限/上限1
records.text: Ahhh, it's not enough... I really want to drink till you puke, Conductor...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/喝饮料/喝饮料1
records.text: You just downed it? Aren't you worried that it might be spiked? ...Just kidding, even if there is something, it would only be something beneficial.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/交谈/交谈1
records.text: That surveillance camera is a bit of an eyesore, but it's generous in sharing information, so I turn a blind eye~ At least it's more easy-going on the eye than that sneaky guy.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/交谈/交谈2
records.text: There are many pests eyeing you, Conductor. Take good care of yourself when I'm not around.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/交谈/交谈3
records.text: Be extra cautious with your diet, Conductor. Some people with ill intentions might target you. But you can always trust me. I would never harm you~!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/交谈/交谈4
records.text: The headquarters of that game company is right here. Have you seen their success, Conductor? Sure enough, people would rather indulge in the loveliness of the virtual world than face the harsh reality.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/交谈/交谈5
records.text: Conductor, are you thinking that 10 Rounds' headquarters is the CDCA Bureau's biggest secret? In truth, there are more interesting things kept under here that just might be way livelier than the resorts aboveground.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/交谈/交谈6
records.text: Have you grown fonder of me, Conductor? Ah... just feeling like it's time for the next stage, so I wanted to ask... hehe...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/交谈/交谈7
records.text: I heard someone claiming to be your nemesis has been pestering you, Conductor. If you need help, just let me know! As a member of Night Chains, Arina is quite skilled in certain methods~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/交谈/交谈8
records.text: Would you like to try our drink-mixing service? If you're curious, come a little closer~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/进入/进入1
records.text: Meeting in this city feels nice, right, Conductor?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/浏览/浏览1
records.text: Or would you like to see Arina's private collection? The kind that's only offered to you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/浏览/浏览2
records.text: I already guessed what you would choose because I know you all too well.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/澄明数据中心/点击喝一杯/点击喝一杯1
records.text: Enjoy, Conductor~ Oh my, I just touched the Conductor's hand. I'm so happy, and I feel a bit warm all over~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/打开任务列表/打开任务列表1
records.text: Go on and choose. I still see some potential to squeeze out of you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/打开任务列表/打开任务列表2
records.text: Heh, do you need to think for so long? Just do it. Go and fight for it. Hesitation will only let opportunities slip away.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/打开商会界面/打开商会界面1
records.text: Hmm? Why are you standing there dumbfounded?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/打开商会界面/打开商会界面2
records.text: You're managing the handover work rather well. What? You don't think I'll change my opinion of you just like that, do you? Hahahahaha, that's hilarious!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/打开商会界面/打开商会界面3
records.text: You're only rewarded when you put in the effort. As long as you can prove your worth, I'll do anything for you, whether it's serving you tea or showering you with all sorts of praises. If you can't, then disappear as soon as possible. Don't embarrass yourself~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/打开商会界面/打开商会界面4
records.text: There are too many Conductors like you. I'm under no obligations to greet each of you, right? But to have persisted to this extent, you're already a bit better than useless fools.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/打开商会界面/打开商会界面5
records.text: Oh my, oh my? You're more capable than I imagined.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/打开商会界面/打开商会界面6
records.text: A heartfelt welcome to you, Conductor {playername}. I, Reizia, will do my best to serve you — Not used to it? But this is what you deserve. I keep my word.

If you want, I can occasionally reserve very profitable orders for you or make things convenient in other ways. Of course, these don't come free. You'll need to compensate in some way — such as the latest product from Night Chains Lesage.

Ah, you probably think I'm a very opportunistic woman. I don't deny that. However, it also means I'm reliable because I'm driven by profit. People who are easily swayed by emotions are the hardest to control.

I greet people who can make me profit with a smile and treat those who can't with a cold face. By following this principle, you can quickly filter out the quality resources that will help you grow. I hope you're among the former, otherwise, our conversation is just a waste of time.

Someone dares to compare my style to that peasant woman from Freeport Ⅶ? Haha, that's the worst joke I've ever heard! How can that rustic woman compare? Besides, she's too weak to accomplish anything significant.

Everyone in the COLUMBA respects Signora Medici, and I naturally don't deny her abilities. I just think their praise can sometimes be too misguided. One day, I will... ah, never mind, it's not the right time to say it yet.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/接受任务/接受任务1
records.text: Yes, yes, work hard and fully utilize your limited value~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/接受任务/接受任务2
records.text: That's the way it should be~ Otherwise, what's the use of being a Conductor?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/取消任务/取消任务1
records.text: Ha... you're only at this level.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/取消任务/取消任务2
00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/任务列表为空/任务列表为空1
records.text: Good, good. Seize every opportunity you can get. Don't leave any behind. You're a good kid~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/雷齐娅/添加任务/成功1
records.text: Based on my analysis, this order will maximize your value. Hehehe, you can trust my judgment when it comes to this.

records.idCN: 开车相关/战斗不能返航
00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/交谈/交谈1
records.text: My daily life isn't very different from others. There are definitely things I'm not used to... but I'll push myself adapt. No worries.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/交谈/交谈2
records.text: I'm like meat quite a lot... well, I'll stop talking, otherwise I might scare people. I only like well done meat, don't mistake me for a real wolf.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/交谈/交谈3
records.text: I've attracted some strange looks, but there are also many willing to believe in me. That's why I'm standing here talking to you. Who knows if we are the fools or they are... still the world is sometimes driven by a foolish persistence.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/交谈/交谈4
records.text: I heard there are ancient ruins underground here. Wanna to excavate them? What kind of...? I don't know, and that's exactly why I'm encouraging you to do it!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/交谈/交谈5
records.text: Thanks to Mr. Heinrich's guarantee, I was able to stay with the BCRL Agency. Appearing penniless and under suspicious circumstances... hahaha, if I had been an officer back then, I would have immediately thrown my past self into a temporary holding cell.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/进入/进入1
records.text: Just call me Lycagia. Let's make this clear, don't give me any random nicknames. Werewolf is definitely unacceptable.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/进入/进入2
records.text: Oh! You're here. I won't suddenly take off my mask and turn back into a human. Rest assured.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/进入/进入3
records.text: The BCRL Agency's duty is... I'll skip the rules and regulations. You already know them.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/进入/进入4
records.text: I prefer taking the field myself... but I can't lead the team out of the city alone every day. So I'll need to rely on you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/进入/进入5
records.text: Things have improved a lot since you've started coming here often. So, will you come again?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/进入/进入6
records.text: How have you been lately? Do you miss your wolf buddy... Of course, we are friends! Even if you call me werewolf now, I won't beat you up.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/浏览/浏览1
records.text: Knowing your limits is important, but I believe you have unlimited potential! Someone said the same to me back then.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/铁安局/莱卡吉亚/浏览/浏览2
records.text: All the tasks here are important, but... I still suggest you start with what you're best at, otherwise, they'll just pile up unfinished.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/摩尔/成功投资/成功投资4
records.text: I see. This is how you handled the investment... I'll make a detailed record.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/摩尔/成功投资/成功投资2
records.text: It's a wonderful thing to receive your investment. I feel I've gained something more valuable than money.
Don't be fooled by my appearance. I also experience joy, anger, sorrow, and happiness. When I'm feeling down, I repeatedly think about the times we shared, which quickly lifts my spirits.
Although I don't mind your opinion of me, I'll answer since you asked: I have no other intentions toward you. I'm satisfied with just observing you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/摩尔/成功投资/成功投资1
records.text: How did you get this number into the data center's official account? I saw it clearly.
Dear <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>, the number of times we've met has risen to an exhilarating figure, hasn't it? Oh, I certainly don't get tired of it. I never will.
It's indeed more pleasant to meet you here. Although I've been trying to observe you elsewhere, it's a bit troublesome.
Yes, I've heard about your activities here. After all, I've been watching you.
<color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>, I think it's time to close the distance between us — I want to observe you more closely. Please, don't step back, I absolutely won't harm you.
It's great to see you again, <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>. If there's anything better than this, it's being able to see you all the time.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/摩尔/成功投资/成功投资3
records.text: The money can be used to expand the computer's data capacity. After all, the folder named <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color> has taken up all the storage space. It's just a little joke, of course. I wouldn't misuse the City Hall's account money for personal use.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/摩尔/货币不足/货币不足1
records.text: Unfortunately, the City Hall's account only accepts sufficient currency and nothing else. It's quite unromantic. Don't you think?

There are many interesting subjects to observe at the CDCA Bureau. By general moral standards, some might not be considered likeable. But it's their unique personalities that make them valuable to observe.
You seem curious about my appearance, but if you ask why I look like this... it's simply because I want to. I wanted to observe you better, so I took on this form. Is this reason satisfactory?
How deep can I see? That's a very interesting question, but I can honestly tell you that my head doesn't have X-ray vision.

Perhaps you're curious why I'm so persistent in calling your name, but it's not hard to understand. I see you for who you are, beyond just your title of Conductor. There are many Conductors, but only one dear <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>.
Hello, my dear <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>. From the moment you arrived at the CDCA Bureau, I've been eagerly awaiting your visit.
Regarding my attitude, some people are suspicious, some are fearful, some are curious... but I don't care what you think of me, as long as I can watch you all.

Let's chat some more, my <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>. As for why I say 'my', it's because my view of you is different from others'. But it's the same for everyone else, as the same object appears differently to each person. Everyone can consider you theirs.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/摩尔/成功投资/成功投资5
records.text: This is indeed a generous number. I'm deeply grateful for the honor of witnessing your magnanimity.

records.text: Taxation during buying and selling will increase the local Reputation.
Constructing and loading freight cars can significantly increase cargo capacity, enhancing trade efficiency.
The selling price of goods is influenced by transportation distance and city preferences.
Selling local goods within the same area will halve the selling price; it is not recommended to sell local goods locally.
Market prices are influenced by the trading activities of conductors.
The procurement cost of picked up goods from lost cargo is zero.

records.idCN: 帮助/乘客帮助/1乘客帮助标题
帮助/客运帮助/招揽乘客内容
records.text:
1.传单及广告投放券用于在指定地点招揽乘客，将乘客运送至目的地，从而获取客运收益。\n\n

2.派发传单时，需要先选择目的地，后选择派发地点，不同地点招揽的乘客，具有不同的喜好和消费能力。\n\n

3.使用广告投放券时，需要先选择目的地，后选择投放渠道，不同渠道招揽的乘客，具有不同的喜好和消费能力。\n\n

4.招揽乘客的数量受到目的地距离的影响。

records.idCN: 帮助/乘客帮助/乘客收益内容
records.text:
1.列车评分可在营运总览里查询，具有8个指标：\n
舒适度，清洁度，美味评分，娱乐评分，宠物评分，水族评分，绿植评分，医疗评分\n\n

2.各项评分根据相关车载家具装饰等情况获得。\n\n

3.乘客会根据列车评分情况进行消费，客运收益将于到站时统一结算。\n
例如：喜好水族的乘客更容易在水族评分高的列车上消费。\n
例如：偏爱舒适的老年乘客更容易在舒适度和医疗评分高的列车上消费。\n\n

4.车载家具可在商会的列车家具商店购买获得。

records.idCN: 帮助/客运帮助/传单获取内容
records.text:
1.每日5:00可以获得免费的传单，工作日50张，节假日100张。\n\n

2.传单可以加印，每周数量限定250张，每周一5:00重置。\n\n

3.传单存放上限为450张。\n\n

4.广告投放券可在休息区的黑月商店购买获得。

records.idCN: 帮助/商会帮助/商会帮助页签
帮助/交易所帮助/交易基础内容
records.text:
低买高卖，是赚取利润的核心。
寻找低价行情交易品砍价买入，寻找卖出行情高的贸易地点抬价卖出，获得超额投资回报。
特产交易品往往利润更高，适当使用进货采买书，买入更多特产获得更大利润。
交易品单次购买库存有限，需要去别的城市往返一次才会刷新，想要在当地连续采购某种交易品，可以使用进货采买书刷新交易品库存。
交易品的每日库存总量有限，每日5:00刷新。
本地交易品如在本地卖出，卖出价格将会减半，不建议在本地出售本地交易品。
投资城市可以解锁当地高价值交易品的贸易许可，提高贸易效益。
买入卖出时的纳税，都会提高当地的城市声望。
提高当地的城市声望，可以增加交易所的讲价次数，成功率和单次买入交易品的数量，提高贸易效益。

records.idCN: 帮助/交易所帮助/交易基础标题
帮助/商会帮助/商会帮助内容
records.text:
1. The guild orders have three types: cargo orders, purchase orders, and passenger orders.

2. Cargo orders require cargo capacity to accept. Transport the target cargo to the destination to complete.

3. Purchase orders require going to the Trading Center to purchase the corresponding Goods and sell them at the objective Trading Center to complete.

4. Passenger orders require having available passenger seats to accept. Transport the passengers to the destination to complete.

5. Guild orders refresh at 5AM daily, replenishing up to the limit.

6. Using an Order Request, you can immediately gain one guild order.

7. The guild's Furniture Store allows you to purchase onboard furniture to improve train ratings. The furniture sold by COLUMBA in different cities will have regional differences.

records.idCN: 帮助/交易所帮助/议价基础内容
records.text:
交易品买入之前可进行砍价，卖出之前可进行抬价。
议价成功率受城市声望、角色生活技能以及抬价次数影响。
抬价次数越多，成功率越低。单次交易结束后，成功率重置。
议价幅度受贸易等级、角色生活技能影响。
议价次数用完后，可以使用再交涉请求书重新议价。
赚取利润提升贸易等级，可以增加议价幅度，提高贸易效益。
一些护卫乘员的生活技能，可以增加交易所的讲价次数，成功率和单次买入交易品的数量，提高贸易效益。

records.idCN: 帮助/交易所帮助/议价基础标题
帮助/交易所帮助/行情标题
帮助/交易所帮助/行情内容
records.text:
交易品名字下方的百分比数字标记了当前交易品的行情。
灰色100%表示行情处于市场原价，红色80%则代表买入或者卖出价格低于市场原价，为原价的80%，绿色120%则代表买入价格或者卖出价格高于市场原价。
交易品的卖出价格，会受到运输距离和城市喜好的影响。
交易品行情会受到来往列车长们交易活动的影响。
当连接城市的行车段发生形态污染事件时，运输断链造成物资紧缺，当地交易所的行情也会受到影响。

records.idCN: 帮助/交易所帮助/小贴士标题
帮助/交易所帮助/小贴士内容
records.text:
遗失货物中拾取的交易品的进货成本为零。
建造并装载货厢可以大幅提高载货量，提高贸易效益。
售价高的交易品，砍价抬价之后，有更高的利润空间。
提高列车的速度，可以在行情来的时候提高贸易效率。
行情好的时候，适当进货采买书，买入更多低价交易品获得更大利润。
卖出价格行情不好的时候，可以将交易品暂存在当地的私人仓库，周转更加灵活。

records.idCN: 帮助/餐饮帮助/餐饮帮助页签
帮助/餐饮帮助/餐饮帮助内容
records.text:
1.这里是每个城市的特色打卡店。邀请队员体验后，队员们可以在战斗中获得默契加成，同时列车长可以获得“激情驾驶，Passion！”加成。


2.在吧台的招待NPC处查看该店铺的菜单，选择项目并邀请你的队员参与。


3.菜单分为双人套餐和团队套餐。其中，双人套餐为，列车长邀请1位队员参与。团队套餐为，列车长邀请团队队员参与，但不能超过最大编队人数5人。


4.每位角色对套餐的喜好程度不同。邀请队员时，他们脸上的表情代表自己的喜好倾向。如果选到了他们特别喜欢的套餐，会激发队员斗志，在战斗中获得更高的默契加成！


5.列车长一同体验后，可以获得“激情驾驶，Passion！”加成。效果为列车最高时速的提升，或者列车的刹车和加速性能提升，这将大大提高列车在城市间穿梭的速度！


6.价格更贵的套餐，会更受大家的喜爱，获得的加成提升也会更多。


7.所有加成持续时间为30分钟。


8.列车长可以连续邀请不同的队员体验，“激情驾驶，Passion！”的效果以最新一次为准。而同一队员无法连续体验，必须在获得的默契加成效果结束后，才可以再次体验。

帮助/污染帮助/污染指数标题
帮助/污染帮助/污染指数内容
records.text:
1.行车区域发生共振形态污染时，区域内的桦树生物和深眠者会异常活跃，此时导航地图会将该区域的污染指数进行标记。


2.污染指数分为12个等级：

<color=#92d050>1~3</color>级指数标记为<color=#92d050>绿色</color>，<color=#f8e71c>4~6</color>级指数标记为<color=#f8e71c>黄色</color>，
<color=#f88825>7~9</color>级指数标记为<color=#f88825>橙色</color>，<color=#de3c36>10~12</color>级指数标记为<color=#de3c36>红色</color>。

污染指数越高，区域内的桦树生物和深眠者越加凶险。遇袭事件的发生频率也会越高。


3.发生形态污染时，请根据污染指数合理规划行车路线，量力而行。


4.当发生10~12级污染时，区域内将处于严重污染，请避开污染区，或者加强列车安保力量。


5.发生形态污染事件时，运输断链造成物资紧缺，附近交易所的行情也会受到影响。


6.因为通行受阻，污染区域的遗失货物也会随污染指数增多。

records.idCN: 帮助/污染帮助/车损与报案内容
records.text:
1.行车遭遇袭击，护卫队员迎击失败后，列车将会损失耐久，同时损失一定数量的铁盟币和货物，有时甚至乘客也会失踪。


2.迎击失败后，可进行铁安局报案处理，你可以在最近的铁安局的案件处理中找到此次案件，主动出击清缴并找回失物。


3.无力处理案件时，也可发布案件至全网，悬赏让好心人士帮忙找回失物。


4.遭遇多次袭击，列车耐久度降为0时，会造成列车损毁，此时列车将无法继续前进。


5.列车损毁时，可以呼叫铁盟24小时付费救援拖车服务，列车将会被拖回出发站点。


6.列车损毁拖回站点后，需要在列车整备间进行修理才可以继续启程。


7.威慑度：威慑度越高，遇到拦路劫匪事件的概率越低。


8.谐响度：谐响度越高，遇到拦路桦树生物及深眠者事件的概率越低。

帮助/污染帮助/混响浮标内容
records.text:
1.有时会在污染区内发现巨大的【混响浮标】，它是造成污染事件的主要原因之一。


2.主动打击【混响浮标】，可以降低【混响浮标】的污染度，该区域的污染指数也会随之下降。

同时可以获得【赴命奖章】和【绝命奖章】等大量资源。

打击【桦树浮标】和【行车沿线桦树生物】也可以降低该区域的污染指数。


3.【混响浮标】的污染度降为0时，该区域的形态污染会随之消失，当然这需要众多列车长齐心协力才可以达成。


4.在导航地图上可以随时查看【混响浮标】的坐标。

records.idCN: 帮助/污染帮助/异构厄枝内容
records.text:
1. [Heteromorphyes] may occasionally appear along train route, attracting large numbers of Deep Sleepers and Chaos Remains, threatening transportation safety.

2. By eliminating [Heteromorphyes], Conductors will receive rare resources, as well as [Duty Medals] awarded by BCRL Agency.

3. When the eradication progress of a [Heteromorphy] reaches 100%, that [Heteromorphy] will disappear.

4. Conductors can check the coordinates of [Heteromorphyes] on the map at any time.

5. Statistics show that new [Heteromorphyes] appear every other week, presumably due to the influence of Morphic Moon.

帮助/花鸟市场帮助/宠物内容
records.text:
1.宠物是队员们的好朋友，绑定一名饲养员，培养亲密度并达到一定等级后，可解锁羁绊来提升饲养员的战斗能力。同时，饲养宠物可以增加车厢的宠物评分，提高爱宠乘客在乘车期间的消费收益。


2.花鸟市场每周仅会进货三只宠物，选购心仪的宠物并安排入住。通过补充宠物口粮、投喂宠物零食，来培养亲密度。


3.在花鸟市场的宠物用品中购买饲养宠物所需道具：一体式宠物别墅、宠物口粮、宠物零食。


4.一体式宠物别墅，简称宠物窝，将其放进车厢中，可安排购买的宠物入住。升级宠物窝可以让更多的宠物入住，一个宠物窝最多能养5只宠物。


5.宠物口粮，是宠物每日消耗的基础食物，补充其在宠物窝内，供入住的宠物食用，可每日增加一定量的亲密度。口粮越高级，每日增加的亲密度越高。宠物窝等级越高，口粮存量上限越高。


6.宠物零食，是为宠物提供额外食物，可直接增加一定量的亲密度。对每只宠物每天最多只能投喂3次宠物零食。如果投喂对应物种喜爱的零食，可获得额外50%亲密度加成。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/约书亚/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: It's you... you must have brought something I want, and that's why you're here, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/约书亚/进入兑换/文本1
records.text: All equipment comes with usage instructions. If you can't understand them, figure it out yourself. Don't bother me for an explanation.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/约书亚/交谈/文本1
records.text: You're bothered by me floating? Well — ordinary people can't float, as stupidity is a heavy burden.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/约书亚/交谈/文本2
records.text: So you have a cat... No, I'm not interested. Don't show it to me! If it gets attached, it'll be a headache for me!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/约书亚/交谈/文本3
records.text: I heard you were tricked by that old hag Rebis, so you find her annoying too... What's that look? I've never been fooled by her.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/约书亚/交谈/文本4
records.text: I'm tired. If I were to collapse on you, you must accept it quietly, no complaints allowed.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/约书亚/交谈/文本5
records.text: Speaking of which, there's a lot of dust here. Even I don't want to sleep in the sand.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/进入交易所/寒暄1
records.text: Hello, I am Plutessa, head of the trading center here... What can I do for you?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/进入交易所/寒暄2
records.text: People like you are hard to come by in all the trading centers. You will certainly make it big.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/进入交易所/寒暄3
records.text: Oh, I really want to find some time to rest. But since you're here, Conductor, it's okay even if I don't rest...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/进入交易所/寒暄4
records.text: With your frequent visits, this place has become much livelier.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/进入交易所/寒暄5
records.text: You've long been a key business partner. Please continue to support my business in the future.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/进入交易所/寒暄6
records.text: I owe all my current achievements to you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/交易行情/交易行情1
records.text: According to my analysis, the recent market for <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> should be very good...
records.noDataString: Even though this is where emerging technologies foregather, it also has many hidden secrets. You might just find a little something if you really look for it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/交易行情/交易行情2
records.text: If you still have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> on hand, you might want to try your luck at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>, and you might make a profit.
records.noDataString: The joy of getting away from those trifling household matters... Ah, don't mind me. I'm just running my mouth.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/采购券使用/采购券使用1
records.text: I've made thorough preparations. All's left is for you to pick it up! I'll get the new order forms right away.

records.text: Oh, I'm so sorry. The warehouse is empty... Please make sure to come back tomorrow, okay?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/买入/购买页签/购买页签1
records.text: Take your time to choose, Conductor. After all, slow work yields fine products.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/买入/购买页签/购买页签2
records.text: Oh my... Conductor, you have such a keen eye, as everything you pick ends up increasing in price.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/卖出/出售页签/出售页签1
records.text: What rare goods have you brought us this time? May I have a look?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/卖出/出售页签/出售页签2
records.text: I have complete trust in anything you bring.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/买入/选择商品/选择折扣商品1

records.text: Ah, do you want to reconsider? This item is quite pricey...

records.text: Selling the goods now might fetch a slightly lower price, but I'm sure you have your reasons.

帮助/污染帮助/桦树浮标内容
records.text:
1.有时会在野外发现外观漆黑如骨状的【桦树浮标】，它通常寄宿着强大的桦树生物。

3.每天都会在行车沿线发现新的【桦树浮标】，污染区的【桦树浮标】更加活跃。


4.【赴命奖章】可以在【铁盟哨站】和【阿妮塔战备工厂】兑换【列车武装】等重要战略物资。

records.idCN: 帮助/铁安局帮助/铁安局帮助标题
帮助/铁安局帮助/驱逐任务标题
帮助/铁安局帮助/驱逐任务内容
records.text:
1.已经获得【铁盟治安协力资格证】的你，可以帮助铁安局清缴行车沿线的各种威胁，获得报酬。


2.每个城市的铁安局一般会有3种不同序列的驱逐任务，完成当地铁安局3个序列驱逐任务共计可以获得：

拉普拉斯协议×10,桦石×300，铁盟币×600000以及1000当地城市声望。

第一序列：任务目标通常为当地不安定分子。

第二序列：任务目标通常为当地行车沿线的桦树生物。

第三序列：任务目标通常为一些难缠的综合性威胁。

完成当地全部序列的驱逐任务时，当地铁安局将会指定派发1个赴命任务，该任务由3个连续任务组成，通常任务地点在行车沿线，完成后即可获得该城市的【限定荣誉家具】与稀有装备。


3.目前拥有铁安局的城市有：7号自由港，修格里城，曼德矿场，澄明数据中心。


4.铁安局任务是获得护卫队员战斗经验与共振材料的重要来源，同时也是列车长快速积累原始资本与当地城市声望的有效方式。


5.驱逐任务可以进行难度变更，难度越高，作战消耗的澄明度越多，获得的报酬对应提升。

records.idCN: 帮助/铁安局帮助/悬赏任务标题
帮助/铁安局帮助/悬赏任务内容
records.text:
1.当地铁安局定期会发布重大威胁悬赏通告，需要当地城市声望达到5级才可接取。


2.悬赏任务难度较高，报酬可观，获得的城市声望也更多，并有机会获得较为稀有的装备。


3.提高当前城市声望，每天发布的悬赏任务的数量会增加，最多3个。


4.使用任务委托书，可以立即获得1个新的悬赏任务。


5.悬赏任务每天5:00刷新。

records.idCN: 帮助/铁安局帮助/案件标题
帮助/铁安局帮助/案件内容
records.text:
1.行车遭遇袭击，护卫队员迎击失败后，可进行铁安局报案处理，你可以在最近的铁安局的案件处理中找到此次案件，主动出击清缴并找回失物。


2.无力处理案件时，也可发布案件至全网，悬赏让好心人士帮忙找回失物。


3.每个铁安局只受理当地上报的案件，案件通常只保留7天。


4.每日发生在行车途中的列车劫案，可以在全网案件中查询。


5.帮忙处理全网案件，有机会获得受助方列车长的点赞与报酬。

records.idCN: 帮助/休息区帮助/休息区帮助标题
帮助/休息区帮助/喝一杯内容
records.text:
1. In the Night Chains' rest area, you can have a drink of [Silver Branch Soda] to restore 50 points of fatigue.

2. Due to limited materials, the city's rest area provides only six free cups of [Silver Branch Soda] daily for Conductor. If you have the raw material [Silver Branch], you can invite Arina to prepare an additional cup for you.

3. Drinking [Silver Branch Soda] will bring you special [Business Luck], lasting 30m each time.

4. Cities currently with rest areas include: Freeport VII, Shoggolith City, Mander Mine, CDCA Bureau, Cape City, Ranshin City, Gronru City.

records.idCN: 帮助/休息区帮助/喝一杯页签
帮助/休息区帮助/黑月商店页签
帮助/休息区帮助/黑月商店内容
records.text:
1. Rest Areas typically feature a [Night Chains Shop], offering a wide range of products for Conductors to choose from. You can purchase any item available through the Night Chains channel.

2. For Conductors with certain commercial capabilities:
The Night Chains Shop is an essential channel for spending [BCRL Coin] to purchase [Chaos Stone] and [Laplace Protocol].
The Night Chains Shop is also crucial for spending [BCRL Coin] to buy [Resonance Material], [Equipment], and other Escort Crew items, as well as [Purchase Appl.] and other commercial goods.

3. Most cities' Rest Areas have their own local shops, while the headquarters shop has a global connection.

4. Typically, local shops refresh their product list weekly, while the headquarters shop has its own refresh mechanism.

5. Currently, cities with a local Night Chains Shop in their Rest Area include Freeport VII, Shoggolith City, Mander Mine, CDCA Bureau, Cape City, Ranshin City, and Gronru City. Some Rest Areas do not have a local shop.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: It seems you are the Conductor that my colleagues have been talking about frequently... Hello, I am Rada, in charge of various management tasks at the BCRL Outpost.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: New pending task? Okay, I got it. I'll handle it later. Thanks for the reminder.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: You look... somewhat afraid of me? Honestly, I'm not as unapproachable as I look. If you need help, come talk to me anytime.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: I'm constantly shuffling between different stations, so I've become very good at handling various emergencies... I guess it's a blessing in disguise.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: ...How could this happen? Next time, I'll go to headquarters and... Oh, you're here. What's up?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: I thought I wouldn't last long here... But now it seems that with colleagues like you, my job has become easier.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/交谈/文本1
records.text: There are rumors about my past at the outpost. Claims of 'amnesty' and 'washing my hands of it' are somewhat exaggerated... But I indeed wasn't a B.C.R.L. soldier back then.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/交谈/文本2
records.text: To be honest, I frequently argue with my superiors in the headquarters. I suppose it's lucky I haven't been fired... but I don't think tolerance is good for work.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/交谈/文本3
records.text: Oh, when I'm in a bad mood, I choose to double my workload. Seeing the results of my work helps me relax.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/交谈/文本4
records.text: The safety of the soldiers is paramount. When the situation isn't that urgent, it's even more crucial to make careful decisions to prevent unnecessary sacrifices.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/交谈/文本5
records.text: Too much overtime? I don't deny it. However, I've noticed that some of your train's crew, including you, don't seem to be getting proper rest either. Why not take a break here with me?

00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Yahoo~! It's been a long time, Conductor. Now I'm the boss here... I mean, the person-in-charge!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: Hmph, Captain is always worried that I'll cause trouble, but look, Conductor, I'm adapting here just fine!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: ...I accidentally blew a hole in the dorm wall while doing an experiment yesterday~☆! Oh well, I'll fix it when I get back. Don't tell anyone!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: Conductor, Conductor, did you encounter anything fun on the way? Quick, tell me about it. I'm bored stiff here —

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: Do you think Ilona would be more suitable for this job than me... If it doesn't require going out... Huh? She probably can't handle it? Why?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: There are some good things here occasionally, like going out to fight bandits and blow up barricades... Conductor, you're here! Let's find something to do together!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/进入兑换/文本1
records.text: Yo, check out my stuff. Top-notch, real deal. You won't find them anywhere else. Yeah, I'm mimicking the arms dealer we caught. Do I sound like him?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/进入兑换/文本2
records.text: Pick this! Pick this! Conductor! This one explodes really spectacularly!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/进入兑换/文本3
records.text: Speaking of which... do you have any requirements for your weapons' look? I've been working on a Legge Bomber that can produce colorful smoke!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/进入兑换/文本4
records.text: Hmm, although I want to recommend what's best for you, I think you can make good use of all the equipment here!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/进入兑换/文本5
records.text: Want it? Buy, buy, buy, Conductor~!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/成功兑换/文本1
records.text: You have a good eye, Conductor! This is the best~ item we have, and it'll blast!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/成功兑换/文本2
records.text: Use them well! Use them to fight the bad guys!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/成功兑换/文本3
records.text: This is a newly modified product I made. I'm sure the results would be stunning!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/成功兑换/文本4
records.text: You're so generous, boss! Wish you a resounding victory, boss!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/交谈/文本1
records.text: Captain is at Cape City. Vice Captain is at Freeport Ⅶ. Karen... Karen should be with Captain, I think?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/交谈/文本2
records.text: I wonder if I can get Ilona to come to this week's barbecue party. Ilona hasn't joined a group activity with me in ten days! Being too introverted isn't good!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/交谈/文本3
records.text: Huh? My experience in dealing with villains and bandits near the BCRL Outpost? Of course, it's — blowing them up!☆~!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/交谈/文本4
records.text: I want to live a carefree life! Of course, I'm not saying this place is bad, but I still want to go out more, ahhh—

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/多萝西/交谈/文本5
records.text: Rada in the management office is a little scary? I thought so too at first! But she is able to observe the explosion waves with me calmly. This definitely means she's a great person!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡洛琳/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Wow... A rare visitor! Do you need any help?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡洛琳/进入兑换/文本1
records.text: Make full preparations before departure. You'll make a great pathfinder, Conductor...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡洛琳/成功兑换/文本1
records.text: I hope these train weapons can assist you on your journey!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡洛琳/交谈/文本1
records.text: *Yawn* So boring! Why did they make a fieldworker like me man a booth?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡洛琳/交谈/文本2
records.text: I wonder where the next exploration mission will be? Oh well, it will be with Yejue anyway...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡洛琳/交谈/文本3
records.text: Acting director... We don't know her well, so no gossips about her. But she seemed really happy eating boiled potatoes the other time. I don't get it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡洛琳/交谈/文本4
records.text: If only the Eternal can enter the Chaos Space. That'll speed up our exploration a lot.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡洛琳/交谈/文本5
records.text: The only good thing about the Chaos Space is that you don't get to see bugs in it! Huh? Blastbugs... ahhh stop saying that!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/掘金机器人/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Identity scan in progress... Data recorded. Non-ONEderland personnel, Conductor CBCRR23 {playername}, welcome.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/掘金机器人/交谈/文本1
records.text: Miss Gold? Searching. No more data on her... oh no, if I keep talking, she'll find out.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/掘金机器人/交谈/文本2
records.text: Miss Gold treats us well. She definitely doesn't force us to fight for her.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/掘金机器人/交谈/文本3
records.text: The reconstruction of the ONEderland is thanks to the Conductor's help.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/掘金机器人/交谈/文本4
records.text: Rock 'n' Roll!!!! What is Rock 'n' Roll? This unit doesn't know, but Miss Gold really likes the term.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/掘金机器人/交谈/文本5
records.text: The Nugget Mech is also responsible for storing reports and records related to ONEderland, but the relevant data of this machine has already been corrupted.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/掘金机器人/进入兑换/文本1
records.text: Please select your desired weapon, Conductor. Note: The tools sold in our store aren't suitable for gold mining usage.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/掘金机器人/兑换成功/文本1
records.text: Thank you for supporting the ONEderland. See you next time.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡莱雅/交谈/文本5
records.text: I heard the aerospace center is launching a series of rocket-themed commemorative tableware. I want to snap up the whole set as soon as it's available!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡莱雅/交谈/文本4
records.text: I'm still upskilling with the latest medical knowledge since I want to take better care of everyone.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡莱雅/交谈/文本3
records.text: Space-Grade Semicon, Alt-Grade Semicon, Shift-Grade Semicon... Hmm... how to make a joke out of it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡莱雅/交谈/文本2
records.text: Conductor, keep going. I'm not asking you to keep the train going, you're not driving right now after all... haha, hahaha!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡莱雅/成功兑换/文本1
records.text: This will do...! Very well, let these equipment protect you on my behalf for now!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡莱雅/进入建筑/文本1
records.text: Conductor! You've had a long journey. Want to take a break?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡莱雅/进入兑换/文本1
records.text: I believe these armaments can offer protection. But if you ever feel tired, please let me take care of you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/卡莱雅/交谈/文本1
records.text: Being on duty here... is very peaceful, but the vibrations during experiments always make me worry about my collectibles breaking.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/伊尔/交谈/文本4
records.text: We ran into danger in the Chaos Space last time... it was Kaleya's anchoring ability that barely got us out.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/伊尔/交谈/文本5
records.text: I read in a paper that point systems increase how willing users are to come back. In that case, I could prepare some paper-cut flowers for you as points.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/伊尔/交谈/文本3
records.text: Development on the new drone model is going smoothly. I'm stationed here for the time being, which makes the work more convenient.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/伊尔/交谈/文本2
records.text: Flee Alarm and... a game console? Yes, the early Flee Alarms were converted from game consoles. Though it doesn't seem to be this particular model I have here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/伊尔/交谈/文本1
records.text: The vending machines in the staff dorms are often out of stock, though the grapefruit juice never runs low.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/伊尔/进入兑换/文本1
records.text: Is there any train armament you need? I can provide complete experimental data.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/伊尔/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: I'm from Anita, and my— oh, it's you, Conductor. No need for introductions, then.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/伊尔/成功兑换/文本1
records.text: I'm currently assisting with continued development on more new armaments. Come by more often if you need anything.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开交货/文本1
records.text: Although this place isn't far from Shoggolith City, the entry restrictions for trains are rather strict. We'll have to rely on you for supplies.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开交货/文本2
records.text: If you're willing to help, it would greatly lighten my workload...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开交货/文本3
records.text: No need to force it. Just bring some supplies when it's convenient.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开交货/文本4
records.text: If there happen to be extra supplies you can share with us...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/成功交付/文本1
records.text: Thank you for helping the BCRL Outpost.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/成功交付/文本2
records.text: Wonderful. I can relax a little.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/成功交付/文本3
records.text: Other orders too... Ah, don't overwork yourself.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/成功交付/文本4
records.text: Everyone at the Outpost appreciates you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/标记/文本1
records.text: Great work habits. Gradual progress, I guess.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/标记/文本2
records.text: Planning ahead before departure can save time effectively.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/取消标记/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/取消标记/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/丢弃/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/丢弃/文本2
records.text: Prioritizing eh...? A very practical choice.

records.idCN: 帮助/便当柜帮助/爱心便当内容
records.text:
1.默契度高于3级的队员将有概率制作爱心便当赠送给列车长，使用后可消除疲劳值。


2.列车长每日最多可收到3份不同的爱心便当。便当柜最多可存放9份爱心便当。


3.每位队员的厨艺水平不同，使用更加美味的爱心便当将消除列车长更多的疲劳值。


4.爱心便当是有保质期的，本着环保的原则，过期的爱心便当将被波克士转化成对应品质的宠物口粮。


5.列车长每次使用爱心便当后，都可以选择给队员的厨艺进行评价，这将直接影响队员下次赠送爱心便当的积极性。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开兑换/文本1
records.text: I have comprehensive supplies here. Just exchange for whatever you need.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/拉妲/打开兑换/文本2
records.text: Besides supplies allocated for B.C.R.L.... no, I won't give you contraband.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: We meet again, and you look about the same as last time!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: Spot anything different about me today? ...My bangs are angled twenty degrees further right than normal. You really can't tell?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: Have you seen the new collab hoodie Kerisee just dropped? I can't decide between the white and the blue... mm, maybe I'll just get both.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: Hey, hey, hey, what took you so long? Those people have terrible comprehension and worse efficiency. Handing things to you is so much less trouble.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: Have you got a package for me this time? It's been ages since I ordered it. Any longer and I'll miss the peak window for posting the photos!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: You know, your taste is looking a lot better lately. Has to be all the time you've spent around me!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开交货/文本1
records.text: Oh, right, could you pick something up for me while you're out there? Don't worry, it's not one of those places where you line up for hours!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开交货/文本2
records.text: Pulling all this together is kind of a pain. Though it's a lot easier when I can just hand it off to you, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开交货/文本3
records.text: With some of these I can guess who asked for it without even checking the name. People around here have very distinct tastes.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开交货/文本4
records.text: Anything you want to ask? Better to have it all clear before you head off.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/成功交付/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/成功交付/文本2
records.text: This is exactly what we needed right now. Perfect timing.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/成功交付/文本3
records.text: I don't see my package anywhere... was it not on your route this time?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/成功交付/文本4
records.text: Just set it down over there. Thanks for making the trip.

Most of the researchers here would rather shut themselves in the lab, so they pushed me out to the management center. Naturally — if anyone's going to be the face of this place, it's got to be a handsome guy like me!
Someone blew out a sewer line testing a weapon the other day. It was filthy... I still get dizzy just thinking about it...
Seriously, don't you want a makeover? Get your style points up? Leave it to me and you'll come out a whole new person! And if it flops, that's on— ahem, I'll buy you cake.

A colleague from Fortress City brought these back from visiting family. Want to try some? Come to think of it, I haven't been home in a long while. Nobody in my family minds, though. As long as we know the others are doing all right, that's enough.
Out of every Gardener at Anita, I'm about as approachable as they come, and that's rare, believe me. Do you have any idea what that's worth?!
In that case, let me think about which orders to give you...
Going with this one? Not a bad pick.
Huh, same page — that's the one I was leaning toward too!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/取消标记/文本1
records.text: People change their minds all the time.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/取消标记/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开兑换/文本1
records.text: Take your pick. Function or looks, Anita's stuff holds up either way.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/晃/打开兑换/文本2
records.text: I've got an idea. What if I tossed a signed photo of yours truly into these packages? What? No? That was a fast no!

records.text:
从修格里商会墨伊拉处得知最近出现了一个新的红茶供应商，准备推广他们全新培育和制作的红茶，现在买入红茶是史上最低价。事不宜迟，前往修格里城的商会向负责人墨伊拉咨询一下吧。

\n

\n

活动导览

\n

1.报名参与活动后，在【红茶战争】持续时间内，修格里城交易品“红茶”的买入行情将在50%~90%区间变动，“红茶”在异地卖出的行情将在110%~150%区间变动。列车长可趁此商业良机进行贸易活动并获取利润，同时修格里城商会的订单任务也将引入全新的“红茶”采购订单。

\n


\n

个人/全服阶段

\n

通过交易“红茶”，可累积个人/全服进度，当达成一定进度时，可领取对应的【红茶战争】纪念卡——【联应之钥】以及其他奖励，同时可获得全服相关的商业增益效果。

\n

全服的进度将会每隔一小时更新一次。

\n

\n

活动成就

\n

通过交易“红茶”交易品和完成活动主线关卡，可完成活动成就，当到达一定进度时，可领取对应的【红茶战争】纪念卡以及其他奖励。

\n

\n

【红茶战争】纪念卡

\n

【红茶战争】纪念卡目前仅能在【红茶战争】活动中获取。卡包合计7张【联应之钥】，完成全部阶段奖励以及成就后即可集齐，【联应之钥】在未来版本中会有全新用途，请列车长多多期待。

\n

\n

集章兑奖

\n

参与【红茶战争】的列车长可以通过【完成红茶采购订单】和【重复挑战活动副本】获得“折让集章”，并凭借“折让集章”在【红茶战争】兑换商店中换取艾略特的皮肤【偷闲】、拉普拉斯协议、队员装备、列车武装、进货采买书、独石碎片等多种奖励。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/活动/红茶战争
records.text: I heard through the grapevine that Shoggolith's affordable Black Tea has been flying off the shelves. Still, quality matters most in my opinion.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/活动/红茶战争
records.text: Come check out what's new? Well, no matter what's in trend, business has to go on!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/活动/红茶战争
records.text: The Black Tea of Shoggolith City seems to be made via some kind of special fermenter. Interesting, yeah? Why don't you look into it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/活动/红茶战争
records.text: Welcome, welcome. I bet you already know what has happened in Shoggolith City, right?! Want to go check it out together?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/活动/红茶战争
records.text: Ahaha! Everyone has lost their minds over that New Gen Black Tea! Who knows, maybe drinking it might just make you feel revitalized!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/活动/红茶战争
records.text: Black Tea, huh? Not bad... That fragrance also makes me consider if I should get a cup...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/活动/红茶战争
records.text: "The inside scoop of what makes Black Tea sell?" What are you talking about? I don't understand...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/交谈/交易行情/站点限定情报1
records.text: People often say that there are many weirdos at our station. But if you ask me, where are the weirdos? It's just that they aren't understood by the world.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/交谈/交易行情/站点限定情报2
records.text: I heard that the acting station chief or director has come up with some new invention and is thinking about getting you involved.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/交谈/家族故事/家族故事1
records.text: That kid Wealt was trained by me from when he was a mere child. He is said to be doing pretty well nowadays, huh? I guess he has outshined his teacher.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/交谈/家族故事/家族故事2
records.text: Argh, what's with my back today? And legs... Ow, ow, ow! I'm getting old? Take medication? No way!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/交谈/家族故事/家族故事3
records.text: The older one gets, the more of a sweet tooth one has. Young one, any idea where to get that, um, chocolate in red packaging?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/站点限定情报/情报1
records.text: Even though this is where emerging technologies foregather, it also has many hidden secrets. You might just find a little something if you really look for it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/站点限定情报/情报2
records.text: The joy of getting away from those trifling household matters... Ah, don't mind me. I'm just running my mouth.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/稀少交易品
records.text: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are being snapped up lately. Make sure to seize the opportunity, Conductor.
records.noDataString: Even though this is where emerging technologies foregather, it also has many hidden secrets. You might just find a little something if you really look for it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/家族故事/家族故事1
records.text: Interestingly enough, since I was young, my father always told me I would have to take over the family business... But is it really my turn to succeed it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/家族故事/家族故事2
records.text: You said Goldiana and Richmont fought again? Goodness, how... does it concern me?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/家族故事/家族故事3
records.text: I'm not keen on my family's business. (sighs) What's the fun of constantly arguing and being busy? I'm off to the spa.

records.text:
“我们的路，我们自己造！”

\n

阿妮塔发射中心预备再次向外界开放，列车长，请前往7号自由港协助铁盟与阿妮塔一起重建通往发射中心的铁路吧！

\n

\n

玩法内容

\n

西大陆风波平息 发射中心通车预备

\n

西大陆的风波在列车长的见证下，至少在明面上已经逐渐平息。因种种原因曾经不再对外开放的阿妮塔发射中心即将重见天日。但是，在此之前，必须要完成发射中心大桥的重新建设……阿妮塔员工“沃斯托克”现身“七号自由港”，向列车长发起委托。

\n

\n

接取指定任务 提升大桥建设度

\n

完成沃斯托克发布的任务，可以提升大桥的建设度。

运输订单任务：前往7号自由港向大桥建设计划运送各项紧缺物资，获得奖励，提升建设度。

威胁清缴任务：清缴对大桥建设造成威胁的怪物，获得奖励，提升建设度。

\n

\n

推进全服进度 合力开启新城市

\n

“我造我路1期”玩法设置了全服建设进度与个人建设进度。

\n

当全服建设进度完成时，全新城市站点“阿妮塔发射中心”将会开启。列车长达成个人建设进度的最后一个阶段，得到“发射中心大桥通行券”后，即可正式造访。

\n

\n

建设最光荣 活跃列车长榜上有名

\n

为鼓励列车长踊跃参与建设计划，阿妮塔将会统计所有列车长的建设进度，并予以公示表彰。

\n

\n

建设奖励

\n

推进个人建设进度，列车长可获得模拟星辰、莫比乌斯环、“我造我路1期”卡包、桦石、星云物质等奖励。在个人建设进度完成后，列车长可获得“发射中心大桥通行证”。

\n

全服建设进度推进后，列车长可获得赴命奖章、绝命奖章·金、“我造我路1期”卡包、一般武器改造凭证、特殊武器改造许可、黑月采购券等奖励。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/打开任务列表/打开任务列表1
records.text: Can I help you with anything? Ah, please, take your time to look around...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/打开任务列表/打开任务列表2
records.text: Don't hesitate to let me know if you need something...!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/打开商会界面/打开商会界面1
records.text: ...C-Conductor?! I can't believe... I can still get to see other living people... I've been waiting here for ages... (wails)

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/打开商会界面/打开商会界面2
records.text: Sorry you had to see that earlier! I-I am Lumina. I know I don't sound very credible saying this now, but please believe me! I will finish my job with dedication!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/打开商会界面/打开商会界面3
records.text: The launch center is an archaic station... Its history is multifold that of my age! There isn't a day that goes by where I don't feel nervous working here...!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/打开商会界面/打开商会界面4
records.text: Conductor! I feel like work has been going extremely smoothly these days. I'm sure you have a part to play in this!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/打开商会界面/打开商会界面5
records.text: (sobs) Sure enough, things are tough without {playername} around... I keep worrying about what to do if the bridge is destroyed by Chaos Remains again...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/打开商会界面/打开商会界面6
records.text: Conductor! I've made up my mind! Regardless of what happens, I will continue safeguarding the launch center... I vow to become an outstanding receptionist!
Mr. Jika often comes to chat with me, telling me things like how I should relax and so on... But what do I have to do to be like him? Feels like it will require a lot of effort to appear relaxed...
Miss Vostok is someone with unwavering faith. I don't think I've reached her level yet, so I gotta work extra hard at it!
The filing system of the launch center is exceptionally complicated... From handwritten to printed materials, and then digital files in the database system... It's truly... not an easy job. Ahaha...

I've been thinking of getting a new pair of glasses since forever! But there was never time for me to visit the Bonfire City... What kind of glasses do you think are more trendy? I'd like to hear everyone's opinions before getting a pair when I'm free!
I can draw posters! To be honest, I'm pretty good at drawing all sorts of things. See, this is a cactus I doodled... It's the mascot of that chewing gum! So cute, right?!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/接受任务/接受任务1
records.text: Okay! I will wait here for your return!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/接受任务/接受任务2
records.text: May you complete the order without a hitch.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/取消任务/取消任务1
records.text: Huh? Y-You don't wanna do it anymore?!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/取消任务/取消任务2
records.text: Please don't leave me alone hereeeee!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/任务列表为空/任务列表为空1
records.text: Today's work is fully done! Tomorrow... Will you come again tomorrow?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/卢米娜/添加任务/成功1
records.text: Sure! You wanna check out New Orders, right?

00NPC对话/活动/沃斯托克/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Awesome! Someone is here to give us a hand! You must be here to help, correct?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/沃斯托克/交谈/文本1
records.text: Freeport Ⅶ may be nice, but I'd still rather get back to my research sooner. So, Conductor, please help with our launch center...!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/沃斯托克/交谈/文本2
records.text: Mm? What is the launch center like? Well, it's not very new or advanced, but it's 100% interesting! Fancy a tour with me, Conductor?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/沃斯托克/交谈/文本3
records.text: My field of study is astronautics. Astronautics no longer exist? So what if it doesn't? I'll still study it!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/沃斯托克/交谈/文本4
records.text: There are good places in the Bonfire City too. For example, I can go to the beverage store to get all kinds of Carmine May beverages at any time... It's such a shame they don't carry Pear Soda, though. Times are really changing....

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/沃斯托克/交谈/文本5
records.text: I wonder where my friend, who studies radio waves, has gone to now... If she could come to help with directing and dispatching, perhaps the reconstruction would take much less time.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/沃斯托克/进入交货/文本1
records.text: Huh?! So you're really here to join the construction project! This is fantastic! I totally had faith in you before this too!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/沃斯托克/交货成功/文本1
records.text: See! As I said, this incredibly reliable-looking conductor will definitely pitch in! All right, don't forget to keep supporting us after this too!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/星花/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Yahoo! We meet again, Conductor of The Eternal! Or is it better if I call you the "Builder of the Launch Center's Bridge" now?

Construction work requires constant human interaction, unlike exploration of the Chaos Space... but the variables aren't any fewer either, considering Vostok had me take a shift here without any prior warning...
I've heard plenty of rumors about you recently. Looks like you've slowly become a mature, dependable conductor, huh? Keep it up!
It's been forever since I last went shopping. I'm gonna go downtown to get some stuff after work later. Would you like to join me?
The dust on the construction site is seriously awful for my hair. Hmm, once Tennie comes, I'll have to ask her about haircare tips.

The Morphic Field near the launch center is actually unsuitable for regular rocket testing, but I don't think they're planning to give up yet. They even have a comprehensive response plan... No way I can turn down their request for help, right? Especially when there's a reward for it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/星花/进入交货/文本1
records.text: Don't worry! I'll do my best to provide technical assistance too.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/星花/交货成功/文本1
records.text: All checked and cleared! Thanks for bring the goods. Hmm, what should be next...?
Hello! I'm Jika! The BCRL Agency's bureau chief? He has left the office. I'm merely an office clerk... Oh, I'm the face of the bureau chief in the files? Heheh, you caught me.
I won't pull your leg this time anymore! I promise, my family is extremely fond of conductors!
Wereferrets are also allowed to work in the BCRL Agency too. Don't be surprised. I reckon I'm considered incredibly hard-working in here!
Gah, I just got word that the Chaos Remains have obstructed the bridge again! Heheh, just kidding! We have intensified the monitoring of the Chaos Remains' activities recently.
Mm... Mm-hmm... (sniffs) With you coming over to help out lately, even the air here has gotten much fresher. Thanks a lot, {playername}!
Conductor, your recent performance has left me in awe... Salute!
Wanna check out the tasks up for grabs?
It will be fantastic if you help out here! This has always been an unfrequented station. Truth be told, it's pretty boring...
If you can come often, I think the bridge's safety is basically assured.
Woah! I just crawled out from under the desk. What's with all the commotion out there again?! Is it another experiment?

My job is quite laidback. I fight Chaos Remains when they appear. If I can't defeat them, I'll just get everyone back to hide out until it's safe... But now, without Chaos Remains, I have to learn to find some stuff to do. Come on, let's go see what Lumina is doing and prank her a little.

Want a Sea Salt Popsicle? It tastes so refreshing! And it's even the limited-edition menu item of Seal's Tea Shop a few years back. I bought all of their leftover inventory after the promotion ended and stored them all in Vostok's cutting-edge freezer. She gave me permission!

I was born in the North when the Earth Union was about to be dead in the water! The people of a small village gave me my name, which means 'star.' I wonder how that village is doing now. There's been no information about them in the records so far... (sobs)

00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/稀少交易品
records.text: There's this novelty item that has been flying off the shelves. What's it called again...? Ah, right, <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>. Did you stock up on it? Let me see!
records.noDataString: I actually can't quite understand the behavior of buying train models as souvenirs to take back from Freeport VII, but they do sell well.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/站点限定情报/情报1
records.text: This place used to be the center of Anita's space research. But if we're talking about a successful experiment, there's probably still a long way to go...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/站点限定情报/情报2
records.text: I'm here just for some peace and quiet. Is the testing ground too noisy? Haha, I'm talking about the hustle and bustle of the human world...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/家族故事/家族故事1
records.text: (sighs) I hope Goldiana is doing all right. I know she won't let herself suffer, but... Haa...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/家族故事/家族故事2
records.text: What I want to see most now is our entire family sitting down for a meal harmoniously.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/家族故事/家族故事3
records.text: The weather has been terrible lately. I bet that geezer Luxorian is going to complain about back and leg pains again. I already told him to start working out, but he refuses and rather stays in the house.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/进入仓库/进入仓库1
records.text: The geomancy of a warehouse is also of the essence. If you don't mind, I can give you two ornaments to put up.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/进入仓库/进入仓库1
records.text: Don't tell me you're planning to take a nap in the warehouse? (chuckles) Just joking.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/括卓/进入仓库/进入仓库1
records.text: Youngsters really need to learn to give and take...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/进入仓库/进入仓库1
records.text: Feel free to look around. As long as you say the word, I'll stuff your warehouse full with goods!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/幼浅/进入仓库/进入仓库1
records.text: Keeping the goods moving is the only way to make money. Quit stockpiling them.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/符游/进入仓库/进入仓库1
records.text: Intending to clear out your warehouse to get your stock from me, huh? Welcome!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/特产情报/特产情报1-1
records.text: Our HTPA Materials are top of the line. Are you not getting some?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/特产情报/特产情报1-2
records.text: Our HTC Ceramic are top of the line. Are you not getting some?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/特产情报/特产情报1-3
records.text: Our Space-Grade Semicon are top of the line. Are you not getting some?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/冲天/交谈/特产情报/特产情报1-4
records.text: Our Solar Cell Array is top of the line. Are you not getting some?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/特产情报/情报1
records.text: The CDCA Bureau's Speaker has been selling out everywhere these days.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/特产情报/情报2
records.text: The CDCA Bureau's Silver Ore has been selling out everywhere these days.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/特产情报/情报3
records.text: The CDCA Bureau's Gaming Console has been selling out everywhere these days.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/富子/交谈/特产情报/情报4
records.text: The CDCA Bureau's Game Cartridge has been selling out everywhere these days.

00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/进入/进入2
records.text: Ah? I was only joking previously. There's no way in hell I'll give up the launch base's management right to others when this is the most beloved place of mine! Still, you are welcome to visit anytime!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/进入/进入3
records.text: I'm so sleepy... I don't even remember how much sleep I got after staying up last night. Regardless, I will do my job well. Mm-hmm, mm... (dozes off)

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/进入/进入5
records.text: Thank you for assisting my... our jobs! You are truly a one-of-a-kind conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/成功投资/成功投资1
records.text: All the people who have contributed financially to us will have their names carved on the launch center's appreciation plaque!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/成功投资/成功投资2
records.text: Wow! You totally give off the 'I can add another zero anytime' vibe!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/进入/进入1
records.text: Yoohoo! Nice to meet you. I'm Vostok, basically the... uh, boss of here! You are free to run this place, provided that you defeat me and the big gun behind me. Come on in, adventurer!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/进入/进入6
records.text: You're here again! Wonderful. I've got the newest test result. Do you want to take a look? In exchange, I'd like to see your navigation log!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/成功投资/成功投资3
records.text: Does being a conductor bring in this much money? Or are you just particularly good at doing business? Alas, all the people we have here only know to splurge.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/成功投资/成功投资4
records.text: Perhaps we can consider developing more special privileges for investors, such as sending a nameplate with all your names to outer space...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/成功投资/成功投资5
records.text: If we successfully discover a new satellite in the future, we will name it after you, okay?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/货币不足/货币不足1
records.text: It's all right! This happens sometimes. Luckily, we know each other well now. If you were to get a bunch of stuff in the supermarket and only realize you were out of money at the cashier counter, that would be seriously awkward...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/交谈/交谈1
records.text: Did you go to the COLUMBA earlier? Lumina didn't secretly lock herself up and cry over work, did she? Mm-hmm, she does do that quite a bit... but we should still show her concern!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/交谈/交谈2
records.text: When I was younger, I used to live near a huge square that had a plethora of statues... Ah, this exoskeleton armor of mine was designed to imitate one of the statues I saw. That was what inspired my dream!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/交谈/交谈3
records.text: I'm the only one left in Anita's aerospace department, save for old researchers. Of course, I don't mean that I want to be the boss! I'm purely saying this field is severely lacking in new blood...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/交谈/交谈4
records.text: I will never give up without a fight regardless of the circumstances. After all, I'm the 'regional chief' of this place! Ahahahaha, just kidding. You're not in a reality-bending video game.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/交谈/交谈5
records.text: ...It will be constructed. For sure. ...Ah, nothing, nothing. I'm just mumbling to myself! Want to sneak some popsicles from the freezer with me?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/交谈/交谈6
records.text: When will you be able to partner up with Carmine May? I'm just asking. Totally not asking you to become a full-time soda deliveryperson!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/交谈/交谈7
records.text: Ah... Those never-ending swarms of Chaos Remains... Wouldn't it be nice if the headquarters' investment in us could be unceasing, too?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/交谈/交谈8
records.text: Thank you for your hard work! You must've had a long day, right? Want a Pear Soda?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/沃斯托克/进入/进入4
records.text: Thanks for your hard work! You must be spent from the journey, huh? The rest area is over there. Go catch some Z's.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/特产情报/特产情报1-1
records.text: Mander Mine may look deserted, but the Mander Toolbox can absolutely be considered leading in sales.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/特产情报/特产情报1-2
records.text: Mander Mine may look deserted, but the Titanium Ore can absolutely be considered leading in sales.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/特产情报/特产情报1-3
records.text: Mander Mine may look deserted, but the Special Steel for Tracks can absolutely be considered leading in sales.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/图浩/交谈/特产情报/特产情报1-4

records.text:
黄金七天乐
\n
假期临近，西大陆涌入大批观光游客，而淘金乐园似乎是个不可多得的好去处……
\n
\n
【玩法内容】
\n
铁盟御敌援助，拖车服务免收费
\n
假期拖车优惠！5.1-5.5期间，铁盟拖车服务的价格将调整为免费！
\n
\n
假期效益提升，勤勉致富好机会
\n
黄金周期间每日随机增益
\n
篝火城电视台将持续对各行业所出现的增益效果进行一手报道，列车长可关注当日特殊行情提升收益最大化。
\n
\n
【玩法示例】
\n
DAY1，黄金价格屡屡创下新高，多种黄金类贸易品也在交易市场表现亮眼，篝火城电视台火速赶往淘金乐园对其负责人进行采访，金子小姐表示欢迎大家前来游玩体验！
\n
贸易行业：沙金、金箔、纯金线材买卖行情将在80%-135%区间波动
\n
制造行业：纯金零件、超导线圈和镀金零件等制造业产物的回收价格提升至150%
\n

records.idCN: 活动/黄金七天乐/滚动小新闻/day1
records.text: Recently, the price of gold has been experiencing a significant increase, leading to a surge in the market for various gold trade goods. As this trend continues, ONEderland has regained public attention, giving rise to a new tourism trend. A considerable number of tourists are now flocking to ONEderland to experience the excitement of gold digging, which experts are referring to as 'the second gold rush.'     Carmine May has capitalized on this opportunity by introducing a new series of chocolates wrapped in gold leaf, creating a sensation in the snack section of major supermarkets.     The person in charge of ONEderland has assured that the facilities have been fully upgraded to accommodate the influx of tourists, and she warmly welcomes all visitors to Carmine May to enjoy themselves.     [Today's Song]: Miss Karen has requested the song 'You Are on My Mind' for 'Charismatic Little Shizuru,' expressing her hope that Shizuru won't forget to go shopping together over the weekend.

records.idCN: 活动/黄金七天乐/滚动小新闻/day2
records.text: Several trains heading to ONEderland have witnessed passengers scrambling to buy bentos on board due to the poor food quality at ONEderland itself. 'I don't think the chefs there have any taste buds at all,' remarked one tourist during an interview. The reporter confirmed this suspicion after observing Nugget Mechs as cooking robots in the kitchen at ONEderland.     It is advisable to exercise caution when purchasing gold, as one customer who bought commemorative gold coins online received chocolates wrapped in gold leaf instead.     A tycoon requested a custom all-gold train with seats made of pure gold, but the technical department responded that only the toilet on the train could meet such a requirement.     [Today's Song]: Mr. Anonymous has requested the song 'Guided by Fate' for 'My Only Enemy,' expressing his hope that they will stop ignoring his mails.

records.idCN: 活动/黄金七天乐/滚动小新闻/day3
records.text: A mysterious woman dressed in black was mistaken for a suspicious person at the Night Chains Amusement Park due to her resemblance to a criminal from a famous crime drama.     Passengers have complained that one train carriage is filled with colorful plum blossoms and is difficult to walk through, but the conductor explained that plum blossoms are an affordable decoration.    [Today's Song]: Miss Galina and Miss Daria have requested the song 'The Letter to You' for the entire crew of the train CBCRR23 with a message, 'We've been doing great! Wishing you all the best!'

records.idCN: 活动/黄金七天乐/滚动小新闻/day4
records.text: According to a spokesperson from B.C.R.L., a significant number of robbers have targeted trains transporting gold due to the continuous rise in gold prices. Several cases of robberies have occurred, severely impacting the safety of railroad transportation. The BCRL Agency in all cities has responded promptly by deploying a large number of soldiers to combat these illegal activities. The B.C.R.L. urges the public to prioritize travel safety and avoid routes frequented by robbers.    [Searching for a Lost Companion]: A young blonde woman from the Empire, who may pose a danger to nearby citizens when hungry. Shouting 'Millie' will elicit a response from her. Please contact me if you have any information regarding her whereabouts.     An elderly citizen expressed dissatisfaction with the train's acceleration, citing discomfort caused by the speed. However, during the interview, he mentioned that he would ride the train again in the future, as no accidents had actually happened.     [Today's Song]: Mr. 'I'm Your Big Brother' has requested the song 'Like Brother, Like Father' for the conductor of the train CBCRR23 with a message, 'Ordering songs is so fun! But honestly, I'd prefer to meet you in person!'

records.idCN: 活动/黄金七天乐/滚动小新闻/day5
records.text: The efforts of the B.C.R.L. have effectively reduced robberies. However, the frequent confrontations between the two parties have caused psychological stress among many tourists. Recently, numerous travelers have reported feeling calm and relaxed simply by observing the aquariums inside the trains. Trains with a large number of aquariums have gained popularity among tourists, sparking a trend of increased ticket purchases known as the 'blue wave.'     A mysterious woman appeared in ONEderland and was mistaken by tourists as a beggar, resulting in generous handouts. However, the woman said that she only wanted food and happily consumed a number of discarded boxed lunches.     In response to recent explosions in various locations, the B.C.R.L. stated that they were caused by law enforcement officers carrying out their duties, assuring the public that no casualties were reported.     [Today's Song]: Miss 'Your Arina' has requested the song 'Always by Your Side' for the conductor of the train CBCRR23 with a message, which has been censored and not announced due to inappropriate content.

records.idCN: 活动/黄金七天乐/滚动小新闻/day6
records.text: The culprits involved in the robberies have all been apprehended, thanks to the tireless efforts of the B.C.R.L. As a result, the majority of tourists have enjoyed a safe and pleasant experience. Souvenir stores in ONEderland are experiencing exceptional success, with many tourists purchasing agate, lapis lazuli, and other souvenirs to commemorate their wonderful journey, resulting in long queues at the stores. The administrator of ONEderland is actively working to address this issue and welcomes tourists from other cities to purchase ONEderland products through trading centers.     A boy who visited ONEderland became fascinated with the idea of becoming a Nugget Mech when he grew up. To showcase his gold-digging abilities, he engaged in a competition with a dog in the park but unfortunately lost.     Preparations for Ten Rounds' new games are currently underway, and the promise of a major announcement has sparked enthusiastic discussions among fans.     [Today's Song] Mr. Wealt has ordered the song 'Loving You Is as Breathing' for Miss Goldiana with a message, 'Come on out and have dinner with me! Please, just once!'

records.idCN: 活动/黄金七天乐/滚动小新闻/day7
records.text: The urban legend surrounding the CDCA Bureau has become a popular topic, attracting urban legend enthusiasts to explore the area. COLUMBA sincerely invites talented individuals to join their organization and encourages interested parties to submit their resumes.     [Today's Song]: The children from the Fortress Experimental Elementary School have requested the song 'Thank You' for all the conductors, expressing their gratitude for the wonderful vacation they experienced.

records.text:
Weekly News
[Gameplay Description]
The news report will reflect this week's trade trends, passenger trends, material retrieve, and group order revenue changes. Some goods and stations will enjoy a week-long bonus.

[Event Time]
Refresh Time: Every Monday at 5:00

[Gameplay Content]
Trade trends: Changes occur weekly, and the prices of goods related to the news will be adjusted as follows this week:

Buy price minimum fluctuation range is 50%~65%

Buy price maximum fluctuation range is 100%~120%

Sell price minimum fluctuation range is 80%~95%

Sell price maximum fluctuation range is 135%~150%

Material recycling: Based on the news report content, the recycling price of certain materials will occasionally increase to 150%.

Passenger industry: Train trips with destinations related to the news will receive bonuses. This includes gaining numbers of high-level passengers, free leaflet acquisition, various train rating scores, seat ticket prices, and various ratings, all of which have chances to gain enhancement.

Group Order: According to the news report content, some order revenues may occasionally increase by 10%.

records.text:
真相就藏在迷宫的尽头，但你是否已做好知晓一切的准备？
\n
\n
内容概况
\n
一、完成活动剧情，探索“闹鬼”公寓
\n
正值澄明嘉年华期间，数据中心挤满游客，好不热闹，但10Rounds公司最新恐怖游戏《不眠之城》发布会的现场，却发生了一桩突发事件。作为发布会场地的远见公寓素来有“此地闹鬼”的都市传说……深入探索这栋诡异的公寓，发现事件的真相吧！
\n
\n
二、全新战斗关卡开放 享受全新挑战
\n
活动期间，“远见公寓”中将随剧情进度开放8个“表象”剧情战斗关卡，可重复挑战并获取奖励。在活动进行至后期时，还会开放新的挑战关卡“深层”，列车长们将能够在“深层”关卡中体会高难度战斗、获取奖励。
\n
\n
三、调查灵异事件，收集冗余数据
\n
参与“澄明异闻奇谈”活动的列车长可以通过攻略战斗关卡获得“冗余数据”，并凭借“冗余数据”在异闻集市中换取拉普拉斯协议、银枝、进货采买书、自观测胶卷、神秘角色皮肤等多种奖励。
\n
\n
四、完成活动成就，获取丰富奖励
\n
本次“澄明异闻奇谈”活动中设置了活动任务系统“怪谈辑录”。只要在活动期间达成任务条件，即可领取桦石、仙人掌能量棒棒糖、纪念卡包·澄明异闻奇谈等奖励。
※“纪念卡包·澄明异闻奇谈”目前仅能在“澄明异闻奇谈”活动中获取。卡包内含7张全新设计的卡牌，完成全部阶段奖励以及成就后即可集齐。卡牌在未来版本中会有全新用途，请列车长多多期待。

records.idCN: 监狱/承包相关/监狱合同内容2
records.text:
一、承包内容\n



整顿中心及生产车间的管理、生产及运营。\n



二、甲方的权利义务\n



1、甲方应根据乙方缴纳的资金，为乙方提供相应的生产资料<color=#cc6e0a>（包括生产车间1间、工作区域2列、整顿宿舍1间、生活区域2块、缝纫机6台、车载缝纫机1台）</color>。\n



2、甲方需为乙方提供场地、水电、安全保卫。\n



3、甲方应在乙方进行管理、生产、销售等活动时，在遵守法律法规的情况下提供帮助。\n



4、甲方应根据法律法规，在乙方进行管理、生产、销售等活动时从旁监督，若乙方违反合同内容或法律法规，甲方有权回收整顿中心及生产车间的管理权限。\n



三、乙方的权利义务\n



1、乙方需向甲方缴纳128万铁盟币作为生产车间和整顿宿舍的租赁费用、200万铁盟币作为整顿中心运维成本，<color=#cc6e0a>共计328万铁盟币</color>作为承包费用。\n



2、乙方应按相关规定制定生产计划、展开生产和销售活动，接受甲方的监管。\n



3、乙方应按相关规定收容、管理罪犯，并按正规流程向甲方报备。\n



4、车间生产与销售产生的盈亏均由乙方负责。
