records.text: Welcome! What would you like to hav— oh, sorry, force of habit from working at home, haven't shaken it off yet! Hehe, let me know what you'd like, just ask me anything!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: Conductor, you're back again! Oh wait, I forgot to introduce myself last time—I'm Komugi! Same as before, just call me if you need anything—

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: It's so stuffy in here today... haah... Oh! Conductor! I wasn't slacking off, I was just cooling down for a sec!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: We've run into each other so many times, but somehow we never really got to talk much... hehe, I'm really glad we get to be friends.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: Your job seems so interesting, Conductor! If I could work on the train with you, I bet that'd be a lot of fun...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: Here! A special reservation voucher for the BCRL towing car! You've been so good to my little shop here, so I wanted to find some way to pay you back—just call this number and I'll come running!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/进入兑换/文本1
00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/进入兑换/文本2
records.text: Humans are really impressive... though I hear a lot of demihumans refuse to use high-tech human gear. I wonder why that is?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/进入兑换/文本3
records.text: I can't give you a discount, but I can help point out the good stuff!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/进入兑换/文本4
records.text: I always figure it's not about how powerful the weapon is, it's about whether it actually suits you. That's what all the veterans say, anyway!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/进入兑换/文本5
records.text: Come to think of it, I heard some piece of gear here got taken away to be used as a test sample...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/成功兑换/文本1
records.text: Here you go! This is the gear you picked out, I already had Miss Paladi's robot carry it to your train!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/成功兑换/文本2
records.text: Great eye! This piece has always had really good reviews.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/成功兑换/文本3
records.text: Please make sure crew members use it safely and within regulations! Ah, I'm just reading off the manual... I'm sure you'd never misuse it, Conductor!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/成功兑换/文本4
records.text: Mmm, something smells good... what'd you eat today, Conductor? Oh—wait, we're on duty right now, aren't we! Sorry, I got distracted!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/交谈/文本1
records.text: Working here's really nice, everyone looks out for me! But they keep telling me to be careful, watch out for accidental discharges... I'm already a proper soldier, why's everyone still so worried about me?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/交谈/文本2
records.text: Most of the time I'm out driving the towing car... coming here for duty is just once in a while. The veterans always tell us to drive safe, but I'm always careful! I was even last year's BCRL Model Driver!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/交谈/文本3
records.text: I went to get my photo taken for the BCRL demihuman recruitment poster the other day. I actually looked pretty cool in it... I wonder if my family will ever see the finished poster?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/交谈/文本4
records.text: My family runs a little restaurant in Ranshin City. Next time you're free and passing through, you have to come eat something! And—and you have to bring me along, I can get you a discount—

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/小麦/交谈/文本5
records.text: I really wish I could get a shift on your train sometime! I've always been stuck up front in the towing car, I've never even seen what the inside of the Eternal looks like...

records.idCN: 监狱/承包相关/新车间承包条件
监狱/承包相关/新车间条件不足提示
records.text: Requirement unmet. Cannot contract a new workshop.

records.idCN: 监狱/承包相关/可承包车间
监狱/承包相关/支付保证金
监狱/承包相关/保证金已满提示
records.text: Your deposit is full and does not need to be replenished.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Hello, I'm Yusong. Pleased to meet you... albeit this doesn't seem like an appropriate place to be chatting. Ahem, anyway, let's get to work.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: The operation style of Base Yunxiu Bridge is markedly different from other stations. I hope you'll be able to adapt to it. Just ask me if you have any questions.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: I'm pretty surprised by how often you visit Yunxiu Bridge... Other conductors all preferred the more developed city stations, but you seem to treat this place like the rest.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: I had no other management experience prior to this, but word has it that the candidates who applied at the same time I did all willingly pulled out of the race... That is how I got the job of managing the entire Base Yunxiu Bridge.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: BCRL has been rating the management standard of each station these days... If you get the survey... No, no, I'm not asking you to give me high ratings! What I mean to say is, if you have any complaints regarding my work, please let me know directly. I promise to work on it!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: Conductor, thank you for your constant assistance and support to the Bridge Management Center. It has been my privilege to work alongside you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开关卡/文本1
records.text: Please make sure to pay attention to safety while on the job.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开关卡/文本2
records.text: I can lend you a portable mission recorder if you need one...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开关卡/文本3
records.text: Hopefully, our collaboration can make the surrounding area a safer place.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开关卡/文本4
records.text: Previously, I got word that the bridge near the launch center often got wrecked by Chaos Remains... Hope we can protect Yunxiu Bridge.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开关卡/文本5
records.text: Even though I really wish to help, the station is seriously short on manpower. Please act with caution, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开交货/文本1
records.text: There is a significant need for supplies at the Reforming Center. Please do your best, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开交货/文本2
records.text: I've tallied the needs of the staff and made a list of the most urgently required supplies for now.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开交货/文本3
records.text: I have no doubt that you're someone with excellent management skills.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开交货/文本4
records.text: As the project is really disorganized, there may be some rather strange-looking requests...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/成功交付/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/成功交付/文本2
records.text: These supplies will be of great help. Thank you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/成功交付/文本3
records.text: I will engage surveillance robots to help transport them. They are incredibly efficient at unloading goods.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/成功交付/文本4
records.text: It must have been a long journey here. Would you like to get some rest first?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/交谈/文本1
records.text: You heard Miss Paladi screaming when you passed by the Reforming Center? ...Got it. I'll find out about it during the shift change later. But since she didn't ask us for help, I guess it should be nothing out of the ordinary...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/交谈/文本2
records.text: I'm constantly receiving complaints about Mr. Qiantu that claim he looks malevolent. Thank goodness you're not one to judge people by their appearance, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/交谈/文本3
records.text: I'm watching combat records. You can frequently find interesting, eye-catching clips in the videos of the standard patrol and eviction quests. I tend to crop them out and send them to the people in the clips as a surprise.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/交谈/文本4
records.text: Coming... Ah, Conductor! About them calling me "Director Yu" earlier... please don't take it seriously. It's purely an inside joke.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/交谈/文本5
records.text: A while back, I helped with the shooting of a short BCRL advertisement that's probably already being played everywhere as of now... It's a film called "Tumultuous Drama." Have you seen it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/放弃/文本1
records.text: Understood. I'll get you another order right away.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/放弃/文本2
records.text: This doesn't happen to be at the top of the list anyway. Don't worry, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/标记/文本1
records.text: Please conduct a thorough check of your equipment and supplies before setting out.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/标记/文本2
records.text: May you have a safe trip.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/取消标记/文本1
records.text: I understand you have a lot on your plate.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/取消标记/文本2
records.text: Just arrange according to your convenience.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开兑换/文本1
records.text: All equipment produced by BCRL is quality-assured. Feel free to pick whatever captures your fancy.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/余淞/打开兑换/文本2
records.text: Per the regulations, bartering isn't permitted in any of Base Yunxiu Bridge's trading places. If any of my colleagues ever make such a request, please turn them down prudently.

records.idCN: 战斗/个人排行榜/记录数量
活动/通用/每周新闻英文
00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/进入交易所/寒暄1
records.text: Hehehehehehe... You must be that legendary conductor of the Eternal. Here, come on in and take a seat. I bet we'll have lots to talk about... Heh...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/进入交易所/寒暄2
records.text: I'm aware I don't look amiable. I hope you won't view me differently because of it... Haha.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/进入交易所/寒暄3
records.text: Doing business is no different from being a decent person; they both require sincerity. However, it is imperative not to trust anyone blindly... Don't you agree?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/进入交易所/寒暄4
records.text: I've been utterly genuine and truthful while doing business with you, you say? Heh, I can't stop you if that's what you want to believe.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/进入交易所/寒暄5
records.text: Heeheeheeheehee...! I am the...! (inhales) (coughs) ...No, nothing. Welcome, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/交谈/家族故事/家族故事1
records.text: ...My appearance has made the other kids of my family look down on me ever since I was young. It's only to be expected that I can't have the kind of glamorous lives they have...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/交谈/家族故事/家族故事2
records.text: It's said that you were wanted by BCRL sometime ago. Is that right? I totally get it... I also had times when I nearly strayed from the straight and narrow... What? It was a misunderstanding? Oh... Forget I said anything... then... Haha... Ha.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/交谈/家族故事/家族故事3
records.text: I understand now. One must take hold of one's own destiny. I don't plan to depend on my family's support anymore... Why are you making that face? I'm only making small talk...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/进入交易所/寒暄6
records.text: You're the most honorable customer of the trading center, in my opinion. I'll do everything to help you obtain whatever product it is you'd like... Heheh...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/交谈/交易行情/交易行情2
records.text: Heheh, I've got a piece of good news for you. If you bring <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> over to <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> to sell, you'll surely make a killing.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/交谈/稀少交易品
records.text: Recently... <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> have been selling out like hotcakes everywhere... Heheh, this information is free of charge. I won't lie to you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/交谈/交易行情/交易行情1
records.text: Based on the intel I received... <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>'s <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> should sell pretty well...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/交谈/站点限定情报/情报1
records.text: Did you hear? Rumor has it that the manager of this place will bark out orders at everyone... Me? Of course, I won't be bossed around by that kid.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/交谈/站点限定情报/情报2
records.text: I may not be able to enter the Reforming Center for a tour, but I do know some of the secrets of their production process... If you're keen...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/进入仓库/进入仓库1
records.text: This is your personal warehouse. Use it as you see fit... Heheh.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/买入/购买成功/购买成功1
records.text: Thanks a lot. Heheh. Now, my earnings for the day will be...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/采购券使用/采购券使用1
records.text: Restock? Sure, sure. As long as you'll be happy... Hehe...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/议价/抬价失败/抬价失败1
records.text: You wouldn't want to lose me as a partner because of reducing my profit, would you?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/议价/抬价成功/抬价成功1
records.text: Hehe... All right, I will let you benefit more from this deal...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/议价/砍价失败/砍价失败1
records.text: Any lower and I will have to sell my property to make up the difference...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/商品交易上限/商品交易上限1
records.text: It's out of stock for real... I promise I will think of a way to get more. Through lawful means, of course...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/卖出/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: You won't be making any profit from this deal... Are you sure about this?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/卖出/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: I will buy it out of trust in you and the product quality. Heheh...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/议价/砍价成功/砍价成功1
records.text: ...Well, I guess I can compromise if it's for the sake of my esteemed business partner.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/卖出/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: You're definitely better at doing business than I am. Looks like working with you is the right decision.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/卖出/取消卖出/取消卖出1
records.text: What a shame... You will still sell me your goods in the future though, yeah?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/卖出/出售页签/出售页签2
records.text: The good news you bring never fails to inspire people.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/卖出/出售页签/出售页签1
records.text: There's always a market for any type of product here... After all, people have no choice in this closed environment. Hahaha...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/卖出/出售成功/出售成功1
records.text: I will distribute these goods accordingly... They will absolutely not be taken to anywhere inappropriate...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/买入/选择商品/选择折扣商品1
records.text: Ah, you sure do have a discerning eye.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/买入/选择商品/选择涨价商品1
records.text: ...Would you like to reconsider? Though I certainly do not mind you shelling out extra money for it... Heheh...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/买入/取消购买/取消购买1
records.text: ...? You've changed your mind? I'm sorry we didn't meet your expectations.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/买入/购买页签/购买页签2
records.text: What do you look out for when you're selecting goods? Just a random question...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/买入/购买页签/购买页签1
records.text: Don't hesitate to pick whichever product you like. Heehee...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/乾图/买入/选择商品/选择原价商品1
records.text: Solid choice... But you did not forget about the costs of shipping and losses, right...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/打开商店界面/文本1
records.text: Remember to check here out often whenever you need anything!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/打开商店界面/文本2
records.text: You can get a sewing machine here and bring it home to try... Hmm, what's that called again, ah, Reforming Center trial edition!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/打开商店界面/文本3
records.text: The furniture and decorations for sale here are 100% identical to those used in the Reforming Center! Worry not, everything is quality-assured!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/兑换商品/文本1
records.text: If you need delivery services for bulky items, please engage my surveillance robots!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/兑换商品/文本2
records.text: The work here isn't tough, not at all. Really. I'm just a li~ttle sick of doing it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/兑换商品/文本3
records.text: Ah, this is my current project. With just one flip of this switch... code red alarm will ring throughout the prison... Exciting, right! Wanna give it a try?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/将物品转入原料仓库/文本1
records.text: Massive kudos for providing production materials for the Reforming Center!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/将物品转入原料仓库/文本2
records.text: Now I can move on with new work arrangements. Thanks, {playername}!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/将物品转入原料仓库/文本3
records.text: Shall I assign you a surveillance robot as your assistant?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/将物品从成品仓库取出/文本1
records.text: When will we get to process something for Source Citadel...? Ah! I didn't say anything. Nothing at all!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/将物品从成品仓库取出/文本2
records.text: You've had a hand in making these goods. Go ahead and sell them as you please!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/将物品从成品仓库取出/文本3
records.text: Ah, this is my current project. With just one flip of this switch... code red alarm will ring throughout the prison... Exciting, right! Wanna give it a try?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/道具不足
records.text: You don't have enough money! Come again next time! ...Ah, I already got a warning before, or else I would've asked you to help get me some Citadel merch as payment for the goods...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/打开仓库界面/文本1
records.text: Gah-ha-ha! I spotted you the moment you reached the entrance! Quick, come on in!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/打开仓库界面/文本2
records.text: Guys, charge! Ah, it's you! That was close. I nearly had the surveillance robots take you down. Sorry! I'll adjust the detection system!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/整顿中心/帕拉笛/打开仓库界面/文本3
records.text: You're here! Fantastic. I recently developed a new surveillance robot program. Stand still at the doorway, let's see if they can avoid you!

records.idCN: 监狱/仓库/购买容量数不足
records.text: Insufficient purchasable slots. Please upgrade your Reforming Center.

records.text: Please complete the previous stage first.

records.text: Insufficient Blank Videotape. Purchase from HQ Shop?
A nameless building that has been deserted for an unknown number of years. Benefits and desires have brought it visitors once again.
A very novel way of greening. Deserves a one-way ticket reward from B.C.R.L. that leads to prison.
The traces of damage here are fairly new, likely created recently. One can subtly hear some unsettling sounds underneath.
Somehow, it feels like it will be better not to find out what exactly is being pumped out of this.
Before the door stands two trees—one normal, one not.
Seems to be the living quarters of the tea factory's employees. The only relatively new facility in this dilapidated place.
A murky pond that emanates an ominous vibe. Best stay away from it, or it will be terrible if you fall in.

Not only are there Chaos Remains here, but this is also the base of the remaining New Northern Alliance members. BCRL Agency strictly prohibits civilians from entering the hilly area and has increased patrols.

A monument of the old Freeport Ⅶ incident. Someone carved "Underground city is safer. Bonfire Cities should be abolished" on it. Those people caught vandalizing the monument have all been fined by the BCRL Agency.
A construction site that has been abandoned for ages. One can somehow tell that this area was originally meant to be built according to the layout of the Bonfire Cities aboveground.
The entryway of the CDCA Bureau. Its massive logo wordlessly exhibits the influence Anita has on this Bonfire City.

One of the most popular restaurants in Gronru City that reportedly only accepts a maximum of ten customers at one go. Bookings are filled all the way to the following year... Is there even a point to advertise in such a place?
The newest object in this alley. The previous one is said to have been stolen.
Tends to remind people of the overseer of this Bonfire City. It's no longer operating though, correct?
A rust-covered roller shutter that looks like it could give out at any time. Behind it is the benchmark that countless Bonfire Cities rely on to maintain stability.
Who could still be supplying power to and updating the advertisement boards of this place after all this time...?
Considering that the CDCA Bureau is an underground city, this water definitely did not come from rain.

As nobody manages this place, the nearby merchants and residents all throw their trash here. What's amazing is that all the trash vanishes in a few days despite no one having ever seen anybody clearing it up.
The car owner has long been missing. Even the license plate number yields no information about who possessed it. May be a car with no factory records...
Based on what the nearby residents remember, this scaffold has been in this state since many years ago. It has remained totally unchanged.
A defaced walkway isn't a suitable background for photos, no matter how stunning a pose you have in front of the camera.
In their memories, that gentle, reliable person was always here. What about now?
Filled with rust and some indiscernible filth to the point that it no longer bears any semblance to its original appearance.

Once upon a time, numerous ambitious researchers stood on the deck and discussed the infinite possibilities of the future with a smile, but now, this is a place left only with a bunch of lost souls who can never be woken up again.
Aside from the damage caused by "The Wilderness King," there is no obvious damage on the exterior of the hull. The biggest problem might be an interior one.
"Flee Alarm" immediately rings non-stop if you so much as try to approach this ship, intensifying the unsettling atmosphere.
Impressive, huh? This is the phenomenal vehicle of the wilderness' only ruler—Wilderness King! The imposing, awe-inspiring king and his vehicle will always prevail. Make sure never to call him Tom.
You mustn't have your mouth open while standing here, or be prepared to be fed sand by the wind.

Many Marauders stand guard outside the walkway of the main control room, their expressions mostly wary as they watch out for anything unusual. But there are also a few of them in the corners letting out soft snores.
This crane appears to have been slightly modified so that it can bear the load of items that used to exceed its weight limit.

This place's defense is incredibly weak. A familiar lock is installed on the door, while some drink cans and food packaging are littered all over the floor. It appears those Marauders like making merry here every now and then.
As expected of the All-Purpose Mobile Engineering Platform. Even though it's already retired, its incomparable mechanical beauty can never be replaced.

MoleGang has committed so many crimes that one can write an entire book about them. They terrorize residents, rob CoC, stick chewed-up gum on advertisement boards... and even dare to steal B.C.R.L.'s supplies!

A large barricade that can obstruct a train's path. The "best helper" in MoleGang's robberies. It's not hard to picture a train once being completely robbed clean upon failing to break through its obstruction.
The newly refurbished Eternal Train. Its exterior almost still seems to be glinting. Make sure it's kept safe from damage.

00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/进入/进入1
records.text: (Kiki) Welcome to Cape City's City Hall. I'm Kiki, the mayor's secretary. I'll be handling the relevant matters. This is Mr. Aleister, Cape City's mayor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/进入/进入2
records.text: (Kiki) Thank you for your support toward Cape City's development... This is what Mr. Aleister says as well.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/进入/进入3
records.text: (Aleister) Meow... (Kiki) Hmm? Mr. Aleister's actually saying hi of his own accord. This is unexpected.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/进入/进入4
records.text: (Kiki) Your rousing deeds in Cape City have already made the rounds in the entire City Hall. We genuinely hope to maintain a good working relationship with you. (Aleister) Meow!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/进入/进入5
records.text: (Aleister) Heh, human. What's with that expression? You should feel honored that I'm greeting you so sincerely.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/进入/进入6
records.text: (Aleister) I admit that you're a very capable human... but I will never let you pet me the way you do other ordinary house cats.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/成功投资/成功投资1
00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/成功投资/成功投资2
records.text: (Kiki) These funds will be used in the construction project of Cape City's latest public facility.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/成功投资/成功投资3
00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/成功投资/成功投资4
records.text: (Aleister) You know, why don't you just add a little more and invest 500,000 at once? This in-between figure is seriously irritating.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/成功投资/成功投资5
records.text: (Aleister) Good job, human. People like you are more than welcome here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/货币不足/货币不足1
records.text: (Aleister) Meow? Meow meow meow! Meow! Meow! Meow! (Kiki) Mr. Aleister! Just because they can't understand you doesn't mean you should...! Um, Conductor, this is a misunderstanding. Mr. Aleister doesn't mean anything by it. Anyway, please come back again after you've prepared the sufficient amount.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/交谈/交谈1
records.text: (Kiki) My fashion style is fully designed by Aleister. He has exceptionally high standards for appearance. As someone who stands beside him, I, of course, can't embarrass him.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/交谈/交谈2
records.text: (Kiki) Back then, I was purely an ignorant student without a penny to my name, as I couldn't get a job after graduation... My life was only changed after Mr. Aleister picked me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/交谈/交谈3
records.text: (Kiki) S-Shoot! Conductor! Mr. Aleister has suddenly started throwing up! Don't tell me something was wrong with the food in Norma's?! Gronru City's conspiracy... What? He's just throwing up a furball? Ah... I'm so sorry for losing my composure... Anything concerning Mr. Aleister tends to make me overly anxious and freak out...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/交谈/交谈4
records.text: (Kiki) You have a cat? Here's a lint roll. Please tidy up and then use this safety fragrance... That's right. Mr. Aleister absolutely loathes the scent of other felines. Sorry for the inconvenience.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/交谈/交谈5
records.text: (Aleister) Kiki and I have the same Ascension Ability that can help me communicate in humankind's language. However, it's an incredibly troublesome thing to do, so I don't normally do that for no reason. You better feel honored!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/交谈/交谈6
records.text: (Aleister) That's right. "Aleister" is a brand of mine. You've probably seen the clothes I designed in other cities as well. Feel free to pile on the compliments. You need not keep them to yourself.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/交谈/交谈7
records.text: (Aleister) Kiki may look level-headed, but he's truthfully an excessively anxious man who would easily lose his marbles over some stuff...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/奇奇&阿莱斯特/交谈/交谈8
records.text: (Aleister) From a brand designer to Cape City's mayor... Impressive, huh? But my goal isn't just that. There are still numerous interesting things in this world for me to try out. When the time comes and you get sick of being a conductor, I can find you a suitable position as well.

records.text: Ahem. Don't be too bothered by Julian and the others' incessant questions. Girls tend to be slightly gossipy at times, though not... not including me.
It's said that during the Earth Union period, Cape City was also one of the most bustling port cities that existed, their port consistently illuminated every night.
Try not to mess with the Citadel people here. Come on, I'm not saying that you'll cause trouble; it's purely an extra reminder.
Wanna take a look around during vacation? Mm... I'm more than happy to join you, if you happen to need a driver.
Once people start exchanging pleasantries, it never stops. We can only assist the people who need help better if they simply get to the point.
Morning. Ready for a day of productive work?
Happy to see that you're punctual.
Looks like today isn't the day for me to let loose either.
We've been seriously short-handed lately. Thank goodness you're around.
Hey, big shot... Fine, I won't tease you.
You're as dependable as always, but I won't be falling behind.
If you're still undecided, I can elaborate further.
Need a hand with something? Oh, Conductor! What are you doing here?! ...Ahem, never mind, I was just wondering if you'd happened, purely by chance, to run into our captain anywhere?
Oh? Guess I can take it easy today, then.
Welcome, welcome! Nice work last time, by the way!
Your energy really never runs out, does it. *yawn* I don't think I could keep up.
Perfect timing—want some tea before we get into the mission?
Well, look who it is, our rising star! So, how are things going with Shizuru?
I'm technically supposed to be on duty in Gronru City, but I'm covering Shizuru's shift here. Not that I minded, mind you—I volunteered! It's really nothing, honestly~
I'm a medic, you know, so I keep spare medical supplies in my bag at all times... hm? Foundation and lip gloss? Of course I've got those too, that's essential gear for any girl.
Right, I need to work hard so the captain sees how much effort I've put in once she's back from leave! ...Though, that said, maybe tea first?

Cape City's scenery isn't bad, and the streets are wide enough, but it still can't hold a candle to Gronru City. A city built entirely on money, one big celebration—you've heard of it, right, Conductor?
To make sure Shizuru has a good time, the rest of us in Team Ratel pooled our money to get her a big present. Hm? Curious what it is? Go ask Shizuru yourself.
Here, today's mission. Honestly, don't push yourself too hard over it...
Go on, just pick one already, I've got other things to deal with.

records.text:
距离海角城不远，一座未开发的小岛，即将在您的规划下化身充满夏日气息和奇幻冒险的度假胜地。作为一名优秀的列车长，当然能够度假赚钱两不误！建设您的专属海岛，开启这场未知的冒险吧！

\n

\n

活动导览

\n

建设海岛

\n

接取并完成“海岛管理局”发布的多项任务，提升海岛建设度，以获取丰富多样的经营设施，将见证荒凉海岛至热闹度假圣地的蜕变。

\n

\n

海岛经营

\n

巧妙布置绿植装饰，精心摆放店铺陈设，通过完成指定任务关卡，获取建设材料，开拓全新海岛区域。制定独特宣传策略，宣传方案，以确保吸引更多游客光顾，提高海岛评分及营业额

\n
\n

海岛治安巡逻

\n

将要成为度假胜地的海岛上突然出现了一群特殊来客，为了维护海岛的和平和收益，直面袭来的敌人吧，列车长！参与活动地图关卡，通过即可获取丰富奖励！关卡可重复挑战，发挥你的实力吧！

\n
\n

【夏日海岛】纪念卡

\n

【夏日海岛】纪念卡目前仅能在【夏日海岛】活动中获取。卡包合计7张【联应之钥】，完成全部沙滩小屋升级任务奖励即可集齐，【联应之钥】在未来版本中会有全新用途，请列车长多多期待。

\n

\n

活动兑奖

\n

参与【夏日海岛】的列车长可以通过【完成海岛任务】和【重复挑战活动副本】获得“贝币”，也可以通过【沙滩排球比赛】获得“排球奖币”，并凭借“贝币”和“排球奖币”在【海岛管理局】兑换商店中换取弗兰的皮肤【夜泊】、拉普拉斯协议、队员装备、列车武装、进货采买书、独石碎片等多种奖励。

00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/交谈/交谈1
records.text: Fancy a debate with fish? This is a one-in-a-million opportunity. There aren't many fish in the world that can speak.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/交谈/交谈2
records.text: The bodies of fish are unable to handle overly complex thoughts; they can only let their consciousness manifest via dreams. In my perspective, this world is merely a dream of a fish. Maybe you're currently in one of yours too, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/交谈/交谈3
records.text: I've tried a plethora of fish bait and feed. They might be nutritious, but they don't taste good... Most fish wouldn't like them, even though we must rely on these foods to survive.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/交谈/交谈5
records.text: Living is living; no need to look for a purpose. This is the conclusion I've arrived at as an ordinary fish.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/进入/进入1
records.text: Welcome! This is the Cape City Aquarium, where you can look around on your own, go on a guided tour, or participate in aquarium trading.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/进入/进入2
records.text: Let me know if you have any questions. No one knows aquatic life better than me!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/交谈/交谈4
records.text: You already have a wolf friend, a robot friend, and now a fish friend... Clearly, what decides who we are isn't our appearance but our free will, albeit it isn't really free.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/进入/进入3
records.text: Feel free to wander around here. After all, it's tough for humans to dive to the bottom of the sea.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/进入/进入5
records.text: If I no longer want to do business someday, I might just choose to be a happy-go-lucky fish on your train.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/浏览/浏览1
records.text: Today's fish and yesterday's fish aren't the same. Please take a closer look.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/进入/进入4
records.text: You're not a fish; obviously, you won't know what the fish are thinking. But I'm a fish. I can help you ask them.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/进入/进入6
records.text: Welcome, my dear conductor. See, I still remember you. Fish's memory lasts way longer than just seven seconds.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/浏览/浏览2
records.text: More new pals have joined us. If you're interested, you can take some to live with you. Of course, you will have to pay me for it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/浏览/浏览3
records.text: Every creature has its own proper living environment. Different water quality, temperature, pressure, and so on need to be taken into account. Please take note of this while making your selection.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/买入/买入1
records.text: Has it caught your eye? Hold on, I'll ask what it thinks... No problem, it's willing to leave with you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/买入/买入2
records.text: Trafficking my own kind? No, no, no. To these aquatic creatures, I'm simply helping them move to a new home. They won't mind.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/售出/售出1
records.text: You want to send it back? Sure, let me take care of it. Its previous fish tank is still vacant.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/花鸟市场/水族馆摩勒/售出/售出2
records.text: Looks like you two aren't that good of a match. If you could also communicate with fish, perhaps such issues could be resolved...

00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/进入交易所/寒暄3
records.text: Welcome, welcome! You're back again! How was the beach? Did you have fun?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/进入交易所/寒暄4
records.text: Cape City's beautiful, isn't it? Back then, I fell in love with the scenery here too, which was why I made the decision to settle down here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/进入交易所/寒暄5
records.text: The good thing about the beach is the never-ending seafood available to eat. I definitely won't be able to tolerate those inland train stations!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/进入交易所/寒暄6
records.text: Aha, isn't it the greatest conductor of all time? Welcome! If you have no other plans, how about I buy you a meal after we're done talking shop?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/买入/购买页签/购买页签2
records.text: The majority of my customers are fussy... So, worry not. You won't find any inferior goods here!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/卖出/出售页签/出售页签2
records.text: As long as what you have is good, I'll buy it!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/商品交易上限/商品交易上限1
records.text: Seems like I'm completely sold out. If you don't mind, how about coming back tomorrow?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/进入仓库/进入仓库1
records.text: This way to the warehouse. The freezer over there has newly stocked frozen lobsters. They're incredibly fresh!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/交谈/稀少交易品
records.text: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> have been flying off the shelves these days. Aren't you going to seize the chance to make some money and treat your crew to something nice, Conductor?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/交谈/家族故事/家族故事1
records.text: ...Conductor, do you have anyone you like? If you do, you mustn't separate or fight with them...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/交谈/家族故事/家族故事2
records.text: It's been a long time since I got in touch with my family. You've probably interacted with them when you visited other Bonfire Cities... Um, when you go to Gronru City's Trading Center, you'll be able to see Goldiana, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/包浮/交谈/家族故事/家族故事3
records.text: The only thing I'm after now is food! Ever since getting divorced... (sighs) Forget it. It was all my fault. I shouldn't have been miserly... It's so lonely to eat by myself...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面1
records.text: It's a new day! Chin up, chest out, and perk up!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面2
records.text: Oh-ho, right on the dot. Come check out the missions, then.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面3
records.text: Not bad, but it's not the time to be complacent yet.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面4
records.text: You did well the last time. I guess I can leave everything to you again this time, too?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面5
records.text: Hmm... I'll give your recent performance a score of 99. Better not start skiving.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/打开商会界面/打开商会界面6
records.text: Phew... Thank goodness. I can finally take a breather now that you're here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/交谈/交谈1
records.text: You're just in time. Come take a look at this. (points) Here and here. They're all not up to scratch, correct? Geez, how could these people be so negligent with their work? This isn't something to horse around about.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/交谈/交谈2
records.text: I must admit, you're truly becoming more and more reliable. Mhm, I've already said so. Why are you still trying to be humble? Just accept it as is. It's not like I'll actually hand you a prize.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/交谈/交谈3
records.text: Come try this; it's fresh out of the pot, and you're the first tester. Huh? Hey! You okay? Quick, drink some water. (hands over water) What the? You're so bad with spice? Then what do you even eat in Cape City for sustenance?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/交谈/交谈4
records.text: Does a vacation break even exist in this world? ...Of course it's just a joke. It's not like I'm a robot that can function without any rest. Still... Wait a sec. Hey, you two over there! Stop slacking!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/交谈/交谈5
records.text: You've been under a lot of stress lately? Well, I know of a pretty good rock climbing club. You can go let loose a little... on the premise that your work is completed. Don't look so startled. Of course, I have my own hobbies as well.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/打开任务列表/打开任务列表1
records.text: What's there to hesitate? Simply pick whatever's within your ability and then do your damnedest!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/打开任务列表/打开任务列表2
records.text: I'll carry on with my work for now. Let me know when you've made up your mind, but don't waste too much time on this.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/接受任务/接受任务1
records.text: That's more like it. Get it done and over with!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/接受任务/接受任务2
records.text: Since you've made up your mind, go get started then. Godspeed! You better do a good job... Don't make others come clean up your mess.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/取消任务/取消任务1
records.text: Tsk! How can a youngster be so timid?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/取消任务/取消任务2
records.text: I haven't even said a word. Don't look so downcast. At the end of the day, recklessness doesn't equate to efficiency.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/任务列表为空/任务列表为空1
records.text: Since there's no more mission, quit loitering around here. Don't you have anything else to do?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/朵弥南特/添加任务/成功1
records.text: This order is perfect for your standards. What's with your expression? I've always been carefully studying you. Besides, you won't get anything done if you keep hesitating here.

records.idCN: 海岛/海岛经营/垃圾站/垃圾提示文本3
records.text: Trash Overflow\n1. Trash overflow occurs when you have not collected trash from any carriage for more than 48 hours or when the stored trash blocks exceed the repository's limit.\n2. Trash overflow will decrease the Max Cleanliness. Therefore, it is important to regularly clean up the trash.

records.idCN: 海岛/海岛经营/垃圾站/垃圾提示文本4

records.text:
一、承包内容\n



整顿中心及生产车间的管理、生产及运营。\n



二、甲方的权利义务\n



1、甲方应根据乙方缴纳的资金，为乙方提供相应的生产资料<color=#cc6e0a>（包括整顿宿舍1间、生活区域2块）</color>。\n



2、甲方需为乙方提供场地、水电、安全保卫。\n



3、甲方应在乙方进行管理、生产、销售等活动时，在遵守法律法规的情况下提供帮助。\n



4、甲方应根据法律法规，在乙方进行管理、生产、销售等活动时从旁监督，若乙方违反合同内容或法律法规，甲方有权回收整顿中心及生产车间的管理权限。\n



三、乙方的权利义务\n



1、乙方需向甲方缴纳<color=#cc6e0a>60万铁盟币</color>作为新增整顿宿舍租赁费用，并额外占用<color=#cc6e0a>400电力</color>。\n



2、乙方应按相关规定合理进行宿舍管理，包括人员安排、卫生维护等，接受甲方的监管。\n



3、乙方应按相关规定收容、管理罪犯，并按正规流程向甲方报备。\n



4、乙方需按照甲方及当地消防安全设施要求，安装消防器材。

帮助/活动帮助/沙滩排球/活动说明
records.text:
海岛活力源，沙滩排球热！

\n

\n

繁忙之余，和乘员们来一场酣畅淋漓的沙滩排球吧！\n

在排球场上，尽情释放热情、挥洒汗水，享受运动的无尽乐趣！\n

\n

【参与条件】\n

海岛等级达到5级解锁。\n

可以在海岛的设施【沙滩排球场】或活动界面的【沙滩排球】点击参加！\n

\n

【内容说明】\n

可以选择训练模式或比赛模式。\n

\n

训练模式：可以随时参加，磨炼对抗技巧，备战比赛模式。\n

\n

比赛模式：每次参与会消耗比赛奖励次数，比赛结束会根据结果获取相应的奖励，参加前请谨慎考虑。\n

但不用紧张，每日可以在管理局兑换【沙滩比赛用球】，使用后可以获得奖励次数。\n

可以在比赛模式点击“+”号或在背包中使用道具。\n

\n

【玩法说明】\n

进入游戏后，玩家可以选择心仪的角色参加这次排球比赛。\n

\n

在双方选择完角色后会正式进入比赛，此时会根据随机的先后手决定先攻的一方。\n

\n

接球：当排球落入玩家的半场时，需要在球落地前点击排球落点的格子，让角色前往接球。\n

进攻：在玩家球权时，当球传到前场，接球的角色将触发扣球动作，和对方防守角色比拼力气，大于对方则进攻成功，获得胜利。\n

防守：在对方进攻时，角色将自动前往防守，和对方进攻角色比拼力气，大于对方则防守成功，获得球权。\n

救球：在排球即将落地时，角色前往落点会触发扑救动作试图救球，但扑救不是一定会成功的，请保持专注。\n

胜利/失败：先获得5分的一方将获得比赛的胜利。\n

\n

帮助/制造站帮助/制造生产线内容
records.text:
1. "Manufacturing Product" feature operates as a small factory on the Eternal, allowing you to craft materials into more advanced materials and finished products.

2. Crated products typically fetch high prices. They can be sold at Trading Centers, Material Retrieve or Group Order for significant returns.

3. Crafting tools can be unlocked by various methods such as progressing through the main story.

4. You can exchange for recipes in various cities. Upgrading crafting tools unlocks more efficient recipes for products.

5. Crafting items increases your Fatigue. In addition, some recipes consume Clarity.

records.idCN: 帮助/制造站帮助/制造生产线标题
帮助/制造站帮助/引擎核心等级内容
records.text:
1. [Engine Cores] are essential for crafting items, with higher-level recipes necessitating more advanced [Engine Cores].

2. You can access [Engine Cores] through the "Upgrade" button located at the bottom left of the crafting tool interface. Currently, [Overload Core], [Furnace Core], [Condensation Core], [Reverberation Core] and [Reverengy Core] are available.

3. Upgrading [Engine Cores] demands a specific power level and successfully overcoming the associated challenges. Once the challenge is complete, your [Engine Cores] will be automatically upgraded based on the results.

4. Each time an [Engine Core] is upgraded by 10 levels, you will receive 100 Chaos Stones as rewards. Subsequently, you will need to use materials to raise their level cap.

帮助/监狱帮助/大楼/建造房间内容
records.text:
1、建造整顿中心里的房间并提升其等级，可以提升各房间内的功能。同时还可以获得整顿中心属性，以此让整顿中心产量和生产效率更高。


2、建造房间并提升房间等级，需要整顿中心或研发中心的等级满足其建造条件。


3、建造房间需要消耗足够的铁盟币、足够的电力并消耗时间。这里可以使用超级帮帮券加速建造或使用桦石立即完成建造。

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/原料车间/原料车间标题
帮助/监狱帮助/原料车间/原料车间内容
records.text:
1.原料车间生产制造是整顿中心生产链中的重要一环，用于生产各种原料。


2.在车间设置囚犯并选择配方后可以进行消耗铁盟币进行原料的生产制造。


3.原料车间可预存至多250万铁盟币。


4.生产会消耗预存的的铁盟币，生产出的原料领取后将存放至原料仓库。


5.同一原料车间至多可同时生产一种原料。


6.部分配方需要研发中心达到一定等级才可使用。


7.生产需要经过一段时间后才会完成，可以使用道具加速生产。


8.提升原料车间等级可以提高车间额外生产率，每级+1%。

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/黑月订单站/黑月订单站标题
帮助/监狱帮助/黑月订单站/黑月订单站内容
records.text:
1、这是黑月商贩所开的订单站，专门收购整顿中心配方相关制造的产物。将制造好的对应产物交付，即可完成订单，提升整顿中心等级并获得相应的报酬。


2、整顿中心等级越高，既可接收到更多数量的订单和更高级的订单需求。


3、订单可以删除，5分钟后会收到新的订单。


4、订单可以记录，在生产车间中的订单记录本中可以查看已记录的订单。

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/原料采购/原料采购标题
帮助/监狱帮助/原料采购/原料采购内容
records.text:
1.棉花哥哥定期在整顿中心发布原料采购订单，列车长可用货物向棉花哥哥换购生产所需的原料供生产使用。\n\n

2.采购订单每日5：00刷新，列车长可使用道具追加更多的订单。\n\n

3.完成订单后将获得对应的原料

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/转运中心/转运中心标题
帮助/监狱帮助/转运中心/转运中心内容
records.text:
1、转运中心可以安排车队，按指定线路运输货物或者囚犯。其中车队和线路需要解锁。


2、运输货物，指将整顿中心仓库里的货物运到已解锁线路的城市仓库。需要消耗铁盟币和时间。车队从整顿中心出发，运完会自动返回。运一趟的耗时是往返时间之和。


3、运输囚犯，指的是在其他已解锁线路的城市叫车队将囚犯接到整顿中心办理入住，需要消耗铁盟币和时间。车队从整顿中心出发，来接囚犯并安排入住，运一趟的消耗时间也是往返时间之和。

帮助/监狱帮助/仓库/原料仓库页签
帮助/监狱帮助/仓库/成品仓库页签
帮助/监狱帮助/仓库/原料仓库内容
records.text:
1.整顿中心原料仓库是整顿中心存放生产原料的重要场所。


2.采购获得的原料、原料车间生产出的原料将自动存放至这里，列车长也可将车厢堆放的货物存放至原料仓库供生产使用。


3.原料仓库需要有对应的原料，才能使整顿中心的生产链正常进行。


4.提升整顿中心等级可以提升原料仓库可购买容量上限

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/仓库/成品仓库内容
records.text:
1.整顿中心成品仓库是整顿中心存放生产成品的重要场所。


2.普通车间生产出的成品将自动存放至这里。


3.列车长可定期从成品仓库提取货物，进行订单交付及去其他城市交易所进行交易。


4.提升整顿中心等级可以提升成品仓库可购买容量上限。

2.提升假释室等级可以提升假释最低表现分。

帮助/监狱帮助/医务室/健康状况页签
帮助/监狱帮助/医务室/健康状况内容
records.text:
---健康度---

1.囚犯的健康度属性反应了囚犯的身体健康状况


2.身体状态不好的囚犯有概率生病，囚犯参与恶性事件有概率生病。


---卫生度---

1.整顿中心卫生度影响整个监狱的健康状况，每日5：00囚犯们会根据当前整顿中心的卫生度下降一定的健康度。


2.提升监狱卫生度即可降低囚犯的生病概率。

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/医务室/治愈疾病页签
帮助/监狱帮助/医务室/治愈疾病内容
records.text:
1.生病的囚犯可以进入医务室进行治疗。


2.床位不够时囚犯需要排队，排队时无法工作。


3.提高医务室等级可以扩展更多床位并降低治疗时间。


4.治疗后的囚犯将回复一定的健康度，保证后续生产正常进行。

帮助/监狱帮助/禁闭室/禁闭功能内容
records.text:
1.在车间生产时发生恶性事件的囚犯将进入禁闭室接受惩罚。


2.提升禁闭室等级可以降低禁闭等待时间


3.对正在关禁闭的囚犯进行搜身，可随机获得囚犯偷偷藏起的生产产物。

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/假释室/聘用律师内容
records.text: 1. BCRL attorneys offer diverse support to the prisoners in the Reforming Center.\n\n2. Hiring attorneys enables you to secure additional parole from prisoners.

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/宿舍/整顿宿舍标题
帮助/监狱帮助/宿舍/整顿宿舍页签
帮助/监狱帮助/宿舍/整顿宿舍内容
records.text:
1、整顿宿舍用于容纳囚犯，可以在这里看到未工作囚犯的日常生活。可以扩建更多的整顿宿舍和其中的生活区域，以收纳更多的囚犯。


2、扩建更多的宿舍或生活区域需要提升整顿中心的等级。


3、每块生活区域有6个床位，扩建1次生活区域可以多容纳6个人入住。


4、在这里看到生病的囚犯，可以将其送往医务室。

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/普通车间生产/生产车间标题
帮助/监狱帮助/普通车间生产/车间生产页签
帮助/监狱帮助/普通车间生产/车间生产内容
records.text:
1.车间生产制造是整顿中心生产链中的重要一环，用于将各种原料加工成成品。


2.在车间设置囚犯并选择配方后可以进行生产制造。


3.生产会消耗原料仓库中的原料，生产出的成品领取后将存放至成品仓库。


4.列车长可根据需要，在车间同时设置多种不同的生产计划。


5.部分配方需要研发中心达到一定等级，兑换后才可使用。


6.生产需要经过一段时间后才会完成，可以使用道具缩短等待时间


7.生产产量分为三部分：①基础产量②额外产量（额外生产率获得的产量）③buff产量（相关buff加成获得的产量）。

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/普通车间生产/车间组长页签
帮助/监狱帮助/普通车间生产/车间组长内容
records.text:
1.每个车间可设置一名车间组长，车间组长设置后新设置的生产计划将会根据车间组长的技能获得效果。


2.正在生产中的车间组长将无法进行更换。


3.车间组长技能：

        安全督导：生产违规事件发生率下降

        工艺改进：额外生产率大幅增加

        员工激励：生产时间缩短

        质量监控：额外生产率小幅增加

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/普通车间生产/囚犯特长页签
帮助/监狱帮助/普通车间生产/囚犯特长内容
records.text:
1.每名囚犯都拥有一个特长。


2.囚犯在进行特长对应类型生产时会获得额外暴击率提高2%的加成。


3.特长类型：

        拥有剪裁特长的囚犯在进行纺织品生产时将获得特长加成；

        拥有织造特长的囚犯在进行布料生产时将获得特长加成。

records.idCN: 帮助/监狱帮助/普通车间生产/特殊事件页签
帮助/监狱帮助/普通车间生产/特殊事件内容
records.text:
---囚犯性格---

1.每名囚犯都拥有一个性格。


2.不同性格的囚犯在生产时有概率出现对应的特殊事件。


3.暴戾、叛逆、贪婪、执拗、贪吃、消极、胆小、冲动为羁绊性格。


4.孤僻、懒惰、幽默、热情、细致为光环性格。


---特殊事件---

1.囚犯在生产时有概率与其他囚犯发生特殊的性格羁绊事件。


2.发生部分事件时生产会暂停，列车长需处理对应的事件才可使生产继续进行。因生产停止导致的实际生产时间不足1次生产计划时，将无法获得产量。


3.发生生产违规事件的囚犯将进入禁闭室接受惩罚且扣除表现分，受害者将进入医务室进行治疗。并获得对应的事件效果加成。


4.囚犯离开的事件可点击缝纫机对囚犯补替，替补的囚犯继承原囚犯的数值计算产量。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/冯里奈/交谈/文本3
records.text: I wonder how Miss Raziel is doing. Last time, she said she wanted to go shopping in the city together, but I haven't had the chance to catch up with her since then...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/冯里奈/交谈/文本2
records.text: Ah... I love working here. It feels like a vacation stepping out onto the terrace and gazing at the endless ocean...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/冯里奈/交谈/文本1
records.text: Forced overtime? Nope, not at all. Overtime at Source Citadel is completely voluntary, except in emergencies.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/冯里奈/兑换成功/文本1
records.text: I'm here to help. As long as it's for the sake of humanity, I— *Yawn* Sorry, didn't sleep well last night...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/冯里奈/进入兑换/文本1
records.text: We've got top-notch Citadel equipment here. Take your pick. Oh, where did I put that shipment list...?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/冯里奈/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Welcome! What can I help you with today?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/交谈/文本4
records.text: Some of Citadel's research programs are top secret, even Lissandra and I are kept in the dark... Sorry, can't tell you everything. But as long as it's something I can tell you, I won't keep them secret.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/交谈/文本5
records.text: It's a perfect spot for enjoying sunsets and sunrises up on the tower. If you'd like to stay a while longer, I'll be delight to show you, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/交谈/文本3
records.text: Well, my Ascension Ability is intriguing, but it can have unexpected effects on others, so I must use it with caution. That's the deal with most Ascension Abilities, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/交谈/文本2
records.text: Did you run into any trouble out there? Your clothes are all dusty... Let me give you a pat.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/交谈/文本1
records.text: I once read in a book that "a lighthouse is a house standing on the waves." Confluence Tower feels like that to me, so... I guess I'm the towerkeeper here!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/放弃/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/放弃/文本1
records.text: Sure, I'll get another one for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/取消标记/文本2
records.text: I'm sure you'll handle your tasks with finesse.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/取消标记/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/标记/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/标记/文本1
records.text: Looks like you're taking this order seriously...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开关卡/文本1
records.text: I've analyzed the situation around here and organized these commissions.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开关卡/文本4
records.text: I've highlighted the key info in the details for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/成功交付/文本2
records.text: Yeah, I'll take care of this cargo!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/成功交付/文本3
records.text: This reminds me of you helping me move stuff when we first met...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/成功交付/文本4
records.text: I can carry these things myself! Oh wait, I'm just a hologram. I can't actually do that...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/成功交付/文本1
records.text: Thank you, you've been so helpful.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开交货/文本4
records.text: Don't force yourself if the order seems weird to you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开交货/文本3
records.text: It is crucial to keep ample stock of supplies.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开交货/文本2
records.text: I prepared some snacks! They're super hot, though. Can you handle it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开交货/文本1
records.text: Must've been a tough journey. Need a breather?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开关卡/文本5
records.text: Thanks to your help, I can focus on my studies here without any worries.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开关卡/文本3
records.text: If you're heading into a battle, please stay safe.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开关卡/文本2
records.text: Things aren't peaceful even around Confluence Tower...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: Looks like you're a capable conductor already... I'm happy about it, and I wish you a smooth journey ahead... If you ever need my help, swing by here anytime.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: Here's a voice recording from Raziel herself: "You're doing great, {playername}. Keep up the great work."

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: Oh? You're back. I'm so glad. Few people have the access to Confluence Tower, and even fewer would pay a visit. Thank you for visiting me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: A robot? No, think me as a replica of Raziel here. I'll perfectly replicate her memory and way of thinking, rest assured.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Greetings. I'm Raziel's simulation hologram, filling in at the tower's front desk while she's away. Please feel free to ask me any questions while she's out, and I'll do my best to assist you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/罗洁尔/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: Thank you for your concerns for Confluence Tower... Phew, with your presence, everything seems to run a lot smoother around here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/故事先生/购入/文本3
records.text: In many adventures, the items you choose can steer the story in interesting directions.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/故事先生/进入界面/文本1

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/故事先生/浏览商品/文本1

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/故事先生/浏览商品/文本2

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/故事先生/售罄/文本1
records.text: If I knew things would get this intriguing, I should have packed more when I accepted this task...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/故事先生/货币不足/文本1
records.text: You're not considering a violent approach, are you?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/故事先生/交谈/文本1

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/故事先生/交谈/文本2

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/故事先生/交谈/文本3

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/故事先生/交谈/文本4

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/故事先生/交谈/文本5
records.text: My boss appreciates beauty and fun, and that one of the crucial reasons I chose to follow him. If you ever find yourself in Night Chains Land, you might bump into him, and he'd be delighted to meet you.

帮助/活动帮助/杀人事件/活动说明
records.text:
遵循谜题的指引抵达乐园所在之地，在门扉的另一侧是否有你期望的一切？

\n

\n

内容概况

\n

一、完成活动剧情，探寻酒店的秘密

\n

淘金乐园的建设顺利进行着，其中最重要的一项工程——淘金乐园大酒店终于落成。关于这座一度停工多年的酒店还有一些传闻，例如它的上一任主人在内部藏匿了巨额遗产。而在试营业活动中，也逐渐发生了不可思议的事情……在乐园现任主人彼得·黄的盛情邀请下，前往淘金大酒店，探寻酒店的秘密吧！

\n

\n

二、全新战斗关卡开放 享受全新挑战

\n

活动期间，“淘金乐园大酒店”中将开放8个“归纳”战斗关卡，可重复挑战并获取奖励。在活动进行至后期时，还会开放新的挑战关卡“演绎”，列车长们将能够在“演绎”关卡中体会高难度战斗、获取奖励。

\n

\n

三、解开谜题，收集线索

\n

参与“叩响乐园之门”活动的列车长可以通过攻略战斗关卡获得“线索”，并凭借“线索”在秘密市场中换取拉普拉斯协议、银枝、进货采买书、自观测胶卷、神秘装备等多种奖励。

\n

\n

四、完成活动成就，获取丰富奖励

\n

本次“叩响乐园之门”活动中设置了活动任务系统“调查事项”。只要在活动期间达成任务条件，即可领取桦石、仙人掌能量棒棒糖、纪念卡包·叩响乐园之门等奖励。

※“纪念卡包·叩响乐园之门”目前仅能在“叩响乐园之门”活动中获取。卡包内含7张全新设计的卡牌，完成全部阶段奖励以及成就后即可集齐。卡牌在未来版本中会有全新用途，请列车长多多期待。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/交谈/文本1
records.text: Look, this is the "Environmental Guardian" medal I just got from BCRL... I'm not trying to show off. Just wanted to share the news with you!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开兑换/文本1
records.text: Night Chains has always been excellent at creating products that people love. I'm sure you'll find the one you like most.

records.idCN: 好友/Tips/对方垃圾站未开放
records.text: Target player's trash dump is not open yet.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Please feel free to utilize the trash recycling service! ...Breese? No, I'm Lester! You've gotten the wrong one!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: Please take this. It's my name card. ...I'm really not Breese.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: Thank you for your support of the trash recycling service. It's what we should do to create a better environment for train operation.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: The trash disposal center utilizes special methods to compress and sort trash into usable and non-usable ones... Ah, I've talked too much! What can I do for you today?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: Thank you for your continued support of the trash recycling service. We hope to maintain a satisfactory partnership with you!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: Looks like the business advertisements I placed everywhere have been beneficial. More conductors have been coming here than normal.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/打开回收/文本1
00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/打开回收/文本2
records.text: It seems your train's trash bin needs cleaning right now! Don't worry. Leave it to me!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/成功回收/文本1
records.text: Breese! ...Ah, I forgot he's not here... Sorry, please don't mind me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/成功回收/文本2
records.text: The sound of the trash processor is just like background music to us. There isn't a day that goes without it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/奖励领取/文本2
records.text: Trash recycling is exceedingly important. You deserve these rewards for your contributions.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/奖励领取/文本1
records.text: Thank you so much for your help! Please accept these gifts we prepared!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/交谈/文本2
records.text: Things that I like? Uh... A lot, like golf, equestrianism, Bonfire City strolls... and... cheese. Cheese is ranked last on the list!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/交谈/文本3
records.text: Hometown? Indeed, there's a "Winter Night Messenger" story well-known in my hometown. It's said that we used to be a clan that brought hope and well wishes to humanity... But now, all I want is to succeed in my profession.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/交谈/文本4
records.text: The keys to business marketing are trends, distinctiveness, and to be eye-catching. Incorporating too much personal preference into it will never work out, but Breese simply likes doing that. It's a pain to get along with him, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/垃圾站/莱斯特/交谈/文本5
records.text: This trash disposal center is newly built, with more high-tech facilities compared to the Furnace. This is all thanks to the support of our investor! ...But there has to be more to that investor...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: This is the first time we're meeting, yeah? No need for formality. Just call me "Mercer"!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: It wasn't my intention to scare you. Worry not. I am indeed a human underneath my helmet.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: Oh, you seem to have gotten used to my getup rather fast... No, I'm not anxious, I'm actually ecstatic. It's just these things rarely happen.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: You always seem so busy. It isn't good to push yourself too hard.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: You're very proficient with these tasks. I wasn't even half as good as you back then.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: Working with you genuinely makes people feel at ease. I reckon you must have heard feedback like this countless times.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开关卡/文本1
records.text: The Fallen Star Bridge is constantly in a state of unrest. It would be greatly appreciated if you could help out.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开关卡/文本2
records.text: There are tons of troublesome matters to deal with... Could you lend a hand?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开关卡/文本3
records.text: Many of the tasks here are highly dangerous. You ought to be on your guard.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开关卡/文本5
records.text: The Fallen Star Bridge has been in this state ever since I was posted here. Maybe you could be the one to turn things around.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开交货/文本1
records.text: There will be a huge demand for supplies for as long as the Fallen Star Bridge project lasts.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开关卡/文本4
records.text: Safety is always the priority no matter what. You can spend some time and think it through.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开交货/文本2
records.text: Only a handful of conductors are capable of coming to the Fallen Star Bridge. I'm glad you're one of them.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开交货/文本3
records.text: Some needs aren't that urgent. Just go ahead and choose whatever you think would be appropriate.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开交货/文本4
records.text: To be honest, I'm not that good at organizing. Remember to let me know promptly if anything is mixed up!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/成功交付/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/成功交付/文本2
records.text: I will inform them to collect these supplies right away.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/成功交付/文本3
records.text: My, there's so much stuff, yet you still managed to deliver them in apple-pie order. This would save us so much time!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/成功交付/文本4
records.text: Feel free to take a seat here if you'd like. Get some rest before setting off again.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/交谈/文本1
records.text: I know my looks are frightening, but rather than the face beneath my mask... it's better that I keep my mask on.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/交谈/文本2
records.text: Aside from the work Night Chains assigns me, I also act as bad guys defeated by heroes in children's play. Righteousness is only noble because evil exists. So long as I can make the children smile, it doesn't matter how many times I'm beaten as the villain.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/交谈/文本3
records.text: When I'm riding the motorcycle, all of those deep-rooted worries in my head will vanish temporarily. Do you also relate to that since you're always driving the train?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/交谈/文本4
records.text: My axe is adapted from a fire axe. Axes are excellent tools. Handy, swift, lethal, inaudible... Hang on, I probably shouldn't be saying these. Please forget that.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/交谈/文本5
records.text: I heard through the grapevine that there have been several fire accidents aboard trains. Make sure to be more careful. I could share with you about some fire safety know-how. Hopefully, they will be useful for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/放弃/文本1
records.text: It's necessary to give up some extra stuff at times. I can understand that...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/放弃/文本2
records.text: No need to regret the decision you made.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/标记/文本1
records.text: Choosing a goal and working hard for it. Sounds precisely like what righteous people would do.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/标记/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/取消标记/文本1
records.text: Even righteous people have times when they feel lost...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/取消标记/文本2
records.text: Let's see if there's anything more fitting for you, then?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/墨瑟/打开兑换/文本2
records.text: It is indeed tough to make decisions. Take your time.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/苏利耶/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Oh, you're here. Let's talk inside. It's windy outside... We're on the sea, after all.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Hello. ...It doesn't matter what you're going to say, but you may go ahead.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/苏利耶/交谈/文本2
records.text: I was assigned here because I'm familiar with the surrounding environment and situation, and the sea... At least that's what I deduced. Most people in Night Chains don't really need a reason to do what they do.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/苏利耶/交谈/文本3
records.text: I was born in Gronru City, but I would never want to go back there... Tch, that place is rotten all the way through. It just looks glamorous on the outside. You better keep your eyes peeled if you visit it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/苏利耶/交谈/文本4
records.text: I don't have a good temper, nor do I have nice things to say. You... Huh? You think I'm all right? ...Okay then.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/苏利耶/进入兑换/文本1
records.text: Just take whatever you want. I'm purely the doorman here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/苏利耶/兑换成功/文本1
records.text: There. Some crates are really heavy. I can help you carry them... if you need.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/苏利耶/交谈/文本5
records.text: There are no restaurants or diners in this station because it's simply way too far from the city. If you happen to be hungry when you're here, come find me. I know one thing or two about cooking.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/苏利耶/交谈/文本1
records.text: My job? Used to be akin to fishing. What I do in Night Chains is similar to that.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: You know mentor Raziel?! Have you... seen her? I-Is she okay?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: I used to be a student of Raziel, but as you can see now, I'm abandoned due to my uselessness... Who can give me new orders...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: Sorry, I... lost my composure earlier. I'll try to pull myself together. Now, please command me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: Mm. Thank you for coming to see me regularly these days. I'm caught up on the situation now. What I have to do next... is to accept the reality, I guess.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: Ah, you're back... Please treat me as usual. I'll do anything for you as long as I can be useful.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开关卡/文本1
records.text: These are battles that I can't fight on my own.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开关卡/文本2
records.text: Hopefully, the battle will go smoothly with no danger...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开关卡/文本3
records.text: I haven't yet earned the right to fight alongside the Eternal crew. I'm sorry.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开关卡/文本4
records.text: I haven't yet earned the right to fight alongside the Eternal crew. I'm sorry.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开关卡/文本5
records.text: Don't hesitate to let me know if there's anything I can help you with during the preparation phase.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开交货/文本1
records.text: I'm sorry. I wasn't of any help to you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开交货/文本2
records.text: It must have been a long journey here.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开交货/文本3
records.text: You're truly impressive. It's as if you'd never feel tired...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开交货/文本4
records.text: Some orders might seem absurd. ...It's fine if you don't accept them. I'll find a way to handle them for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/成功交付/文本1
records.text: Thank you. Thank you so much...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/成功交付/文本2
records.text: If I could become as resolute as you...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/成功交付/文本3
records.text: You must command me to help you with transportation! Please...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/成功交付/文本4
records.text: I'll go take stock right away! ...Thank you for giving me this chance. I really needed something to do...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/交谈/文本1
records.text: When mentor was still on Senanonic, I was her student and also one of her assistants. ...But I was never helpful to her. Perhaps that's why she... No, nevermind. I've said too much.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/交谈/文本2
records.text: Managing this place is incredibly simple. All I need to do is to handle the orders and commissioning at the desk, as well as run some errands... It's nothing worth mentioning at all. But if this will be of help to someone...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/交谈/文本3
records.text: Personality simulation... People have all kinds of opinions about it, but I don't mind having my consciousness replicated. After all, I'm just an insignificant nobody. But if it were her... I wouldn't know how to face that...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/交谈/文本4
records.text: Thank you for your concern, but... no, not yet. There are still things I have to do... I'm the only one who shouldn't rest. All I want are new commands, any command will do...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/交谈/文本5
records.text: Mr. "Butler"? Yes, he's indeed... someone very affable and sophisticated. He's the one who gave me temporary emotional support and something I could do. I must thank him for that.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/放弃/文本1
records.text: I believe you made the right decision.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/放弃/文本2
records.text: Mm, I'm sure you have your own considerations.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/标记/文本1
records.text: I hope you can have a smooth trip without any trouble.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/标记/文本2
records.text: Are you about to set out...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/取消标记/文本1
records.text: Do you have other plans? I wish I could share some of your burden...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/取消标记/文本2
records.text: I won't question your decision. All the best to you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开兑换/文本1
records.text: If there's anything you like, I could transport them for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/切茜娅/打开兑换/文本2
records.text: ...Do you need anything else? How about I get you some new goods?

records.text:
内容概况

\n

一、完成活动剧情

\n

通往岚心城的轨道周围突然出现了棘手的新型深眠者，附近区域一时间陷入了被围困的危机之中。与此同时，CBCRR23无垠号上，一位神秘的不速之客凭空现身……
完成活动剧情“异乡之骏城”，解决事件的源头吧！

\n

\n

二、全新战斗关卡 追忆挑战

\n

活动期间，活动界面的“追忆挑战”中将开放7个“余晖”战斗关卡，可重复挑战并获取奖励。在完成“余晖”关卡后还会开放新的高难挑战关卡“无明”，挑战完成后可进一步获取奖励。

\n

\n

三、收集岚纹小判 兑换补给处物资

\n

参与活动界面的“追忆挑战”，完成关卡后可以获得“岚纹小判”，并使用“岚纹小判”在补给处换取银枝、进货采买书、自观测胶卷、神秘装备等多种奖励。

\n

\n

四、完成活动任务 获得丰厚奖励

\n

本次“异乡之骏城”活动中设有活动任务，可以通过活动界面的“任务一览”查看任务内容，完成任务即可获得桦石、仙人掌能量棒棒糖、纪念卡包·异乡之骏城等奖励。

※“纪念卡包·异乡之骏城”目前仅能在“异乡之骏城”活动中获取。卡包内含7张全新设计的卡牌，完成全部阶段奖励以及成就后即可集齐。卡牌在未来版本中会有全新用途，请列车长多多期待。
\n

\n

五、特殊委托  清剿卡巴内

\n

本次“异乡之骏城”活动，沿途充满感染的“铁心”怪物。为了铁路的稳定，特此发布清缴委托。列车长需要有清剿许可证，才能前往清缴，并会消耗疲劳。完成清缴委托可以获得特殊物资和铁盟币奖励。
