When I heard the others talking about you before, all I thought was that you were a fairly impressive youngster, but after seeing you in the flesh, I thought you'd be a great friend... Hiss, we're friends, right? We got to be.
Have you run into any thugs or troublemakers on the streets of Ranshin City? Hmm? Nothing. I'm just asking... It would be best if you haven't.

I heard that Izakaya outside has pretty good yakitori skewers. The guys in the agency often get together there after work. I'd join them sometimes too... How about you come with us the next time? I've been saving you a seat.

You want to rub my tail... Ha. Well, we've known each other for so long, and we've been through quite a lot together, a friendship forged through life and death, sworn friends, so I guess it's okay... Huh? You don't want it anymore? Come on—
Me? Haha! There's nothing special about me. You can just take it that I climbed up to this position with my sweet tongue and diligence, all right?
Based solely on these commissions, I can still give you some simple combat advice.
There are commissions for fighting people and of course for fighting Chaos Remains. Choice is yours.
Relax, relax. As the saying goes, victory can only be realized when the mind is at peace. Isn't that right?
Hey, you're here. I'm counting on you as usual, {playername}!
Ranshin City's situation... I won't rant about it to you. Thank goodness for your help lately, or else we would have to organize more "special ops."

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/朱鹮/成功投资/成功投资3
records.text: Although this isn't considered a small sum anymore... I shouldn't be saying anything as the governor, but as an elder, I believe you're capable of more than this.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/朱鹮/货币不足/货币不足1
records.text: Oh, insufficient funds... Haha! That's normal among youngsters. Being hard up for a while isn't a big deal. Just come again next time. You won't accept my beneficence, so I won't even try to offer!
Hey, you're here. As usual, I'll start by introducing myself. My name is Fushimi. Looking forward to working with you.
Here, take a seat! Ranshin City's interior layout is quite different from elsewhere, but you can get used to it, right?
What do you think about Ranshin City so far? I'm curious. Just take it as a public survey.
My, seeing how diligent you are, I guess you'd make a better soldier than me... Hey, hey! I was just kidding. Don't go!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/朱鹮/成功投资/成功投资4
records.text: Haha! Why such an awkward amount? This sum will be negligible on the big stage. If you have the guts, how about adding more?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/朱鹮/成功投资/成功投资5
records.text: Very bold of you. Ranshin City will certainly reciprocate your generosity, and same goes for me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/朱鹮/成功投资/成功投资2
records.text: Thanks. You're very cautious. This is hard to come by in this day and age.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/市政厅/朱鹮/成功投资/成功投资1

records.text: {playername}, be frank with me. What exactly is Ranshin City like to you? What have you observed in this city?

Hokushinryu is renowned for Itto-ryu. Steady one's heart, breath, and hands; all's over once the blade's out. This is how people should conduct themselves. I guess this is just how it's going to be for me.

Anyone who can establish themselves in Ranshin City is undoubtedly either radical, shrewd, or cautious. Do not take anybody's word at face value, especially those who you treat amicably... Me? Hahahaha! You're truly one clever kid!
There are plenty of people in this world who are physically strong yet mentally weak, but you... You're someone who has been through trials. I can sense that you're much stronger than those people.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/交谈/文本3
records.text: I don't mean to badmouth my organization, but Ranshin City is one of Night Chains' headquarters. You need to be more vigilant of those who treat you especially well... Huh? Are you suspecting me? If that's so, why don't you come check me up?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/交谈/文本4
records.text: Miss Yoizuki is an exceptionally capable person. She's personally involved in every new product of Night Chains Lesage's seasonal collection. That's gotta be a difficult job~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/交谈/文本5
records.text: Ranshin City has a tradition of making New Year's wishes... If one makes a wish with their lover as the clock strikes twelve, it will definitely come true in the coming year... Do you have any wishes to make, Conductor? Could you bring me along?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/交谈/文本6
records.text: This little one? Hehe, It's a "friend" I made here. In Ranshin City, owls are regarded as animals that can bring luck and fortune. I hope it'll bring you good luck too, Conductor. Wanna pet it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/交谈/文本8
records.text: Conductor, have you met that kid from COLUMBA? ...There's a lot about her to know... Hehe. This city doesn't care if it's an adult or a child when it devours people.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/浏览/文本1
records.text: Please pick whatever pleases you~ It would be my honor if these products I carefully prepared could be of use to you, dear customer.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/浏览/文本2
records.text: Ranshin City's commercial trade is very prosperous, but there are always items that won't be for sale on the market. So, I've gathered them here all for you~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/交谈/文本7
records.text: One day, I was walking on the street when a talent scout gave me a name card and said I'm "celebrity material" or something... Fat chance. I just want to be together with you!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/喝饮料/文本1
records.text: How does it taste, dear customer?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/点击喝一杯/文本1
records.text: Want a drink? Sure thing! Allow me to pour it for you!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/上限/文本1
records.text: You've drunk quite a bit... Do you need me to take you home? I promise to return you to your room in one piece.
Conductor {playername}. I've heard a lot about you. Looks like I finally get to see you in the flesh... (chuckles) I'm Toki, governor of Ranshin City. Here's to a solid partnership.
No need to be uptight. You can speak your mind.

There's a tradition among the elite families of Ranshin City—cultivate a child that's kept hidden from outsiders, with similar appearance, physique, and abilities to the family's successor. Such individuals are called Kagebusha, the "Shadow Dancer".

Night Chains Lesage's new products seem to gain traction in the city recently. Yoizuki sent a few pieces to me specially. They look different from those designs sold elsewhere. She most likely designed them herself. You can have them if you're keen.
Lots of rumors out there make me sound as terrifying as a Shura or Oni, but they can never be fully dispelled no matter what. In that case, it's best I just walk my own path... That's all.
This tachi isn't for decoration. I take meticulous care of it daily... That's right. I'm considered a seeker of martial arts. How could I let the weapons that are virtually my life become dull?
{playername}, it must be exhausting to constantly be on the road. Since you're back, get some rest before we talk business.
There have been quite a lot of talk about you in the city lately. Keep it going. It's a good thing for youngsters to be this proactive.
It seems you're truly an ambitious youngster... Ha! Don't worry. This isn't a criticism.
Oh? Why are you here again?
1. Invest in a city to increase its investment level.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/交谈/文本2
records.text: The fashion sense in Ranshin City is truly intriguing. Just looking at the people on the streets makes me want to try their getup... How about you, Conductor? Wanna try on the outfit that matches my current one?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/交谈/文本1
records.text: How do you like being called "dear customer"? This is Ranshin City, after all! I figured it would be nice to try something different.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/岚心城/进入/文本1
records.text: O' {playername}, my lord, you had me waiting for ages. What do you think of my new outfit, dear customer?
Recent plans...? Hmm, continue crushing bad guys! Just like what I've always been doing. Nothing wrong with that, right?
Word is, the circumstances in Ranshin City are unstable... Don't get me wrong. I have no interest in authority. It's just, this might give me more "hunting opportunities"... Hehe.
Please take this love letter~! Ah, of course it's not a love letter. Take a look. It's crucial intel. Now, you owe me a favor.
Hmm? Night Chains' recent activities? There's a high price to pay when getting intel from me. Are you ready for it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/魇/进入兑换/文本1
records.text: Ah, you're here to shop. That's much better than those idiots who "come to admire Miss Maruha." Well, I'll make an exception and play the enthusiastic employee this time.

records.idCN: 大富翁/每分钟地块产出
00NPC对话/武装商店/魇/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Hello~ All right, that's all to my enthusiastic welcoming. Please help yourself now.
The work here is seriously dull. When I'm bored, all I can do is to go outside and watch the birds fly in the sky... Feels like I've been exiled!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/武装商店/魇/成功兑换/文本1
records.text: Thank you for supporting the shop~ Do come back often!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/打开任务列表/打开任务列表1
records.text: Feel free to select whichever one you like. Of course, I can also tell you about the current situation of each place.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/打开任务列表/打开任务列表2
records.text: Are there any orders that catches your eye, Conductor?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/打开商会界面/打开商会界面1
records.text: Hello. Welcome to COLUMBA Ranshin City branch! You may call me Kosuzu. I'll get you some tea!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/打开商会界面/打开商会界面2
records.text: Huh? Other administrators? You mean someone older? Sorry... I'm the only one here. Please let me know if you have any feedback or suggestions.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/打开商会界面/打开商会界面3
records.text: Honestly, Kosuzu... Ah, I'm not exactly matured yet, so I'll have to count on you for many things, Conductor!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/打开商会界面/打开商会界面4
records.text: Dearest {playername}! You're back! Ah, sorry, have I overstepped...? Please pardon me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/打开商会界面/打开商会界面5
records.text: You've been so gentle with me... Words genuinely can't express my appreciation. I can only repay you by doing my best at work.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/打开商会界面/打开商会界面6
records.text: Thank you for continually supporting Ranshin City's business development. ...Um, I'm counting on you in the future too, Conductor!
I was born and raised in Ranshin City. Even though it's gorgeous and prosperous, it's also packed with malicious people... I guess this is exactly what it means by "all that glitters is not gold."
I heard a lot about you from President Medici and always hoped to meet you in real life... It's almost unbelievable that I get to talk to you face to face and hang out with you as friends now.

This bell? It's something that many Ranshin City children wear, meant to pray for the kids' safety and happiness. Mine doesn't have a clapper in it, though. That might be why I... Ah, nothing. Please don't worry.

My hair's getting too long... Truth be told, it takes a lot of time to brush and plait my hair in the morning every day. Conductor, have you seen those cool, short-haired women in movies produced by Night Chains? Kosuzu wants to be like them.
Family? ...Kosuzu no longer has one, but thanks for the concern, Conductor. I'll be strong. ...Will you still come help Kosuzu in the future? There's still so much I don't know...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/接受任务/接受任务1
00NPC对话/商会/小铃/接受任务/接受任务2
records.text: I have faith in you. Kosuzu will wait here for your return!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/取消任务/取消任务1
00NPC对话/商会/小铃/取消任务/取消任务2
records.text: Conductor... are you tired? Why don't you get some rest in the back?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/任务列表为空/任务列表为空1
records.text: Please give me a second to check... All of today's orders have been dealt with. How about you come back tomorrow, Conductor?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/小铃/添加任务/成功1
records.text: The orders at hand... Mm! This should be good!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/交谈/站点限定情报/汇流塔1
records.text: There are few residents and travelers in this station, so the work here is frankly rather laidback.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/交谈/站点限定情报/汇流塔2
records.text: Word has it that everyone in Source Citadel is highly intelligent... Is that true? Can they really save the world?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/交谈/站点限定情报/栖羽站1
records.text: There's a very famous wetland park nearby that many bird-watchers love visiting in hopes of encountering rare bird species.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/交谈/站点限定情报/栖羽站2
records.text: Sumihane means perching birds, beautiful, isn't it? But visitors often talk about how hard it is to pronounce or memorize...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/交谈/站点限定情报/远星大桥1
records.text: Our trading center frequently receives investment funds from HaliFox Salvage. We truly owe them a ton!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/交谈/站点限定情报/远星大桥2
records.text: There are many spots on this bridge ideal for sight-seeing, but conversely, the view on the bridge is also terrifying on stormy days at sea...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/交谈/站点限定情报/云岫桥1
records.text: Heh! In fact, we also supply part of the Reforming Center's material needs, but fret not, we definitely won't get in the way of your business!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/交谈/站点限定情报/云岫桥2
records.text: The majority of the B.C.R.L. employees working at the Yunxiu Bridge Station are hard-working common folks who just can't go out to shop. This is when your help is greatly needed!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/进入交易所/寒暄1
records.text: Hi, hi. I am Tanuki. Yes, yes! Tender, nice and kind!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/进入交易所/寒暄2
records.text: Shapeshift? I do know a little, but this can't be taught to humans. Enough about that. Come taste the snacks I just bought!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/进入交易所/寒暄3
records.text: The air-conditioner has been turned too low these days, the hair on my neck has thickened... Time to brush it...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/进入交易所/寒暄4
records.text: I've run this place in Ranshin City for many years... It's all thanks to my integrity in business. (sighs) Yeah, I am a bit round, but I still have my hands and feet. I'm holding on.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/进入交易所/寒暄5
records.text: The weather's so good today! This sun and breeze... Hey! Don't touch the leaf on my head. Bad things will happen!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/进入交易所/寒暄6
records.text: Hoho, you're basically a regular here now. We'll skip the pleasantries then. What are you looking for today?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/交谈/家族故事/家族故事1
records.text: Hurry! Come try the seasonal tea I just stocked! You're asking about my homeland? Ha, I've been staying put in Ranshin City. How would I know?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/交谈/家族故事/家族故事2
records.text: You want to see my true form? This is it. I don't look the same as those salamanders!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/交谈/家族故事/家族故事3
records.text: From time to time, I'll order some pretty clothes, furniture, and so on and have them delivered to Plutessa and Goldiana. Hmph! If you ask me, young ladies absolutely should doll themselves up... How could they stay with those toads who aren't even willing to get curtains!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/交谈/交易行情/交易行情1
records.text: Rumor has it that {goods} are selling pretty well at {station}!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/交谈/交易行情/交易行情2
records.text: From what I know, {goods} have been in high demand at {station} lately. You better not miss such an opportunity.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/交谈/稀少交易品
records.text: Let me see... Yes, {goods} have been selling like hotcakes everywhere lately. If you still have stock aboard, you should consider cashing them in!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/交谈/站点限定情报/情报1
records.text: Interesting things in the city...? Certainly. It's said that the owner of the ramen store ranked first on the Bonfire Must-Eat List was a yakuza. Did you know that? ...Actually, that rumor is false. Teehee!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/理茂/交谈/站点限定情报/情报2
records.text: The things popularized on the streets tend to come back in fashion every few decades. See, isn't this the style that many people wore when I was younger? Hmm, but I'm merely a tanuki. I guess it's not really my place to discuss fashion...

records.text: Just by the sound of it, I can tell you didn't bring enough Ranshin Koban. Come on, let's go do some odd jobs for BCRL?

帮助/活动帮助/海岛经营/说明
records.text:
Not far from Cape City, there is an undeveloped island awaiting transformation into a summer-themed resort brimming with fantasy adventures under your guidance. As a skilled conductor, you surely can make money while on vacation! Build your island and set out on this exciting new journey!

Event Instructions
Quest
Complete diverse tasks issued by the "Island Authority" to develop your island, raise its level, unlock new facilities, and attract new visitors.

Manage Your Island
Strategically place greenery, decorations, and store amenities to increase the overall rating of your island, raising its level and unlocking new areas. Devise unique marketing tactics to draw more tourists, boosting your island's rating and income.
You can review investments, operations, and collect operation income via Island Authority – Operation Revenue.

Unlock New Stores and Decorations
You can obtain [Material Vouchers] from Island Patrol and Quest. These vouchers can be used for purchasing island facilities and decorations via Island Authority – Decoration Store.

Island Revenue, Cleanliness, and Invaders
Island facilities and decorations accumulate trash over time, requiring regular cleanup of both trash and trash blocks. Trash unhandled for 48 hours reduces your island's Cleanliness, thus impacting the your revenue.
Invaders may show up on your island, impacting your revenue if not eliminated within 48 hours.
Keep an eye on your island's Cleanliness and promptly eliminate invaders.

帮助/活动帮助/大富翁活动/道具说明正文
records.text:
1. In Rumbling Monopolis, you can gather various magical items from battles and events, which can prove invaluable during your journey.

2. Only one item can be used per turn.

3. There is a limit to the number of items you can carry. You cannot carry more items if the limited is reached.

4. Drag items onto the target to use them. Certain items are only usable on specific targets, while others don't require target selection.

5. Traps can only be placed on non-city tiles. Placing a new trap on a tile with an existing one will replace the original trap. Traps set on the starting tile have no effects.

6. After an item is used, its icon will be displayed on the UI. Tap on the icon to check item effects, durations, and remaining uses.

records.idCN: 帮助/活动帮助/大富翁活动/财深与贫琼说明页签
帮助/活动帮助/大富翁活动/财深与贫琼说明正文
records.text:
1. Each day at 12:00, a random salamander will appear on the map, which could either be [Reech] or [Poar].

2. Upon stopping at the salamander's tile, you will receive its blessings. After that, the salamander will follow you.

3. The salamander's blessings will expire at 12:00 the next day.

records.idCN: 帮助/活动帮助/大富翁活动/嚎虎箱说明页签
帮助/活动帮助/大富翁活动/嚎虎箱说明正文
records.text:
1. In every round, a [HowlingBox] will appear on the map, and all players need to collaborate to defeat it.

2. Each player can challenge the [HowlingBox] once per day.

3. Upon a successful challenge, the [HowlingBox] will lose 5% of its Max HP. When its HP is reduced to 0, all players in the round will receive rewards.

4. Failing the challenge grants rewards based on the HowlingBox's remaining HP in the fight, and [HowlingBox] loses HP proportionate to its remaining HP in the fight.

5. You can seek assistance from another player who has participated in Rumbling Monopolis to confront the [HowlingBox].

6. Every day, each player can assist up to 3 friends in challenging the [HowlingBox].

records.idCN: 帮助/活动帮助/大富翁活动/泥嚎箱说明页签
帮助/活动帮助/大富翁活动/泥嚎箱说明正文
records.text:
1. In every round, several [HelloBoxes] will appear on the map.

2. Players need to stop at their tile in order to challenge them.

3. Players can use the item [Noise Kinase] to provoke them and raise their level. Higher level grants better rewards.

4. Players can use the item [Metaplasia Bait] to generate a [HelloBox] at a random location on the map.

5. [HelloBoxes] only vanish when defeated.

records.text:
1. "Rumbling Monopolis" is a sandbox management game passionately created by COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce, with up to 8 players per round, featuring asynchronous interaction between players.

2. At the start of round, each player has a starting fund of 100,000 and 10 dice.

3. After participating in the current round, players can obtain a certain number of dice daily during the game period, with more dice available on weekends.

4. Players can obtain additional dice from 12:00 to 15:00 and 18:00 to 21:00 daily, with more dice available on weekends. Dice have a holding limit.

5. By rolling the dice, the player's train moves according to the points rolled.

6. Each time a player rolls the dice, the game map is refreshed in real-time, including the coordinates of all players and item usage status.

7. Players can only choose a direction to travel when they cannot move forward or are at a station. Direction can also be changed by using certain items.

8. The map contains numerous railway tiles, each with corresponding events.

9. When stopping on a city tile, players can invest in the city, increasing the city's investment level, thereby boosting the city's Funds yield.

10. The Funds generated by the city have a storage limit and must be claimed while on the city tile.

11. "Rumbling Monopolis" lasts 4 rounds, each lasting one week, with rewards settled based on the investment leaderboard across the server. The investment amount does not reset after each round.

12. The rewards for each round of "Rumbling Monopolis" can only be claimed during the next round. After the fourth round ends, the current event's rewards can be claimed from 5:00 on the game ending day until the event page closes.

Overview
I. Join Uncharted Ops
Participating in Uncharted Ops allows you to earn substantial BCRL Coins. Players need to defeat as many enemies as possible within the limited time to gain more Coins.

II. Exchange for Supplies
Participate in Uncharted Ops, and after completing stages or quests, you can obtain "Ops Bonus Pts." Use these points at Redemption to exchange for various rewards such as Silver Branch, Purchase Appl., Self-Observe Film, Train Livery - Demonic Eye and more.

III. Complete Event Quests
This event has event quests that can be viewed through the "Sequence" interface. Complete these quests to gain Chaos Stones, Cactus Lollipops and more.

records.text: You've done well today. Would you like to rest before considering the next leg of the journey?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/成功交付/文本2
records.text: The cargo's too heavy? Don't worry, I'll carry it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/成功交付/文本3

records.text: Did you encounter any danger along the way?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开关卡/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开关卡/文本2
records.text: I won't be able to join you on the field, but I can offer some advice for the battle ahead.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开关卡/文本3
records.text: If you have the capacity, you might consider collecting some samples from the Chaos Remains you defeat in battle—it would be of great help to our ongoing research.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开关卡/文本4
records.text: Members of the Destroyer place particular emphasis on their Ascension Abilities in combat, which may differ somewhat from the tactics you're accustomed to.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开关卡/文本5
records.text: The surrounding area may be affected by a leak from the Unbewusstes, which could give rise to certain anomalies. Please proceed with caution.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: As of today, I am the administrator of Tattle Station. I look forward to working alongside you as a partner from here on, Conductor.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: I have faith in you. I look forward to seeing even more from you going forward.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: You've done well—and not only in my eyes. That much is plain for everyone to see.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: Diligence is admirable, but balance matters as well. If you need to rest, there's an empty room at the end of the corridor; feel free to make use of it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: I must express my gratitude to you as a partner... I know I've said as much before, but allow me to say it once more.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: Everything has gone smoothly so far, and much of that is thanks to you. I hope to continue relying on your assistance going forward. Now then, let's get to work.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开交货/文本1
records.text: I have a great deal of combat experience, though matters of commerce, I admit, remain somewhat unfamiliar to me.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开交货/文本2
records.text: Please be careful of attacks along the way, whether from Chaos Remains or from humans.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开交货/文本3
records.text: I myself have little need for food or daily necessities. Replacement parts and various consumables, however, are difficult to come by out here... I'll be counting on you for those, when the time comes.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/打开交货/文本4
records.text: ...Strange. I've never seen an order quite like this before. Could it have been requested by another Citadel member here on investigation?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/放弃/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/放弃/文本2
records.text: Now then, let's have a look at the new options.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/交谈/文本1
records.text: One moment, please—I'm adjusting the bearing in my hand joint... it won't take long.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/交谈/文本2
records.text: Hungry? As it happens, I can prepare a simple meal using the ingredients you brought earlier. Please wait in your room a while.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/交谈/文本3
records.text: Sommer and Nayuta come to visit here from time to time, under the pretense of attending to official business... though, truthfully, I'd rather they simply admitted, plainly, that they'd taken leave to see family.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/交谈/文本4
records.text: You've already met Nayuta at the Apoaster Bridge, haven't you? It's a comfort to see him standing on his own as a capable member of the Citadel. I have every confidence his future holds a great deal of promise.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/交谈/文本5
records.text: The climate around Tattle Station is extremely dry, ill-suited to plant life. Still, I've managed to cultivate a few common species using equipment brought from Senanonic. If you have the time, would you care to join me in tending to them?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/达斯廷/取消标记/文本1
records.text: Has something changed with the plan?

records.text:
Not far from Cape City, an undeveloped island is about to transform into a summer-themed and fantastical adventure resort under your planning. As an excellent Conductor, you can surely enjoy both vacation and earnings! Build your exclusive island and embark on this unknown adventure!

Friend Island Instructions
Go to Friend Island
On the left side of the island, there is a friend button. Click it to open the friends list, which will show information about friends who have already opened their islands. You can click to visit your friend's island.

Friend Island Activities
(1) You can like a friend's island to increase its popularity.
(2) If there are invasive creatures on a friend's island, you can help drive them away. Your friend will receive rewards, and you will receive 50% of the rewards as compensation. There will be a limit on the number of times, refreshing daily at 5 am.
(3) If a friend's trash bin is full, you can help clean it up for a chance to gain some trash blocks. The chance decreases with the number of successful gains, and your friend's pet will also reduce the probability of gaining trash blocks. The higher the pet's rating, the greater the reduction in probability. Click the button next to the success rate to view details. Each day, there will be a certain number of cleaning opportunities for each friend, refreshing at 5 am daily.
The success rate of gaining trash blocks = base success rate (1) * repeated cleaning reduction rate * pet watching reduction rate.
Repeated cleaning reduction rate = 1 - success reduction rate (0.3) * number of successful cleanings.
Trash blocks gained from cleaning are directly sent to the temporary storage area of the train trash bin.

Visit Records
You can view the history of friends' visits and today's visit records through the visit records in the friend island list.
Today's visit records refresh daily at 5 am.

00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Welcome to my paradise, where you can sing, dance, laugh, and cry... Feel free to showcase your beauty here!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: You arrived a bit late today; what held you back? In this paradise, there are too many fascinating things... If you're only focused on the wonders before you, you might miss your step and fall into the rabbit hole.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: The more you polish, the more dazzling your brilliance becomes!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: Come draw a card, hmm... I guess you drew the six of spades. This isn't the kind of magic you think it is; it's predetermined fate. Take it; this is a good card that matches your efforts.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: This child has been a bit excited since just now, it seems to have sensed in advance that you would come over... Being favored by it is something you can boast about, okay?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: Ah... I'm really getting more and more curious about how you can transform to become even more beautiful... Since that's the case, you shouldn't be held back in place anymore... This feeling of contradiction and joy is truly spine-tingling.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开关卡/文本1
records.text: Battle, what a forbidden and captivatingly cruel aesthetics it is.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开关卡/文本2
records.text: What type are you? Fighting fiercely until you're covered in bloodbath, or do your hands remain completely spotless?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开关卡/文本3
records.text: From the sweetness of candies and pastries, one can faintly smell the scent of metal and gunpowder... It's truly beautiful.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开关卡/文本4
records.text: Give me a chance to see for myself, will you? The way you lead them in battle.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开关卡/文本5
records.text: Your defeated appearance must also be very beautiful... Ah, but most people prefer to hear something like "wish you a triumphant return," right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开交货/文本1
records.text: Humans are creatures driven by various desires.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开交货/文本2
records.text: From these needs, it is easy to determine this person's requirements and thus seize their weaknesses... These techniques might be useful for you as well, right?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开交货/文本3
records.text: "Something that feels a bit strange"? Because I always hope to collect beautiful things as much as possible...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开交货/文本4
records.text: Although not human, this child will also have things it wants, you know?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/成功交付/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/成功交付/文本2
records.text: Let me surprise you in return! For example, what can I conjure up with this hat?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/成功交付/文本3
records.text: Oh, this child... looking at its appearance, it seems to be affirming your achievements as well.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/成功交付/文本4
records.text: Oh my, oh my, so perfect that it makes me want to grab your hand right now and dance a piece together, immersed in the joyful rhythm!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/交谈/文本1
records.text: I once tried working as a fortune teller, watching the vulnerable lambs open their hearts to strangers like that, it was truly hard to resist... This easily attainable pleasure is not bad to enjoy occasionally.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/交谈/文本2
records.text: Do you want to touch this child? Then feel free to try... Did it dodge? Yes, that child doesn't really like being touched... Haha, your disappointed expression is really interesting.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/交谈/文本3
records.text: I heard you drink a lot of black tea on the train. Would you like to try this cup topped with frosted cream? Hmm, it seems you're quite open to new things. There used to be someone who only drank green tea made in the most traditional way and never got tired of it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/交谈/文本4
records.text: Whether it's used for casual competition or magic performances, you must ensure complete control over the hand cards. You too should firmly hold your own cards and make sure not to lose them.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/交谈/文本5
records.text: Does the strawberry-flavored Snow Mountain Parfait from Night Chains Land suit your taste? Hayabusa can't stop eating it every time he comes... Is he the one who mentioned it to you? It seems he really likes you. But as for Arina, she would probably only let you eat things she's made herself.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/放弃/文本1
records.text: Are you pursuing the perfection in your mind?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/放弃/文本2
records.text: Unnecessary things should be discarded... You are an efficiency expert.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/标记/文本1
records.text: As swift and imposing as a hunter striking its prey!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/标记/文本2
records.text: Just like the irresistible arrows of Love!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/取消标记/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/取消标记/文本2
records.text: Hehe, it doesn't matter, because this is a place where magic is effective, so once an arrow is shot, it can still turn back.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开兑换/文本1
records.text: If possible, I truly wish to offer all beautiful things here! But my ability is still not enough to match my ambition...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/歌德/打开兑换/文本2
records.text: The choices you make can reveal the most urgent needs, and what form does your desire take? It's truly intriguing.

records.idCN: 帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城/地图内容
records.text:
1.The Night Chains Land map has 4 starting points. Players will start from 1 of them randomly.

2. The Night Chains Land map has 20 floors. Players can only continue to the next floor from their current floor. They can move to any of the 3 tiles ahead: front-left, front, or front-right.

3. Various recreations await you in Night Chains Land, including 10 fixed structures and random ones scattered throughout the map. The Witch's House is where you can't miss out, while the Castle is the final destination. There, you must defeat the final boss, Mournful Witch Serena.

4. Recreational facilities within structures are fixed, but those activies of random ones are different each round. Check the mini-map to see their locations.

2. When starting a round, the Invitation you use will randomly turn into a Snowflake Invitaion, Tinder Invitation or Blitz Invitation.

3. Snowflake Invitaion, Tinder Invitation and Blitz Invitation have different buffs.

records.idCN: 帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城/美梦徽记内容
records.text:
1. Dream Emblems can be obtained mainly from Battles and Emblem events. They are important for your combat power, so please collect as many as possible.

2. Dream Emblems must be activated for their buffs to take effect.

3. Dream Emblems can be upgraded to enhance their buffs.

4. Their levels do not reset after finishing a round of game.

5. There a chance for Dream Emblems to appear in shops.

records.text:
1.The Float randomly appears on a tile along movement path each round and starts moving in a random direction. Players and the Float move simultaneously.

2. The Float consists of 5 carriages and occupies 3 tiles on the Night Chains Land map. It moves 2 tiles per move. Step onto the Float to encounter it.

3. Encountering the Float grants Gems and rewards.

4. You cannot obtain rewards from the Float the second time you encounter it in the same round.

records.idCN: 帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城/游玩项目内容
records.text:
1. There are 9 types of events, including: Battle, Special Battle, Emblem, Polishing, Treasure, Encounter, Shop, Broom, and Worn-out Broom.

2. Events:

— Battle: Win to claim rewards. Failure will cost you 20 AP.

— Special Battle: Win to claim tradable goods. Failure will cost you 20 AP.

— Emblem: Obtain [Dream Emblem] and [Dream Shard].

— Polishing: Upgrade [Dream Emblem].

— Treasure: Obtain random rewards.

— Encounter: Obtain random rewards or assistance, and unlock content in the "Cocoon of Memories" gallery.

— Shop: Use [Dream Shard] to purchase [Treasure Box Item].

— Broom: Widen the movement range to 5 tiles in front and reduce the AP cost for this movement to 0. Gain a [Box of Dreams].

— Worn-out Broom: Randomly move to 1 of the 5 tiles in front and reduce the AP cost for this movement to 0. Gain a [Box of Dreams].

records.text:
1. There are 10 facilities in Night Chains Land: Candy House, Divination Room, Fountain, Ferris Wheel, Broom Academy, Carousel, Garden, Teahouse, Witch's Home and Castle. Each facility offers a certain event and a Gem of a random color (except for Castle).

2. Events:

— Candy House / Divination Room: Polishing.

— Fountain: Treasure and random Tracker.

— Ferris Wheel: A 3-minute consecutive battle.

— Broom Academy: A 3-minute consecutive battle.

— Carousel: 5 consecutive battles.

— Garden / Teahouse: An Encounter and a Teatime Blessing.

— Witch's Home: A Boss battle with limited HP.

— Castle: A Boss battle with unlimited HP. Higher DMG grants higher score, which will be recorded in the Leaderboard.

records.text:
Polishing

Overview
1. About Polishing
When you have a polishable Emblem and arrive at the Candy House, Divination Room, or encounter a Polishing event, you will gain 1 attempt to polish an Emblem.

2. How to Polish
The Polishing interface will display the polishable Emblems you own. You can choose one to polish, which will deduct 1 attempt and consume materials.

3. Leave the Event
Your Polishing attempts will be cleared once you leave the Polishing event.

records.idCN: 咕卡/美梦徽记帮助/1内容
records.text:
Dream Emblem

Overview
1. How to Use Emblems
Dream Emblems you own are shown in this window. Click on an Emblem to paste it on the board. Its details are shown on the left. You can rotate and move the Emblem to place it on unoccupied blocks.

2. Emblem Buffs
Once the Emblem is pasted on the board, its effect will be activated. You can view all activated buffs in Emblem Buff menu.

records.text:

2. Blue Tile: "Around-the-Clock." Enter a shop that sells Ascents, Dice, and Intuitions.

3. Yellow Tile: "Trinket." Gain random Ascent, Dice, and Intuition.

records.text:
1. Conductor acts first in a turn.

2. Conductor needs to use Move and Rotate actions in any order.

3. Move: Move to an adjacent tile.

4. Rotate: Rotate the current row in 90 degrees.

5. Singularity's Turn: After Conductor finishes the actions, Singularity will also use Move and Rotate once. And when Singularity moves, the previous tile will be destroyed, and Singularity will gain a buff.

6. An Action Point is consumed when both Conductor and Singularity finish their turns.

records.text: Didn't expect a conductor to run into something as embarrassing as insufficient funds... okay, I'm just kidding. Doesn't happen often, but I'm sure you'll be back soon enough with plenty to invest.

No need to talk extra loud with me, I've got earphones on but I'm not actually listening to music. You wouldn't want to be yelling into your communicator during a remote meeting either, right? Yeah, that's basically it.

Free time? Uh... I don't really have any... hobbies to speak of. If I had to say something, I've been trying out some social mixers and cocktail parties lately—a-and no, I definitely didn't drink too much, and I absolutely did not pass out on the side of the road! What are you even thinking!
This brooch... I've had it for years, been wearing it since I was just a regular City Hall employee. A friend gave it to me back then. Though... we're not really in touch anymore.
Work matters, sure, but don't let it eat into the time you spend with the people around you. I mean it, nothing's more important than the people you care about.
I've been thinking about getting a new office chair lately... this one's giving me a bit of back and shoulder pain, though it might just be from sitting and reading paperwork too long.
Since we've built up a good working relationship based on trust, I can offer you a few conveniences within my means. There's snacks and coffee in the lounge, want to try some?

Gronru City's commercial scene is pretty developed, but you're probably still not too familiar with how the city's laid out, right? If you want to check out a luxury store or book a table at some restaurant, feel free to just use my name.
...Hm? Oh, sorry, I was thinking about something else. I do space out sometimes at work. Not that surprising, is it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/奥罗拉/打开商会界面/打开商会界面3
records.text: What a pleasure to find you here—we happen to be short-handed at the moment.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/奥罗拉/打开商会界面/打开商会界面4
records.text: Simply seeing you seems to lighten my burden somehow. Oh? Perhaps it's only in my mind? Still, that you inspire such a feeling speaks well of you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/奥罗拉/打开商会界面/打开商会界面5

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/商会/奥罗拉/打开商会界面/打开商会界面6
records.text: Please, don't hesitate to ask if there's anything I might assist with. You've shown me a great deal of kindness over the years, after all.

(yawn) Weather like this always brings back memories of napping on a sun-warmed hillside as a child, lying in the grass and feeling the distant train rumble along the tracks... oh, forgive me, did I drift off for a moment?
You seem in rather good spirits today. I take it whatever was troubling you last time has been resolved? There's no need to thank me, though—I was merely lending an ear.

The president is a woman most worthy of admiration, though I do often worry she takes on too much. Since she has entrusted this work to me, I ought to shoulder more of it myself, if only to spare her some of that burden.

Gronru City is truly a fine place to settle. Indeed, many say as much. I'm quite fond of its grand, lively festivities as well... how lovely it would be, if one day everyone could raise a glass at the carnival without a single care in the world.
Do wait a moment—if you'd like to wash your hands, perhaps try this instead. Pleasant, isn't it? A specialty of Gronru City. Please, take it if you're fond of it—I have plenty more to spare.

records.text:
Welcome to the Friends' Carriage!

Friends' Carriage Instructions
Visit Friends' Carriage
Above the avatar in your carriage, there is a button [Visit Friends' Carriage]. Click it to open the friends list, where your friends will be displayed. You can click the button [Go to Carriage] to access the friend's carriage.

What can you do in the Friends' Carriage?
(1) You can swipe left or right to view the layout of the Friends' Carriage.
(2) If the trash bin in the Friends' Carriage is full, you can help clean it up and have a chance to gain some trash blocks. The probability decreases with the number of successful gains, and the friend's pet will also decrease the probability of gaining trash blocks. The higher the pet's rating, the greater the decrease in probability. You can click the button next to the success rate to view details. Each friend has a certain number of cleaning attempts daily, which refreshes at 5 am every day.
Success rate of gaining trash blocks = Base success rate (1) * Probability reduction for repeated cleaning * Probability of pet guarding
Probability reduction for repeated cleaning = 1 - Success reduction rate (0.3) * Number of times cleaned successfully
Trash blocks gained from cleaning are directly sent to the temporary storage area of the train garbage bin.

Visit Records
You can check the friends' visit records through the cleaning record in the friends list.
Today's visit records refresh at 5 am every day.

records.text: Welcome in. ...I do hope you have a lovely time here in Gronru City, Conductor. Though, of course, it'd be even lovelier if you came around to see me more often~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/喝饮料/文本1
records.text: Do you like it? There's plenty more where that came from.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/点击喝一杯/点击喝一杯1
records.text: Come now, this was specially prepared by Arina to celebrate your arrival~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/交谈/文本1
records.text: Might be to keep the locals happy, but Gronru City has quite the long seaside promenade—the travel magazines call it "the most beautiful" one around. If you're looking to clear your head, Conductor, that'd be a fine place to start... and of course, I'd be more than happy to walk it with you!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/交谈/文本2
records.text: Miss Neph at City Hall may seem hard to get along with, but she's honestly fair to everyone. She stops by my place every so often after work to drown her sorrows in a drink... hehe, don't worry, I always make sure she doesn't overdo it—no need to worry about her on my account~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/交谈/文本3
records.text: Miss Goldiana has such forward-thinking taste in fashion... she's a regular at the luxury boutiques, you can tell just by looking at her. So tell me, Conductor, what do you think of her style? If Arina dressed like that too... would you like it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/交谈/文本4
records.text: Lately, Arina's been thinking of you an awful lot... you're becoming more and more important to more and more people, which means you'll be away from Arina's side even longer. ...Just thinking about that makes me terribly sad. But you'd never abandon Arina, would you?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/交谈/文本5
records.text: I caught wind of something from my superiors... but nothing's settled yet, so I can't say just what to you, Conductor. It's not bad news, mind you, but something's about to shift with the situation around the railway loop—do keep an eye out.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/交谈/文本6
records.text: By Gronru tradition, the largest carnival on the Western Continent is held here every year—everyone's free to indulge without a shred of restraint... people usually come with friends, or with someone special. If you're thinking of joining in, Conductor, you simply must invite Arina!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/交谈/文本7
records.text: Conductor, are you free tonight? Any restaurant you've had your eye on? Don't worry yourself over the price or a reservation—wherever you'd like, Arina will get you the very best seat in the house.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/交谈/文本8
records.text: I just received a new perfume, a gift from Night Chains Lesage—they wanted me to try it before it hits the market... would you like a whiff, Conductor? I'm sure you'll love this scent❤

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/浏览/浏览1
records.text: Ever since the Western Continent railway loop got back up and running, the selection of goods has grown so much richer.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/浏览/浏览2
records.text: That these goods make it here safely, well, that's all thanks to you keeping the routes secure, Conductor... you really are the best there is!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/贡露城/上限/上限1
records.text: Care for another drink—oh, wait, no! Didn't you say you'd hold back a little? Arina will keep an eye on you then❤ That's enough for today—do come back tomorrow, Conductor~

records.text: Oh my, welcome. I'm the proprietor of this little shop for the time being. As for how I run it, well — since I'm the one who's taught all those children their manners, I doubt there's much to worry about there... What do you think, Conductor?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/海伦娜/浏览商品/文本1
records.text: All of this was bought fair and square from the Grottlings. The little ones are starting to get the hang of "currency" and "goods" too.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/海伦娜/浏览商品/文本2
records.text: Don't worry about the quality of the goods — I've checked every piece myself.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/海伦娜/购入商品/文本1
records.text: Here, take this. Hm? You'd like me to wrap it up myself? Of course.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/海伦娜/购入商品/文本2
records.text: Want to borrow a familiar or two from Olivien to help carry it?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/海伦娜/购入商品/文本3
records.text: I've cast a small spell onto this item to boost your luck, you know.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/海伦娜/商品售罄/文本1
records.text: Looks like that one's sold out already... but if you really want it, I might be able to track some down for you later.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/活动/海伦娜/货币不足/文本1
records.text: Hm? Not quite enough coin on you... here, use mine — heh, just teasing. I'm not about to bail you out for no reason. I'm not the sort of elder who spoils children unconditionally, you know. Learning to manage your money matters too.
As the little ones' ideas and habits keep changing, the look of this village keeps changing right along with them... Seems even lifeless little familiars can develop something like human society.
If you're interested in magic, why not let Livia become my student instead? Magic turns out differently in different hands, and I'm rather looking forward to seeing how far she gets with it.

You want to learn magic from me too? ...Sadly, I can't teach you anything on that front for now. But I'll say this much — the potential in you is a match for anyone's... it's the kind of power that could change the world, even.
Running this little shop is easy work — the Grottlings handle most of it... and I take care of the rest with magic.

"The Ageless Witch and Her Children"...? Ha, I know the one — that so-called "Mundus Empire fairy tale" that circulates on the surface. I even came across it once in a bookshop. Let's just say... it's rather far from the truth.

Content Overview
1. Complete event storyline "Exodus de la Terre"
Accompanied by earth-shattering sounds, a mysterious outlander breaks the peace of a "dwarf" village. Hot springs, new friends, colorful magic; mysterious tribe, unexplored places, shadows lurking underground, and the so-called "Bofay"… Step by step, approach the truth and compose the "Exodus de la Terre"!

2. New battle stages available
The event offers 8 character trial stages, where Conductors can experience the charm and strength of the outlander "Slokai" in advance. Additionally, 8 recurring stages will be available for Conductors to repeatedly challenge and gain rich rewards.

3. Overcome stages to gain rewards
Conductors participating in the event can gain "Grottling Coins" by clearing battle stages. Conductors can exchange them at the Grottling Shop for limited Recruit Protocols, UR equipment, limited avatars, Laplace Protocol, Silver Branches, Purchase Appl., Self-Observe Film, and other various rewards.

4. Complete event tasks to gain abundant rewards
The event features event quests. Completing them to claim Grottling Coins, Self-Observe Film, Cactus Lollipop, and card packs as rewards.
※ The limited card packs can only be obtained during the "Exodus de la Terre" event. The card pack contains 7 newly designed cards, which can be collected after completing all stage rewards and achievements. The cards will have new uses in future versions, please look forward to it.

records.text: Next time I have leave, I want to go see the kids who like playing with me and do some magic tricks for them. Been too busy with work lately, haven't gone in a while. Do you... want to come with me?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/放弃/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开关卡/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: So this is what it's like, working alongside you... it's nothing, I'd just imagined how this might go, before.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开兑换/文本1
records.text: Per Citadel regulations, an item of equal value is required for the exchange...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: Give me a moment, I'll be right there once I finish this.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: Seems you're still not quite used to seeing me standing here. Want me to use a bit of illusion so you can look past it, for now?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开建筑/文本6
00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开建筑/文本4
00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开兑换/文本2
records.text: ...You're saying I don't smell like blood anymore? Mm. I took care of that, some time ago. It shouldn't linger anymore.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开关卡/文本3
00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开交货/文本1
records.text: I've already learned how to operate this system, so it shouldn't be a problem.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开关卡/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开交货/文本2
records.text: If you run into any trouble along the way, let me know. I'll take care of it.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开关卡/文本5
records.text: ...Though with you here, I suppose there's not much need for me to leave my post.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开关卡/文本4
records.text: When it's necessary, I'll leave the management center too, to deal with certain "matters out there."

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/成功交付/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开交货/文本4
records.text: Have you seen Mr. Dustin or Sommer recently? ...Ah, just asking. It's been a while since I've been back.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/成功交付/文本2
records.text: I'll have a robot come collect it shortly.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/成功交付/文本3
records.text: Good work today. If you need to rest, the area up ahead has already been cleared out.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/成功交付/文本4
00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/交谈/文本1
records.text: Life here is a bit different from being out in the field. It's a major transit hub, so there's a lot of traffic coming through, but oddly enough, it's also a good place to just... clear your head.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开交货/文本3
records.text: The Apoaster Bridge is an important transfer point, so the range of orders here is quite extensive.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/交谈/文本4
records.text: Sorry, about leading you into danger before, for the sake of following Lady Lissandra's orders. ...I'll try to see that it doesn't happen again.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/交谈/文本3
records.text: Eat together? ...There's not much of a kitchen here, and nothing particularly good to eat, just rations and boxed meals... no, wait. Give me a moment. I'll put something together for you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/放弃/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/交谈/文本2
records.text: I don't sleep on the job. If I need rest, I'll go to the break room. ...You're saying I could do that on the Eternal too... true enough. Understood. Next time I'm tired, I'll come find you.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: Hello. Starting today, and for the time being, I'll be taking over operations at the Apoaster Bridge. ...Do you need me to introduce myself again? ...Ahem. I'm Nayuta. I look forward to working with you from here on.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/标记/文本1
records.text: Don't push yourself too hard... that's what Mr. Dustin always tells me, before I leave home.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/标记/文本2
records.text: I hope everything goes smoothly for you along the way.

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/那由他/取消标记/文本2
records.text: If that's your decision, I have no objections.

records.text:
过往已被焚烧殆尽，所以迷雾蔽日遮天。
别让恐惧封闭耳朵，去听吧，祂的呓语，祂的……哀鸣……

内容概况
一、完成活动剧情，聆听“林间呓语”
一封送给乘员的“家书”，来自向外界封闭已久的维蒂林场。怀抱着疑问和恐惧向雾中深入，寻觅微渺却温暖的一星光亮……群树在向你倾诉，也将诱惑你永留此地。
勿要投身火中。

二、全新战斗关卡开放 享受全新挑战
活动期间，“林间呓语”中将开放8个“散雾”联动限定角色试用关卡，列车长们可以提前体验异乡来客“赫卡蒂”，见证她的魅力与实力。另外，还将开放8个“驱瘴”周回关卡，列车长们可重复挑战，获取丰厚奖励。

三、攻克关卡，获取奖励
参与“林间呓语”活动的列车长可以通过攻略战斗关卡获得“树泪”，并凭借“树泪”在"维蒂杂货铺"中换取联动限定抽卡券、联动限定UR、联动限定头像、拉普拉斯协议、银枝、进货采买书、自观测胶卷等多种奖励。

四、完成活动成就，获取丰富奖励
本次“林间呓语”活动中设置了活动任务系统“实习生手册”。只要在活动期间达成任务条件，即可领取树泪、自观测胶卷、仙人掌能量棒棒糖、纪念卡包·林间呓语等奖励。※“纪念卡包·林间呓语”目前仅能在“林间呓语”活动中获取。卡包内含7张全新设计的卡牌，完成全部阶段奖励以及成就后即可集齐。卡牌在未来版本中会有全新用途，请列车长多多期待。

00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/放弃/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开关卡/文本1
records.text: 在林子里要随时注意安全。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: 来了啊。等完成工作以后有东西要给你带走，别忘了拿。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开兑换/文本1
records.text: 要什么就和我说，这儿没什么值钱的东西，但有的东西别处也拿不到。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: 之前不是已经作过自我介绍了吗？我是贝尔法斯特。虽然拗口，但你记得住吧？

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开建筑/文本3
records.text: 就算不记得我也没关系。对于森林来说，我这个人无关紧要。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开建筑/文本6
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: 虽然你们都说不需要回报，但我不喜欢欠人情。我会想办法给你们帮忙的。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开兑换/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开关卡/文本3
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开交货/文本1
records.text: 年轻人的品味变成这样了吗……

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开关卡/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开交货/文本2
records.text: 系统是其他人帮忙弄的，我看不太懂。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开关卡/文本4
records.text: 我看你们也不需要猎枪防身。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/成功交付/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开交货/文本4
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/成功交付/文本2
records.text: 细胳膊细腿的，力气估计不如我大……别想着帮忙了，在这休息吧。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/成功交付/文本3
records.text: 嗯……呃……好了。然后呢，你是不是就下班了？

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开关卡/文本5
records.text: 等你们清理完林子里的东西以后，我会去巡逻。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/取消标记/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/成功交付/文本4
records.text: 这也算是善后工作的一部分。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/交谈/文本1
records.text: 萝赛说她暂时先不回去。林场确实还需要人手，她也帮上不少忙……但让已经在外面成了家的人不得不留在这里……真不像样啊，我们这里的人。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开交货/文本3
records.text: 稀奇古怪的东西要是出现了你就删掉。夏尔说那是什么……植物广告？直入广告……？

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/交谈/文本4
records.text: 跟你走的那两个孩子怎么样？……假如在城里过得不好，这里还是欢迎她们回来，好歹会给她们留口饭吃、留个地方住。不懂非要去城里干什么……但要过得好的话，也就罢了。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/交谈/文本3
records.text: 这段时间村子里没再死人了，我也不需要总去“处理”……真像做梦。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/放弃/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/交谈/文本2
records.text: 归雾节……哼，估计还会再有。但他们还敢像以前那样乱来的话，我第一个不准。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/标记/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/打开建筑/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/取消标记/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/标记/文本2
00NPC对话/作战中心/贝尔法斯特/交谈/文本5
records.text: 呼……我刚从林子里巡逻回来。真冷，但这才是现在该有的……这才是我想看到的林子……

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/镇长助理/放弃/文本1
records.text: 当然，当然，这就为您看看有没有更好的。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/镇长助理/打开关卡/文本1
records.text: 这些任务都很危险，为了各位的安全还请千万不要贸然……能不能请您带来的那位鹅别啄、啊！！！

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/镇长助理/打开兑换/文本1
records.text: 有什么看中的东西尽管和我说啊，什么都行，千万别客气！

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/镇长助理/打开交货/文本1
records.text: 业务视察团居然还能兼运输物资，哎呀……您的规划水平真是高超！

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/镇长助理/成功交付/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/镇长助理/交谈/文本1
records.text: 虽然外界对林场总有些奇怪的传闻，但我作为土生土长的本地人可以保证，这儿可是个人杰地灵的好地方，最适合休养生息了。您带领的团队如果有休假安排，不妨考虑常来？

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/镇长助理/标记/文本1
00NPC对话/作战中心/镇长助理/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: 您好、您好，平时可没什么大商会的业务团队会来林场，您几位愿意来真是让这儿蓬荜生辉！

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/镇长助理/取消标记/文本1
records.text: 哎呀，要我说这单子确实不做也罢……

records.text: “归雾节”是林场一带的传统，好像从许多年前就一直举办，直到现在。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/交易所/交易所学徒/交谈/站点限定情报/维蒂林场2
records.text: “归雾节”是林场一带的传统，好像从许多年前就一直举办，直到现在。
夏尔那孩子如果她太闹腾了，还请你多多包涵……不过你们相处的时间已经那么久了，我一点儿也不担心你们之间会有问题。
夏尔的妹妹、我的小女儿……她确实还在上学，不过她读的是篝火城里的寄宿制学校，当时她自己要去的。我家那口子还说不放心她一个人出去读书，我把他狠狠地训了一顿！他真是木头！

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/兑换站/萝赛/兑换成功/文本1
records.text: 眼光不错！哈哈，不过我也不知道这东西在外面的价格多少……但列车长选的东西，肯定没错，这我有信心。
贝尔法斯特先生很固执？哈哈，人年纪大了就容易这样，我们花了好久才劝他接受了现在的状况……不过他找来的蘑菇、松果之类都很好吃的！他要是给你硬塞的话，你一定别推辞呀。
小时候我也在林场生活，最喜欢的事是爬到果树上帮忙摘果子，当时哪知道后来林子会变成这样……哎呀，真是过了好久呢，我也是个阿姨了。……啊，不说这些！我新熬了果酱，大家吃不吃？
光是能时不时和你们这么见上一面，我就很开心了。这儿也是我的家呀，我一点都不觉得无聊！

1. Conductor may consume BCRL Coins to perform Goods Investment, which increases the purchase quantity and stock capacity of designated goods in the current city.

2. When performing Goods Investment, Conductor will also gain Reputation for that city.

3. Goods Investment starts at Level 0, with a current maximum investment level of 20.

4. The maximum investment amount at one time is affected by the city's Reputation. The investment capacity can be reset by re-entering the city.

5. The upgrade effects only apply to the city where Goods Investment has been performed.

6. Goods Investment at each station will be unlocked in multiple phases. The second phase will unlock after all investments in the first phase reach Level 10, and so on for subsequent phases.

7. Conductor must meet the specific Reputation requirements of the corresponding city before being able to invest. If the requirements are not met, clicking the corresponding Goods Investment button will display the required Reputation conditions.

8. For every 100 million BCRL Coins cumulatively spent on Goods Investment, the purchase quantity of all goods in all cities will increase by 1%.

records.text:
生与死的界限是时速180公里，
在这趟无法停止的曙光号上，
我们要如何驶向明天？

内容概况
一、完成活动剧情
当承载希望的新型列车成为毁灭的隐患，在真正的不幸发生之前，心系铁路的人们能否找到通往明日的一丝希望？

二、全新战斗关卡开放 享受全新挑战
活动期间，“曙光号爆破事件”中将开放8个“治安确保”剧情关卡，通过挑战剧情关卡，列车长将协助查明曙光号爆破事件背后的阴谋。另外，还将开放8个“危机对应”高难周回关卡，列车长们可重复挑战，获取丰厚奖励。

三、攻克关卡，获取奖励
参与“曙光号爆破事件”活动的列车长可以通过攻略战斗关卡获得“曙光代金券”，并凭借“曙光代金券”在"补给站"中换取限定抽卡券、限定UR、限定头像、拉普拉斯协议、银枝、进货采买书、自观测胶卷等多种奖励。

四、完成活动成就，获取丰富奖励
本次“曙光号爆破事件”活动中设置了活动任务系统“重要事项”。只要在活动期间达成任务条件，即可领取曙光代金券、自观测胶卷、仙人掌能量棒棒糖、纪念卡包·曙光号爆破事件等奖励。※“纪念卡包·曙光号爆破事件”目前仅能在“曙光号爆破事件”活动中获取。卡包内含7张全新设计的卡牌，完成全部阶段奖励以及成就后即可集齐。卡牌在未来版本中会有全新用途，请列车长多多期待。

records.text:
内容概况
火啊，你带来温暖，也降下惩罚，你让宁静消融，也将黑夜烧却。火光之中，何人叙述新的骑士篇章——
一、完成活动剧情
矛盾随火星在城市之间悄悄扩散，沉睡的故事即将醒来。而在熟悉的咖啡厅内，伴随劲爆乐声，一片白色的羽毛静静飘落……

二、全新战斗关卡开放 享受全新挑战
活动期间，“曼杜斯骑士谭：烈焰篇”中将开放8个“炽烈乐章”剧情关卡。另外，还将开放8个“传颂史诗”高难周回关卡，列车长们可重复挑战，获取丰厚奖励。

三、攻克关卡，获取奖励
参与“曼杜斯骑士谭：烈焰篇”活动的列车长可以通过攻略战斗关卡获得“不死鸟尾羽”，并凭借“不死鸟尾羽”在"新月咖啡厅"中换取限定抽卡券、限定UR、限定头像、拉普拉斯协议、银枝、进货采买书、自观测胶卷等多种奖励。

四、完成活动成就，获取丰富奖励
本次“曼杜斯骑士谭：烈焰篇”活动中设置了活动任务系统“重要事项”。只要在活动期间达成任务条件，即可领取不死鸟尾羽、自观测胶卷、仙人掌能量棒棒糖、纪念卡包·曼杜斯骑士谭：烈焰篇等奖励。※“纪念卡包·曼杜斯骑士谭：烈焰篇”目前仅能在“曼杜斯骑士谭：烈焰篇”活动中获取。卡包内含7张全新设计的卡牌，完成全部阶段奖励以及成就后即可集齐。卡牌在未来版本中会有全新用途，请列车长多多期待。

records.text:
吾等应滋生繁衍、充满大地。
寻觅乐事，帮助友邻，
得呼唤时便要应声。
等到一切的事都完成以后，
就是安歇的时候了。

“……意思是说，矮子也会放假吗？”

内容概况
一、完成活动剧情，寻求“应许之憩”
窟灵族的度假村已经建成迎客，温泉浴场亟待打扫……本该温馨宁静的日常，却突然被一位陌生的异乡来客打破。消失的神圣盔甲，梦游的窟灵族……解决工作就能得到保证的假期这种好事，真的存在吗？

二、全新战斗关卡开放 享受全新挑战
活动期间，“应许之憩”中将开放8个“轻松游览”联动限定角色试用关卡，列车长们可以提前体验异乡来客“迪妮莎”，见证她的魅力与实力。另外，还将开放8个“紧急安保”周回关卡，列车长们可重复挑战，获取丰厚奖励。

三、攻克关卡，获取奖励
参与“应许之憩”活动的列车长可以通过攻略战斗关卡获得“窟灵纪念币”，并凭借“窟灵纪念币”在游客中心换取联动限定抽卡券、联动限定头像、拉普拉斯协议、银枝、进货采买书、自观测胶卷等多种奖励。

四、完成活动成就，获取丰富奖励
本次“应许之憩”活动中设置了活动任务系统“维护事项”。只要在活动期间达成任务条件，即可领取窟灵纪念币、自观测胶卷、仙人掌能量棒棒糖等奖励。

records.text:
有小城名为武林源。山水环抱，湖光与茶园相映，屋舍廊桥，四时景致各有不同。春赏花开，夏听荷风，秋观桂影，冬踏雪痕，市井小店，茶香药香常伴。
孩童嬉戏于河畔石桥，长者闲坐于柳下长廊，岁月自成秩序，不知外世之喧嚣……

内容概况
一、完成活动剧情，游叙“武林源记”
一觉醒来，你失去了出生长大途中经历的所有记忆。白发女孩儿慌忙地握住你的手——在与她共同生活于武林的日子里，你渐渐回忆起关于踏枝山庄、虎跃堂、西湖以及这武林的一切……等等，成亲又是什么意思？！

二、全新战斗关卡开放 享受全新挑战
活动期间，“武林源记”中将开放8个“镇仪”联动限定角色试用关卡，列车长们可以提前体验“蓝鹊儿”，见证她的魅力与实力。另外，还将开放8个“祓禊”周回关卡，列车长们可重复挑战，获取丰厚奖励。

三、攻克关卡，获取奖励
参与“武林源记”活动的列车长可以通过攻略战斗关卡获得“交子”，并凭借“交子”在湖滨市集中换取联动限定抽卡券、限定UR、特设限定头像、拉普拉斯协议、银枝、进货采买书、自观测胶卷等多种奖励。

四、完成活动成就，获取丰富奖励
本次“武林源记”活动中设置了活动任务系统“镖书簿”。只要在活动期间达成任务条件，即可领取交子、自观测胶卷、仙人掌能量棒棒糖、纪念卡包·武林源记等奖励。※“纪念卡包·武林源记”目前仅能在“武林源记”活动中获取。卡包内含7张全新设计的卡牌，完成全部阶段奖励以及成就后即可集齐。卡牌在未来版本中会有全新用途，请列车长多多期待。

records.text: 欢迎光临！客官随便挑——噢哟，这不是虎跃堂少主嘛！
这个？这个没有了哦！真不好意思，下回我们肯定……
这是武林大哥大，好像也是从前的归乡客带回来的！可以和远处的人说话，方便得很呢！
我家长辈过去可是名厨，还给虎跃堂烧过饭呢！您、您说不记得了？啊……嗯……反正顶顶好吃的，您有机会一定来我家里尝尝！
真个是忙得团团转，一点空闲也……啊！炉子上的汤没关火！！
虽说是一分钱一分货，可您是少主呀……我们不会亏待了您的！

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/美琪/打开建筑/文本1
records.text: 我是代府尹在此处理杂务的巡按使，钱家美琪……不过，叫我美琪就行了。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/美琪/打开建筑/文本2
records.text: 嗯，有什么事？这是……新的账簿，嗯，没错！旧的我收起来了！

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/美琪/交谈/文本5
records.text: 没什么帅气战斗的机会也是好事，至少证明武林太平……呃……嗯？没什么……就是感觉这个话由我来说，有点怪怪的。

records.text: 呃，我现在很忙啊……但接待你的话还是有点空的，说吧，要做些什么？

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/美琪/打开建筑/文本4
records.text: 真羡慕你，不管什么时候都保持着一如既往的态度……我就做不到……好想休假……

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/美琪/打开建筑/文本5
records.text: 我已经对这里的杂务得心应手了！……不对，我的新账簿放在哪个架子上了来着？

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/美琪/打开建筑/文本6
records.text: 呼，不管怎么样，总归让这里的情况走上正轨了。今后也要加油啊！……当然，我是说我们两个都要加油。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/美琪/打开关卡/文本1
records.text: 维护天下太平，这说法很帅吧？

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/美琪/打开关卡/文本2
records.text: 作为“虎跃堂少主”，做这些工作会不会太累了？

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/美琪/打开关卡/文本3
records.text: 嗯……你倒也可以让镖局的下人们来做啦。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/作战中心/美琪/打开关卡/文本4
records.text: 身为巡案使，这些本应我们自己解决……可惜我实在是分身乏术，唔。

帮助/活动帮助/致孩子们/活动说明
records.text:
内容概况
在我们尚是孩子的时候，也曾有蜜糖般的甜梦，彩虹色的生活倾泻而下——现在我们仍知道那梦留在哪儿，即使我们必须再一次长大；随后，我们还要再一次，去找到那些孩子们。
一、完成活动剧情，破解“变小事件”
在给孩子们开展安全教育活动的次日，多萝西和伊洛娜一觉醒来，发现自己也变成了孩子的身体。二人下定决心，一定要找到幕后黑手，将自己变回原样！可是，一切真有这么简单吗？

二、全新战斗关卡开放 享受全新挑战
活动期间，“致孩子们”中将开放“点亮瑰晨”剧情关卡。另外，还将开放8个“童真寻梦”高难周回关卡，列车长们可重复挑战，获取丰厚奖励。

三、攻克关卡，获取奖励
参与“致孩子们”活动的列车长可以通过攻略战斗关卡获得“碎布片儿”，并凭借“碎布片儿”在"秘密基地"中换取限定抽卡券、限定头像、拉普拉斯协议、银枝、进货采买书、自观测胶卷等多种奖励。

四、完成活动成就，获取丰富奖励
本次“致孩子们”活动中设置了活动任务系统“线索核查”。只要在活动期间达成任务条件，即可领取碎布片儿、自观测胶卷、仙人掌能量棒棒糖、纪念卡包·致孩子们等奖励。※“纪念卡包·致孩子们”目前仅能在“致孩子们”活动中获取。卡包内含7张全新设计的卡牌，完成全部阶段奖励以及成就后即可集齐。卡牌在未来版本中会有全新用途，请列车长多多期待。

records.text: 这附近有一些风景秀美的岛屿，乘船很快就到，而且没有人会打扰哦。列车长如果什么时候想去和我度过一段漫长的二人假期的话，请随时告诉我❤

records.text: Welcome to Cape City~Why I'm here? I missed you so much and followed you all the way...

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/海角城/喝饮料/喝饮料1
records.text: How does it taste, dear customer?

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/海角城/上限/上限1
records.text: 啊……好可惜，已经喝不下了吗？没关系，亚莉奈还会尝试更多新的配方，明天也要再来哦，列车长❤

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/海角城/浏览/浏览1
records.text: Honey~ Everything I’ve prepared for you is irresistible!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/海角城/浏览/浏览2
records.text: A suprise among cargoes? Don't miss out!

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/海角城/交谈/交谈1
records.text: 海角城的风景还是一如既往地美丽呢。人家曾经在这里做过一段时间的侍应生……让人印象最深的，应该就是随处可见的学会风格建筑了吧？

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/海角城/交谈/交谈2
records.text: 市长阿莱斯特先生同时也是一位著名的服装设计师……列车长对它的作品有兴趣吗？想穿它设计出的衣服吗？只要您说想要，亚莉奈就可以为您找来哦……但果然还是很想亲耳听列车长说“想要”……啊啊……

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/海角城/交谈/交谈7
records.text: 海角城的水族馆应该是西大陆规模最大的水族馆之一……亚莉奈想要和列车长一起去那里约会，就像是电影里描绘的那样，手牵着手……

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/海角城/交谈/交谈8
records.text: ……亚莉奈的分身们总是在看见列车长的时候非常兴奋呢。这一定是因为我们的心情是一样的……不过，我不允许列车长被任何人夺走，即使是另一个我也不行……请一直看着亚莉奈哦，列车长~

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/海角城/交谈/交谈3
records.text: 铁安局的执勤人员偶尔会有变化哦，您发现了吗？蜜獾小队的各位经常互相替代对方执勤，感情真好呢……亚莉奈也想和列车长做同一份工作。

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/海角城/交谈/交谈4
records.text: 假如在别的地方遇见了态度糟糕的人，欢迎列车长回到这里来哦。亚莉奈无论何时都非常欢迎您~！

records.idCN: 00NPC对话/休息区/海角城/交谈/交谈5
records.text: 街道上经常能看见隶属于不同部门的学会成员呢，在别处很难看到这种景象。……列车长会觉得他们的装备很有意思吗？会被吸引而移不开眼神吗？

帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城2期/奖励结算内容
records.text:
1.在书林核心中与最终BOSS“罪恶的板子”查特兰奇战斗，将根据伤害梯度获取奖励。

2.奖励区间：
伤害达到20000000，获得1扭蛋币，100000铁盟币
伤害达到100000000，获得2扭蛋币，200000铁盟币
伤害达到500000000，获得3扭蛋币，300000铁盟币
伤害达到1000000000，获得4扭蛋币，400000铁盟币
伤害达到5000000000，获得5扭蛋币，500000铁盟币
伤害达到10000000000，获得6扭蛋币，600000铁盟币

3.活动期间，列车长历史最高伤害将计入巡游积分榜，积分榜前500名的列车长将获得活动特殊奖励。

records.idCN: 帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城2期/车队内容
records.text:
1.车队每局会随机出现在移动轨迹上的任一格，并向随机方向开始移动，玩家和车队同步行动。

2.车队共5节，占撰文迷宫地图3格，每次移动会固定移动2格。

3.走到车队上，即可获得火焰和随机奖励。

4.同一局中，第2次遇到车队将无法获得奖励。

records.idCN: 帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城2期/游玩项目内容
records.text:
1.共有9种游玩项目，其中包括：战斗、特殊战斗、书籍、装帧、珍宝、邂逅、商店、提灯、破旧的提灯。

2.游玩项目介绍：

（1）战斗，战斗胜利时可以获得奖励，但如果战斗失败，将额外扣除20行动点。

（2）特殊战斗，战斗胜利时可以获得交易品奖励，但如果战斗失败，将额外扣除20行动点。

（3）书籍，获得【书籍】。

（4）装帧，可以为【书籍】升级。

（5）珍宝，可获得随机奖励。

（6）邂逅，可以获得随机奖励或者帮助，并解锁“奇遇日记”中的图鉴内容。

（7）商店，在其中可以使用【书的一页】购买【背包】里的道具、火焰、扭蛋币。

（8）提灯，使用提灯后加宽可前进的格数，变为面前的5格，选择一个方向移动后不消耗行动点，同时获得【失落之匣】，打开可获得【书籍】。

（9）破旧的提灯，使用破旧的提灯后会随机移动到面前的5格之一，不消耗行动点同时获得【失落之匣】，打开可获得【书籍】。

records.idCN: 帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城2期/活动说明内容
records.text:
1.在撰文迷宫中不断前进，收集书籍和火焰提升自身战斗力。

2.追寻巡游中的雷比斯车队，获得丰厚的随机奖励和火焰。

3.收集不同色彩的火焰，可解锁不同的强力烟花效果，在最终战中对“罪恶的板子”查特兰奇打出高额伤害，伤害越高，奖励越丰厚。

records.idCN: 帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城2期/活动说明页签
帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城2期/游玩项目页签
帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城2期/固定建筑内容
records.text:
1.撰文迷宫中包含10大固定建筑：学生中心、广场、食堂、树屋、喷泉、灯油营地、调律室、哲人釜、迷津之门、书林核心。在固定建筑中可以体验固定的游玩项目，同时每个建筑必定获得1个随机颜色的火焰（书林核心除外）。

2.固定建筑游玩项目介绍：

（1）学生中心/广场：珍宝，随机获得追踪咒器，查询车队轨迹。

（2）喷泉：邂逅，可获得灵光启示——战斗回复增益。

（3）食堂/树屋：装帧，可以为【书籍】升级。

（4）灯油营地：战斗，连续战斗3分钟。

（5）调律室：战斗，连续战斗5关。

（6）哲人釜：邂逅，

（7）迷津之门：战斗，打败“罪恶的板子”查特兰奇。

（8）书林核心：战斗，对无限血BOSS“罪恶的板子”查特兰奇造成伤害。伤害越高，奖励越丰厚。伤害积分将计入排行榜。

帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城2期/地图内容
records.text:
1.撰文迷宫共有4个起点，玩家会从中随机1个起点出生。

2.撰文迷宫共20层，玩家只能从所在层向下一层行动。玩家可朝向面前的3格移动，也就是左前、前、右前移动。

3.在撰文迷宫地图中可以体验不同的游玩项目，包含10大固定建筑和遍布在地图中的随机游玩项目，其中迷津之门是必经的建筑，书林核心是最终的目的地，在书林核心中与最终BOSS“罪恶的板子”查特兰奇战斗。

4.建筑的游玩项目是固定的，而随机游玩项目每一局都不一样。具体分布可以在小地图中查看。

records.idCN: 帮助/活动帮助/黑月游乐城2期/美梦徽记内容
records.text:
1.【书籍】主要从战斗项目、书籍项目、提灯项目，或者道具【失落之匣】中获得，是重要的战力道具,请尽量收集。

2.需要将【书籍】装配后，才会获得对应的战斗属性。

3.【书籍】是可以通过装帧项目升级的，升级后可获得更强大的属性。

4.【书籍】的等级可以继承到下一局对局。

5.【失落之匣】有概率从商店中买到，或者从珍宝中获得。

records.text:
红月大人，红月大人，
今日的罪人，我们已奉上。
请您褪去，请您归山，
再赐我们，一个天明。


一、完成活动剧情，身涉“红月夜中”


作为落羽村的学生，你过着平凡又快乐的生活，身边也围绕着一些有趣的朋友们。最关心你的寄宿家庭独女亚莉奈，活泼可爱的同伴同学诗羽，执着剑道的大姐头沙罗……以及兼任神社巫女的朱月。与同伴们一起，抱持敬虔之心，举办红月祭吧。
只是切切记住，不要迷失其中。


二、全新战斗关卡开放 享受全新挑战
活动期间，“红月夜中”中将开放“危险信号”限定角色试用关卡，列车长们可以提前体验“亚莉奈·危情”，见证她的魅力与实力。另外，还将开放8个“罪人搜寻”周回关卡，列车长们可重复挑战，获取丰厚奖励。

三、攻克关卡，获取奖励
参与“红月夜中”活动的列车长可以通过攻略战斗关卡获得“缘钱”，并凭借“缘钱”在授与所中换取限定抽卡券、限定头像、银枝、进货采买书、自观测胶卷等多种奖励。

四、完成活动成就，获取丰富奖励
本次“红月夜中”活动中设置了活动任务系统“神谕一览”。只要在活动期间达成任务条件，即可领取缘钱、自观测胶卷、仙人掌能量棒棒糖、等奖励。

records.text: 选择玩家背包内的矿机并点击安装。维修消耗设施内材料。

records.idCN: 荒原/界面/长按产物并拖到玩家背包的合法空格取出后计入任务_0309
records.text: 长按产物并拖到玩家背包的合法空格，取出后计入任务。

records.idCN: 荒原/界面/长按此物品并拖到设施的空格只在成功转移后计入任务_0310
records.text: 长按此物品并拖到设施的空格；只在成功转移后计入任务。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600185/提示
records.text: 先取消已装备的工具，保持徒手；点击“前往”依次采集树木和石头，或手动点击可达目标，收集木头、石头各4个。两项都达标后自动发放任务奖励。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600186/提示
records.text: 打开背包→工具分类→选择斧头→合成→数量1→确认。材料不足时先采集，合成成功1把后完成任务；查看详情和中间点击不发奖励。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600187/提示
records.text: 打开背包→工具分类→选择镐子→合成→数量1→确认，用木头和石头制作1把镐子。材料不足时先采集；工具损坏后仍可徒手采集。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600188/提示
records.text: 点击“前往”按任务要求装备工具并采集；手动操作时在背包工具详情点击“使用”，或拖入快捷栏后点击装备。用斧头完整采完1棵树，再用镐子完整采完1块石头；只点击或打一下不算完成。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600189/提示
records.text: 准备木头、石头各6个，打开背包→工具分类→选择简易武器→合成→数量1→确认。成功制作1件后完成任务，材料不足时先返回采集。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600190/提示
records.text: 打开背包选择简易武器，在详情点击“使用”装备，或拖入快捷栏后点击装备；关闭背包，点击可达动物并击杀1只。动物逃走时靠近后继续，装备或攻击一次不算完成。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600191/提示
records.text: 准备木头、石头各15和金币100，打开背包→建筑分类→选择House1→合成→数量1→确认。此任务要求合成1件建筑，下一任务再放置建造。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600192/提示
records.text: 打开背包→建筑分类→选择已持有的House1→详情“使用”，或放入快捷栏后点击；选择同层全绿位置→确认建造1座。预览和取消不消耗建筑，也不重复发任务奖励。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600193/提示
records.text: 打开背包→建筑分类→选择双向轨道件→合成→数量3→确认。每件需木头、石头各2个，3件共需各6个，可铺3格；直线和转弯共用数量，合成成功累计3件后完成任务。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600194/提示
records.text: 点击“前往”到铁路断口→打开背包→建筑分类选择“自动铺轨”→详情点击“使用”→点击指示地块延伸轨道→新增3格有效预览后点击确认。每格消耗对应轨道件，缺货红影不计入；取消不消耗，中间点击不发任务奖励。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600195/提示
records.text: 点击火车任意车厢，在菜单确认上车；点击手指指示的连通轨道行驶至少3格；再点击指示的非轨道格停车下车。不会自动驾驶或确认，奖励由服务器确认后发放。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600240/提示
records.text: 前往仓库导航点，消耗背包木头、石头各5激活；大型仓库需各20。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600241/提示
records.text: 打开已激活仓库，将木头、石头各5拖入指定仓库格。火车停靠时可同时使用玩家、火车、仓库三栏。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600242/提示
records.text: 前往木材工厂，消耗玩家背包木头、石头各10激活。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600243/提示
records.text: 把木头存入木材工厂，木头2加工木板1需10秒。加工并取出木板累计5，满仓会暂停后续生产。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600244/提示
records.text: 消耗木头、石头各10激活矿脉；手动合成简易矿机后安装，累计取矿石5。矿机每10秒产1，耗1耐久；设施内木石各2可维修25耐久。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600245/提示
records.text: 玩家背包准备木板10、石头10，在金属工厂导航点或合法停靠点激活。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600246/提示
records.text: 把矿石放入金属工厂，每2矿石加工1铁锭需15秒；加工并取出铁锭累计3。

records.idCN: 荒原/任务引导/引导61600247/提示
records.text: 打开已激活工厂，选择当前可访问容器，向NPC出售木板、矿石、铁锭、钢板或齿轮累计3件；不会自动出售其他容器物品。

records.text:
请将这冰冷的故事握在你无力的手掌，
为它系一段悼念的绸带，在你失去的记忆中珍藏。
如同那一个个仍然美丽的花环，
是来客们献予已无法归还的异国他乡。


一、完成活动剧情，身涉“箱庭内外”


活动期间，“箱庭内外”中将开放“巡礼开始”剧情关卡，列车长可以通过攻略关卡来解锁活动剧情。

二、全新战斗关卡开放 享受全新挑战
活动期间，“箱庭内外”中将开放“《温暖你的篝火》”等限定角色试用关卡，列车长们可以提前体验“小红帽”等角色，见证她的魅力与实力。另外，还将开放8个“破坏箱庭”周回关卡，列车长们可重复挑战，获取丰厚奖励。

三、攻克关卡，获取奖励
参与“箱庭内外”活动的列车长可以通过攻略战斗关卡获得“借阅证”，并凭借“借阅证”在图书归还处中换取限定抽卡券、限定UR、限定头像、银枝、进货采买书、自观测胶卷等多种奖励。

四、完成活动成就，获取丰富奖励
本次“箱庭内外”活动中设置了活动任务系统“寻猎目标”。只要在活动期间达成任务条件，即可领取借阅证、自观测胶卷、仙人掌能量棒棒糖、等奖励。
